name: abyssal scimitar
descriptions: This curved blade looks as if a nightless sky were used to
craft it. Light is swallowed up by the edge and yet a deadly
shine seems to dance along the length. Black iron has been
used to fashion a simple hilt to this weapon of evil. A
taint seems ever-present with this scimitar, and a low
shriek can be heard as the weapon slides through the air.

name: acid gland
descriptions: This rubbery lump is covered with a thin layer of slime. It
is pale white in colour, and has a distasteful smell faintly
reminiscent of rotting flesh.

name: acid slasher
descriptions: A blade of magical acid is grafted to a silver hilt. The
blade drips large goblets of flesh-eating acid on the ground
causing a hissing to sound. On the pommel of the hilt is
the symbol of a black and white snake intertwining,
devouring each other in an eternal struggle.

name: adamantite bracers
descriptions: These heavy, dull grey bracers are crafted from the
juggernaut of all metals -- adamantite. It is known for its
massive weight and incredible durability. As with anything
made from adamantite, these bracers are heavy and nearly
impenetrable.

name: adamantite chain gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of elbow-length gauntlets, created from
adamantite metal. The gloves seem to have their own gleam,
and the links themselves show the excellence that only a
dwarven hand could bring.

name: adamantite chainmail coif
descriptions: Crafted expertly for snug fitting protection of the head,
these adamantite chain links look almost invincible to
the sharpest blade.

name: adamantite chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This heavy suit of chainmail armour gleams with the smooth
darkness of the metal known as adamantite. Nearly
indestructible and quite rare, only master smiths have the
necessary skill to craft such works of art.

name: adamantite chainmail leggings
descriptions: These heavy leggings gleam with a shine all their own.
Crafted from adamantite, the chain links have been fasioned
with an experienced hand. While heavier then normal chain,
they also provide increased protection from attack.

name: adamantite chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is plainly decorated, but has been
polished to a nearly mirrorlike shine. Silver studs lining
its edges glimmer brightly, and it is obvious that the chest
is full of valuables.

name: adamantite chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is plainly decorated, but has been
polished to a nearly mirrorlike shine. Silver studs lining
its edges glimmer brightly, and it is obvious that the chest
is full of valuables.

name: adamantite claymore
descriptions: This is a large one-handed sword, nearly the size of a
bastard-sword and crafted out of adamantite. The hilt is
wound with black leather and intertwined with fine mithril
thread. Dark blue energy pulses up and down the length of
the blade, making the hair on the back of your neck stand on
end.

name: adamantite enforced boots
descriptions: Boots of thick, heavy leather have been reinforced with
large bands of pure adamantite. The efficiency of the work
shows the boots to be of dwarven make, and their toughness
in combat can be seen by the naked eye.

name: adamantite katana
descriptions: This four-foot-long sword is one of the finest examples of
craftmanship you have ever seen. Made from the powerful, but
heavy metal, adamantite, it is a weapon to strike terror
into a foe. Perfectly balanced and sharper than a razor, in
a master's hands it is a whirling blade of death.

name: adamantite key
descriptions: This large key is crafted from the dusky grey metal known as
adamantite. It is indestructible and quite heavy for its
size. Stamped into the head of the key is a bold royal
insignia.

name: adamantite longsword
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened adamantite, bladed
along one edge. Its thin, heavy blade was made for thrusting
or slashing. The feel of the sword shows it was crafted to
be a well-balanced weapon, striking wounds with ferocious
accuracy.

name: adamantite ninjato
descriptions: This blade of bright adamantite looks sharp enough to split
a hair. The wooden hilt has been wrapped with fine black
leather, and the letter R has been stamped on the base.

name: adamantite platemail tunic
descriptions: This massive suit of plate armour is made of interlocking
plates of dark, gleaming adamantite. Nearly impenetrable,
this suit of armour would greatly protect the wearer in
combat, if the weight is bearable.

name: adamantite ring
descriptions: This ring is crafted in the image of a dragon, encircling
itself to devour its tail. Written on the head of the
dragon is the letter "R".

name: adamantite scale gauntlets
descriptions: Toughened animal hide is decorated with the fist sized
shapes of pure adamantite metal. While heavier then the norm
these gloves are clearly designed for the best protection
in combat, without the weight of platemail. On each piece
a dwarven rune has been stamped, showing the craftsman to
be of great prowess among dwarves.

name: adamantite scalemail leggings
descriptions: Discs of purest adamantite have been sewn together into the
thick hide of an animal. While the hide itself offers some
protection, the powerful metal covering offers even
greater protection to the legs of the wearer. On each disc
is stamped the dwarven letter for "M" indicating the master
craft of a dwarven smith.

name: adamantite scalemail tunic
descriptions: This suit of animal hide is covered with fist-shaped discs
of adamantite. Each one has been sewn into the hide,
clustered together in vital areas of the torso. On each disc
the rune of the dwarven tongue has been stamped, indicating
this fine suit of armour the work of "Martok"

name: adamantite scimitar
descriptions: This is a curved sword, about three feet in length, and
bladed upon one edge. It is thin and fairly light, but can
deliver considerable slashing wounds.

name: adamantite spear
descriptions: This long, heavy spear is crafted from one of the hardest
and heaviest metals known -- adamantite. Its dark surface
almost seems to absorb light, and its head is razor-sharp
and glimmers in the light.

name: adamantite wrist guard
descriptions: This wrist guard is made from pure adamantite, glimmmering
darkly as you turn it this way and that examining the
exquisite work. The metal is tastefully paired with black
leather to form a dark and dangerous looking wrist guard,
while still providing excellent protection and flexibility
for the off-hand.

name: aegis shield
descriptions: This huge, round shield is intricately carved in a manner
not seen in hundreds of years. Raised in the centre of the
shield, a long-forgotten god's face stares out, the
sapphires in his eyes gleaming like lightning. It has
survived for countless generations, and aside from its
antiquated appearance it is completely unmarked.

name: agate stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is banded with brown, blue, red
and white stripes.

name: aged desk
descriptions: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from
a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside
mansions of the rich. Thick dust coats it entirely, turning
its polished brown to a dull, sickly grey.

name: aged desk
descriptions: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from
a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside
mansions of the rich. Thick dust coats it entirely, turning
its polished brown to a dull, sickly grey. A drawer is
curiously open halfway, drawing your attention.

name: alder chest
descriptions: This large, iron-banded alder chest is nearly too heavy to
move. Iron handles on its sides allow it to be carried, and
whatever is inside rattles about noisily.

name: alleyway
descriptions: This narrow, unlit alley is filled with trash and other
unbecoming articles. It stinks heavily of rot and offal,
and rats scurry away as you look.

name: altar
descriptions: This large altar is made of smooth granite, with runes of
wickedness carved into its face. Restraints for the head,
hands and feet have been grafted to the stone, allowing
little escape for anyone chained to its blood-bathed
surface. An intricate spider design has been fashioned in
the centre of the rock, its eyes glaring at you evilly.

name: altar
descriptions: A round pillar of molten brimstone is set in the center of
the lair, flames billowing high from its center pit. Glyphs
and other symbols of forbidden arcanery flicker from the
altar's smoldering surface, seeming like caged spirits held
against their will.

name: altar
descriptions: This large, bloodstained altar has wide blood gutters
leading down to a hollow at one end. In this hollow, a
black, fist-sized gem is set. Presumably blood and the gem
are used for some sadistic ritual -- it is clear that
sacrifices made on this stone slab would bathe the black
stone in blood.

name: altar
descriptions: This bowl-shaped silver altar looks like it was once used
to burn offerings or to provide light. It is permanently
affixed to the shrine's marble floor, which is probably why
it has not been stolen.

name: amber emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCAMBER.EMB

name: amber key
descriptions: This is a large shiny key carved from a large piece of
amber. Its handle is carved in the shape of a lightning
bolt.

name: amber pearl earrings
descriptions: This pair of small amber earrings have been crafted to
cradle a pearl, looking as though they were a pair of rain
drops. The pearls seem to waver in front of you, but it
could be a trick on your vision.

name: amber sceptre
descriptions: Three feet in length, this sceptre has an odd glow to it, as
if dimming and shining in its own pattern. Strange, unusual
markings adorn it on all sides, and a shining ball stands
atop its circular head. Great power seems to surge forth,
and you sense a heat that emanates from the grip.

name: amber shard
descriptions: This long shard of amber is shocking to touch for it seems
to possess an awesome amount of electricity. Inside
the crystal you see lightning dancing within, most likely
fueling the enormous shock it emits.

name: amber talisman
descriptions: This small, circular disc is engraved with a curving sigil
of peculiar design.

name: amethyst emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCAMETH.EMB

name: amethyst pendant
descriptions: This is a crudely-cut piece of amethyst in a plain iron
setting.

name: amethyst ring
descriptions: This beautiful, silver ring is set with a trio of small,
uncut, lavender-hued amethysts.

name: amethyst stone
descriptions: This small, fancy stone is a beautiful semi-transparent
purple in colour.

name: ancient blackwood heart
descriptions: An ancient wooden heart, so black it is almost cancerous.
Dirt still clings to it like a second skin and a stench
seems to arise from it intermittently. It still feels very
warm to your touch as if it still held life inside of it.

name: ancient bone chest
descriptions: A chest that sends shivers down your spine it is a chest
made of some ancient wood that appears to be stained with
blood all over. Strange runes are etched all along the sides
and even more archaic symbols adorn the handles and locks

name: ancient book
descriptions: Many years are stacked on the pages of this great and
massive tome, the front reads "Epic of Ages Volume XXX"
by Jiggs Longthorne. You open the book and read...

name: ancient chime
descriptions: This is a bell-like golden chime, often used to ward off
evil spirits. Dust covers it like a greatcloak, but it
still looks useable.

name: ancient door
descriptions: This huge ancient door is elegantly decorated with delicate
scrollwork and stylized vines. It appears to have weathered
the years quite well, and is nearly as strong as it was when
it was new. A square lock gapes from its right side, though
the key to this door must be long lost.

name: ancient key
descriptions: This key of ancient stone is shaped like an angel with its
wings spread for flight. Most of the features have been
marred by age, and it feels as if it were about to crumble
in your hand.

name: ancient obsidian key
descriptions: A large key fashioned from obsidian shows immense age and
use. It is very worn, and some of the teeth seem to have
disappeared entirely, you are sure this key is totally
worthless.

name: ancient paper
descriptions: Almost tattered beyond recognition, this paper has been
folded, unfolded, and mangled many times. You can see
deep lines in the paper, where ink once was, but has now
faded to mix with the dirt that has shaded this paper.

name: ancient parchment
descriptions: An ancient scroll, written many ages ago, it crinkles as
you grasp it, the dry page beginning to flake away from
your touch.

name: ancient scroll
descriptions: This ancient scroll holds cryptic writing within it that
seem glow with a dangerous power. They look to be priestly
runes inscribed upon its aged skin.

name: ancient scroll
descriptions: This ancient scroll holds cryptic writing within it, that
seem glow with a dangerous power. They look to be runes of
the magi upon its aged skin.

name: ancient scroll
descriptions: Time has finally gotten the best of this scripture to
knowledge. As soon as you unravel the scroll you see the ink
has faded beyond recognition and the scroll itself is about
to crumble.

name: ancient statues
descriptions: These huge, weatherbeaten statues must have been carved some
thousands of years ago, judging from their unfamiliar style
of workmanship and the degree of decay. They appear to be
warrior-kings, each holding up a palm in greeting... or
possibly warning. You think you can see a hint of sadness
etched into the statues' ancient, scarred faces.

name: ancient stone wall
descriptions: This ancient stone wall towers about a hundred feet over
you. It is made of huge dark blue blocks, their surfaces
barely marred by the passage of time.

name: ancient sword
descriptions: This ancient iron scimitar was crafted very well, as it has
survived many an age without losing its edge. Very well
balanced and hilted with a carved oak handle this would be
an excellent weapon for most fighters. A single rune is
stamped on the hilt, possibly a family crest.

name: ancient tapestry
descriptions: within the picture seems to draw you in.

name: ancient tome
descriptions: This large, heavy tome lays open, a thin, red silk bookmark
nestled between its pages. The ancient, yellow pages are
covered in a thin, spidery text which reads:

name: ancient tome
descriptions: Opening the tome, you find a page and read...

name: Angel's talon
descriptions: This dagger is over two feet in length. Large for its size,
it is somewhat quick to wield. It looks to be made of ivory
but it has an almost hidden beauty not found in earthen
stones. The blade is somewhat curved to appear like that
of a talon. A golden sunburst is engraved on the pommel of
the silver hilt.

name: AngelCrusher
descriptions: Hellish runes dance along this evil weapon. Black draconian
wings sprout from the handle to form opposing hammerheads.
Crimson markings are seen all along the entire weapon, no
doubt signs of the many evils that have been enclosed into
the black iron of this crusher of angels.

name: angelic statue
descriptions: A large marble statue stands before you, a sculpture of
some angelic figure clutching a book as if it were more
important then life itself. A silver plaque has been clawed
and scratched as if blotting out any mention to which the
statue was ment to honor.

name: angular key
descriptions: This beautifully-crafted brass key is quite large and
heavy. It head is cut with an angular geometric design.

name: ankh key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of an ankh.

name: anointed morningstar
descriptions: A platinum rod connects a chain of finest silver to a large
barbed diamond ball. Incantations of divine power encircle
the diamond, protecting it from shattering, while dealing
swift and brutal justice to any and all villiany. The weapon
moves swiftly and with ease, as if it were an extension of
your arm. Its spikes are like the fangs of a coiled viper.

name: antlered helm
descriptions: This is a rigid leather helm, with many druish runes painted
on the crown and sides. Two large three-pointed antlers have
been grafted to the helm, giving its wearer a fearsome
visage.

name: anvil
descriptions: This large black-iron anvil is propped up by a stand, giving
it a height of four feet. Its flat hammering surface is
battered in parts from heavy use, and other dents show its
abuse as well. Carved into the side of the anvil is the
letter "A", other letters follow but they have been
scratched out.

name: apple
descriptions: A semi-round fruit with bright red skin and off-white flesh.
A dry, brown stem and small green leaf are still attached to
its crown.

name: apple pie
descriptions: An apple filled pastry fills and is folded over a thin tin
pan. The dough is cross-hatched across the top, and baked
to golden perfection. The smell of cinnamon seeps wafts out
from within, oozing in places where the apple goo has seeped
out of cracks.

name: apple tree
descriptions: Matured well into its prime, this beautiful, healthy tree
has greyish brown bark and soft green leaves. The
branches and foliage are so thick it is sometimes difficult
to spot ripened fruits within. You think you spot a ready
fruit hanging just above your reach.

name: apple tree
descriptions: Matured well into its prime, this beautiful, healthy tree
has greyish brown bark and soft green leaves. The
branches and foliage are so thick it is sometimes difficult
to spot ripened fruits within.

name: aquamarine stone
descriptions: This small, precious stone is quite smooth, and a pale
blue-green in colour.

name: arcane tome
descriptions: This is a small, hand-sized book. On its cover is an exotic
design decorated by a strikingly ornate description.
Glancing about its tattered pages, you find an ancient
incantation which may be of use to mages.

name: arlysian dagger
descriptions: This is a small, sharp knife, used primarily for stabbing.
It is easy to handle and to conceal, but it does minor
damage. It is completely useless against most heavy armours.
The mark of Arlysia is etched on the blade.

name: arlysian firegut
descriptions: A strange and mysterious liquid resides in the depths of
this stone tankard. A quick sniff immediately numbs your
nostrils, cutting off all sense of smell and feeling.

name: arlysian longsword
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon. The mark of
Arlysia is etched on the hilt.

name: arlysian mace
descriptions: This is a steel ball mounted on a two-foot wooden rod. It
is a well-rounded weapon, providing adequate defense and
attack. This is the weapon of choice for those of the
priestly following. The mark of Arlysia is etched on the
handle.

name: ashwood staff
descriptions: This long, slender staff has weighty silver caps on the ends
for better striking power. It is nicely balanced. Thin
leather strips have been wound about the centre for grip.

name: ashwood wand
descriptions: This long, slender ashwood wand is smoothly carved, and is
engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: astral gloves
descriptions: This pair of silky smooth gloves reflect an alien greyness
that moves about with a life of its own. At first glance
these gloves look flimsy, but upon further inspection reveal
a magical toughness that would offer fair protection to the
hands.

name: astral robes
descriptions: Strange, haunting visions of the astral plane continually
shift and writhe across the surface of these pale golden
robes. Made of some light, but incredibly strong, material,
the magic inherent in these robes can be felt by even the
most magic-deadened individual.

name: astral skirt
descriptions: The bright sights of the astral plane move and quiver
across this wrap of pale golden fabric. Made of an almost
weightless material, the feeling of immense magic radiates
from the fabric.

name: astral slippers
descriptions: Astral patterns dance along the tops of this pair of
magically woven slippers. While more weighty then a pair of
shoes, the power of these slippers easily offer more
protection from the elements.

name: astral staff
descriptions: This staff is seemingly made specifically for fighters,
however strong magics have been placed upon it. It is
doubtful that any but the most strongly linked to magic
could wield it.

name: astral trousers
descriptions: The bright sights of the astral plane move and quiver
across this pair of pale golden leggings. Made of an almost
weightless material, the feeling of immense magic radiates
from the fabric.

name: avalanche of jagged rubble
descriptions: This massive pile of collapsed stone appears to be
completely impassable, as the stones are both too large and
too sharp to handle. However, several man-sized holes can be
seen leading inside the rubble, and although it would be
dangerous, a few of them may be passable.

name: azure shamshir
descriptions: This long, curved sword is made out of an intense blue
substance that appears to be glass. It is smooth and
exceptionally well crafted, and the handle is made of
carved ivory that is extremely comfortable.

name: azurite stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is opaque and a deep mottled
blue in colour.

name: bag of poison
descriptions: This small leather bag is filled with a lethal concoction
of poisons.

name: ball of webbing
descriptions: This thick ball of webbing is remarkable light and pliable.
It looks as if it would make a decent projectile.

name: bane dart
descriptions: Made from the poisons of a jeweled viper this dart is able
to disrupt a spellcasters ability to draw and control
magical powers.

name: barbed circlet
descriptions: This odd piece of headwear has been created from a metal
you have not seen before. It is spindly and thin, as if
it could be easily breakable, yet somehow feels
indestructable. It hums slightly, and a glow pulses from it
in a rhythm of its own. Large purple-tinged barbs stick out,
as if to grasp the head that wears it.

name: barbed key
descriptions: This key is made of some foreign metal with various barbs
and spikes jutting from its teeth. A wicked looking key you
shudder to think of the door that it must go to.

name: barbed spear
descriptions: This long, sturdy spear has been crafted out of a tough
swamp tree. Its head is made of sharp steel, hooked and
barbed to cause painful injury.

name: barbed whip
descriptions: This long, heavy whip is made of thick leather strands
intertwined with thin metal wires. Along the length of the
whip are hooked metal barbs, and a large cluster of these
is affixed to the tip of the whip.

name: bardic lute
descriptions: This rare lute is a remnant of the days of the legendary
bards. Its resonance is perfect and its construction is a
mastery of woodcraft.

name: barkskin scroll
descriptions: This thick, weathered bark scroll is inscribed with many
passages written in a bold, flowing hand. Upon scanning its
contents, you discover that it contains the secret methods
of learning and casting the Regeneration spell! This
powerful but short-lived spell rapidly heals the target's
wounds.

name: barrier
descriptions: This shimmering, nearly invisible barrier can only be seen
by the slight opalescent ripples that occasionally break
its surface. It covers the passageway to the north, and
seems impenetrable.

name: bas-relief image
descriptions: This beautifully-carved image is that of an angular, glowing
figure garbed in flowing robes. Great feathered wings spread
out majestically from its back, and its head is bowed as if
in supplication. Its androgynous face radiates a feeling of
serenity and peace.

name: basalt key
descriptions: This black, porous stone key is indestructible despite its
fragile appearance.

name: basalt obelisk
descriptions: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric
symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level,
two lines in an ancient language read:

name: basalt obelisk
descriptions: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric
symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level,
two lines in an ancient language read:

name: basalt obelisk
descriptions: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric
symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level,
two lines in an ancient language read:

name: bastard sword
descriptions: This is a light two-handed sword. It is about three-and-a-
half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a
greatsword. It is fairly fast and damaging, and is overall
a good weapon.

name: battered chainmail hauberk
descriptions: It is evident from initial inspection that the wearer of
this tunic met with a grisly end. Missing links, large holes
and countless nicks and scratches show this tunic has gone
through several untold battles. Despite this, it looks
protective for someone desperate enough in battle.

name: battered wooden chest
descriptions: This large wooden chest has seen better days. Large iron
bands scratched and bent in places from fruitless attempts
to remove them, hold the container securely on the floor. No
locks secure the lid and there is a loose latch on the lid
that looks like it would be easy to lift.

name: battle-hammer
descriptions: This is a large, two-handed sledgehammer. It is very heavy
and quite slow, but the damage it does in battle is
considerable.

name: battle axe
descriptions: This is a large double-bladed axe, used in one hand. It is
a favourite of strong warriors, as it can inflict impressive
wounds, and is not so massive as to be unwieldly.

name: battlehorn
descriptions: This is a simple horn of some large beast, hollowed out
entirely with a mouthpiece of platinum at the tip. You see
on the mouthpiece is a large O with a swirl inside the ring,
a rune of perhaps but your not sure what it does.

name: beaded belt
descriptions: This belt is made of several coloured beads, woven together
with several tiny vines. You can not tell if the glow of
the belt comes from the beads or the vines, but a strange
warm feeling seems to radiate with each glow.

name: beastly claws
descriptions: Formerly belonging to some dreadful beast, these claws look
as though they could slash through skin with chilling ease.
The claws themselves are attached to a pair of large,
severed hands that have been hollowed out somehow by
unnatural means. The sickening thought enters your mind that
you could use these claws as a weapon by wearing the skin.

name: bed
descriptions: This large, comfortable bed is simple in design, but
sturdily crafted. A luxurious goose-down mattress insures
a good night's rest.

name: beef stew
descriptions: This is a small earthenware bowl filled with a thick,
nutritious stew comprised of beef and onions.

name: behemoth hellhound hide
descriptions: This is the thick, heavy hide of a behemoth hellhound. Its
black fur is dry and straight, and reeks of brimstone.

name: behemoth hide
descriptions: This hideous-looking armour is fashioned from the worked
hide of a behemoth. Stronger than steel, the behemoth's
spiked skin gives the wearer an ominous and deadly
appearance while providing incredible protection.

name: belt of faith
descriptions: Crafted from a mix of mithril and adamantite, this belt is
a symbol of protection. A platinum circle adorned with a
diamond, a ruby, and an onyx sits as the buckle. Inscripted
upon it are the words "Protection of faith." It is very
finely made and gives off an aura of power.

name: belt of might
descriptions: This is a plain leather belt, with a solid iron buckle
fashioned into two clasping hands. Its ordinary appearance
hides a potent power.

name: belt of the crimson flame
descriptions: This is a wide leather strap with crimson metal scales
fastened tightly together around it. Each scale has the
mark of a flame stamped firmly upon it. The largest metal
piece also works as the buckle. It is somewhat stiff to bend
but flexible enough to wear around the waist.

name: bench
descriptions: This long wooden bench is often seen accompanying the common
tables in an inn. It is sturdily built from solid oak wood.

name: birch rod
descriptions: This heavy birch rod is about two feet long, and is
covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: black altar
descriptions: The black altar is large enough that a large human would
easily fit upon its surface. Ancient bloodstains can be seen
encrusted upon it. The glaring eye engraved on the altar
fairly radiates evil, and has an odd, smooth construction.

name: black and white serpent ring
descriptions: This intricate ring is crafted out of coloured adamantite,
and is made to look like two intertwined snakes, each biting
the other's tail. Each tiny scale is picked out in perfect
detail, and each small eye is a round, glittering grey
crystal.

name: black badge
descriptions: This heavy iron badge is crafted in the shape of a clawed
fist. It is commonly seen on high-ranking leaders in an orc
war band.

name: black banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCBLAC.BAN

name: black book
descriptions: It is hard to tell if this book has ever been opened.
Not a spot of dust covers the entire manual and the pages
look crisp and fresh. Spidery runes decorate the front and
sides of the manual, you open it to the first page and read:

name: black cauldron
descriptions: This massive black cauldron is large enough to hold an
entire person, and from the looks of it, has indeed been
used for such a purpose. Vile slime coats the inside of the
cauldron, and it reeks of evilness.

name: black chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This suit of chainmail is enameled with a flat black lacquer
finish. It sports cruel-looking spikes on the shoulder
guards and has on it a badge made in the image of a red
horned skull.

name: black chitin armour
descriptions: This exotic-looking armour seems to be made out of glossy,
violet-black plates of insect carapace. It has been crafted
in such a way as to maximize protection given, and has been
treated with some special formula and bonded with spider
silk to increase strength. It is indeed incredibly hard and
strong for its weight.

name: black chitin gauntlets
descriptions: These exotic-looking gauntlets seem to have been made out
of glossy, violet-black plates of insect chitin. They have
been bounded together with spider silk and treated with a
secret formula which makes them extremely hard and glossy.

name: black chitin helm
descriptions: This exotic-looking helm is quite beautiful in an alien sort
of way. It seems to be made of a deep violet-black insect
carapace, and has been crafted to resemble the head of one
of these insects, complete with antennae and glossy black
eyes on the forehead of the helm. It is extraordinarily
strong for its weight.

name: black chitin leggings
descriptions: These exotic-looking leggings seem to have been made out of
glossy, violet-black plates of insect chitin. They have been
bonded together with spider silk and treated with a secret
formula which makes them extremely hard and glossy.

name: black chitin shield
descriptions: This exotic-looking shield seems to have been crafted from
three large, interlocking plates of violet-black insect
chitin. They have been bonded together with spider silk, and
treated with a secret formula, rendering them extremely
hard. The shield is very light for its size, and would
provide excellent protection.

name: black diamond
descriptions: These oval shaped black diamonds appear to be worn
ornamentally on the forehead. Holding one in your hand, you
realize they are actually a living organism that embeds in
their flesh. Only the death of a nanati host releases the
stone. It hums with life in your hand.

name: black door
descriptions: Steel bands reinforce this black wooden door. A small
shuttered slit is cut at eye level, allowing whomever is
inside to look out, but not allowing you to look in. An
elaborate depression in the shape of a five-pointed star
is set just above the handle of the door.

name: black dragon boots
descriptions: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the
black hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and
are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also
form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: black dragon carving
descriptions: This three-foot-diameter obsidian carving features a roaring
dragon's head, encircled by fuming droplets. Five odd curved
slots ring the carving, two of which are filled by white and
black fangs.

name: black dragon gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the
hide of a black dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm
to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost
any attack.

name: black dragon helm
descriptions: This is a sturdy helm of black dragonhide, fashioned with
superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect
the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: black dragon hide
descriptions: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon.
Black as night, it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes
jutting out in some spots. Touching the scales show an extra
roughness to them, and you wonder if it could be used for
some kind of armour.

name: black dragon hood
descriptions: The cloth of this hood readily appears black, but shines
midnight blue in bright light. A serpentine dragon has been
embroidered along the bottom of the mask, looking as
though it were about to strike. The mask enhances the abilit
to sneak up on someone, as  it absorbs even the tiniest
sounds of breathing.

name: black dragon leggings
descriptions: Black dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings.
Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer
powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very
flexible.

name: black dragon robes
descriptions: A magnificent silk robe, coloured a deep black. Sewn on the
front is a midnight blue dragon, reaching out with claw and
fang alike to strike out. It is tied around the waist by an
equally black silk sash that has small onyx sewn into the
center.

name: black dragon tabi
descriptions: These knee-length boots have been fashioned from a fine type
of silk, and dyed a midnight blue. The form of a black
dragon has been sewn on them, its tail beginning at the shin
and its maw ending on the foot. The soles have been woven
in such a way that movement would be muffled, enhancing
the wearers stealth.

name: black dragon tunic
descriptions: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of black dragonhide was
obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along
the back and shoulders give it an almost nightmarish look,
making its wearer look terrifying indeed.

name: black embroidered robes
descriptions: A large black robe of a velvet material that completely
covers you from head to toe. A gold pattern is embroidered
around the hem of the robe, and around each sleeve. The
material is thick and provides excellent protection.

name: black fang
descriptions: This is a four-inch-long fang, black as pitch and very
sharp. It irritates your skin to touch it.

name: black flail
descriptions: This large, jet-black flail has glowing red runes burning
along its length. Its three heads are spiked and would cause
great damage in battle.

name: black iron chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has
been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's
carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its
lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: black key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted black, you
can assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: black keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate black keys.

name: black king
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a royal crown,
similar to that of a great king.

name: black knight
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which then is fashioned to become a horses
head.

name: black leather belt
descriptions: This leather belt is made of a glossy black leather which
seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does not weigh
much at all, and is very flexible.

name: black leather book
descriptions: A tightly bound black leather volume, no writing can be
seen on the outside, as if something had burnt off any
lettering. You open the book and find a passage.

name: black leather book
descriptions: A large leather book dyed black, bear no markings of any
sort on the cover. You open it and find a page that draws
your attention....

name: black leather book
descriptions: A tightly bound black leather volume, no writing can be
seen on the outside, as if something had burnt off any
lettering. You open the book and find a passage...

name: black leather leggings
descriptions: This pair of leather leggings is made from a glossy black
leather which seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does
not weigh much at all, and is very flexible.

name: black leather tunic
descriptions: This leather vest is made of a glossy black leather which
seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does not weigh
much at all, and is very flexible.

name: black mountains
descriptions: The stone of these mountains is coal black and as sharp as
flint. It is shot through with thin metallic red veins,
which reflect the light with crimson sparkles. This mountain
range is known to be practically unscalable, and is nearly
devoid of plant life. Very few creatures can survive in such
harshness, and those that do are deadly.

name: black ninja robes
descriptions: These tight black robes are made out of a tough, non-
reflective fabric. They are slightly elastic to allow
freedom of movement, but are fitted so they do not flap or
make any noise.

name: black opal
descriptions: This small gem is dark green in colour, with black mottling
and golden flecks.

name: black orb
descriptions: This fist-sized orb is engraved with swirling lines and
designs. Spaced evenly about the orb are six different
runes, carved deeply into its surface.

name: black orb
descriptions: This head-sized orb floats in the air with apparent ease.
Its smooth, featureless surface is shrouded in arcing energy
which makes you wince at its intensity.

name: black parchment deed
descriptions: A thick double-rolled sheet of parchment bound with black cord
and sealed with jet wax stamped with a skull. The lettering is
set in silver ink and grants full ownership of a spacious gang
hall with capacity for up to 1,200 members.

name: black plate boots
descriptions: This pair of boots is fashioned from thick black iron, and
lined with the coarse hide of some animal. Formed with very
poor skill, they lack any form of comfort but offer
good defense against attack. A harsh, crimson rune has been
stamped on the toe and heel of each boot. The iron is
surprisingly light for its thickness.

name: black plate corselet
descriptions: This is a heavy platemail corselet, made of black iron.
Underneath is a black chainmail shirt of the same material.
It is extremely heavy, but is massive and will provide
excellent protection from attack. Glowing red runes glitter
over its entire surface, and appear to crawl and move when
you're not looking directly at them.

name: black plate gauntlets
descriptions: A collection of black iron have been fashioned to into a
pair of heavy gauntlets. The palm of each metal glove has
been created from coarse animal hide and each knuckle has
been stamped with a harsh, glowing rune. The iron looks
very heavy but feels surprisingly light.

name: black plate leggings
descriptions: These crude iron plates are inscribed with harsh, sprawling
runes, and are heavily nicked and scratched. However, they
are surprisingly light for their apparent size.

name: black potion
descriptions: This heavy metal flask is filled with a vile, oily fluid
that reeks of rotting vegetation. Small bits of unknown
matter float about in it revoltingly.

name: black retchweed
descriptions: This coarse, wiry plant is one of the fouler species of
vegetation in swamps. Known to cause death and deformity in
whomever eats it, it can be used to create powerful poisons
for which there is no known antidote.

name: black robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: black rook
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which then is fashioned to become a castle
battlement.

name: black rose
descriptions: Midnight petals hug the stem of this freshly cut rose. Soft
to the touch that it almost feels like down, it is so pretty
in its dark richness it almost brings a tear to your eye.
Legend holds that black roses are the most rare and are
desired for magic if not true beauty.

name: black runed shovel
descriptions: Looking at this shovel makes you queasy. The handle is made
of polished blackwood, with glowing red runes running along
it's shaft and the shovel blade. As you examine the blade
further you realize it has been honed to a sharp edge and
it looks more like an enlarged spearhead then anything else.
Whoever fashioned this shovel no longer intend it to dig.

name: black scimitar
descriptions: This wicked-looking blade is heavily serrated. It is heavy
and unwieldy, but would do great damage to unarmoured
opponents.

name: black scroll
descriptions: With word from the Enigma Lord, I sense my minions from
Silvermere have betrayed me. You saw them when you
delivered the message of Nadroj. Kill them, and any agents
of the white wench or the grey jester. --Balthazar
--Balthazar

name: black serpent key
descriptions: This glossy, sinuous key depicts the form of a serpent with
red, glinting eyes. The teeth of the key are oddly curved as
well, and any lock this key fits must be of a completely
different construction than any ordinary lock you've seen.

name: black shield
descriptions: This heavy black iron shield is emblazoned with a red
horned skull. It is quite heavy, but is large enough to
provide good protection from attacks.

name: black silk gloves
descriptions: These fine gloves are woven out of a glossy black silk. They
are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly
tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen
stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk pants
descriptions: These fine pants are woven out of a glossy black silk. They
are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly
tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen
stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk robes
descriptions: These fine robes are woven out of a glossy black silk. They
are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly
tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen
stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk skirt
descriptions: This fine wrap is woven out of a glossy black silk. It is
embroidered with black thread, and is surprisingly tough.
At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all
over their surface.

name: black silk slippers
descriptions: These fine slippers are woven out of a glossy black silk.
They are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly
tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen
stitched all over their surface.

name: black spike
descriptions: Fashioned from a black metal, this spike looks as though it
were filed to a needle sharp point. Dried blood and bits of
gore stick to the surface, and it seems to emenate a strange
throbbing heat.
realize that the 'rust' is actually dried blood.

name: black spiked ball
descriptions: The smell of burning flesh rises up from this ball of metal.
Long, nine inch spikes protrude from the ball at every angle
making it difficult to manipulate. A small hole can be seen
within the ball itself, with tiny threads inside, as if the
ball were meant to be attached to something.

name: black stained tunic
descriptions: A tunic made of cotton, dyed a deep, unending black. It is
entirely unremarkable except for the dark stains that mark
the shirt. Splotched all over there is no pattern to them
other then they appear to have been splashed on the tunic.
Upon closer inspection you realize the stains are blood,
giving you a slight chill up your back.

name: black star key
descriptions: This black iron key's head is shaped like a circled
five-pointed star. You get a faint feeling of distaste when
touching it.

name: black steel halberd
descriptions: This massive, unwieldy weapon has a wickedly-curved head,
and is fashioned from a gleaming steel the colour of soot.
Wound about its haft is a thin cord which provides a good
grip.

name: black tabi
descriptions: These padded black boots resemble sandals worn overtop
knee-length leggings. Their soles are woven in such a way so
that the sounds of movement are muffled greatly.

name: black tome
descriptions: This huge, heavy tome is covered with swirling silvery runes
and symbols. Inside, yellowed parchment pages are inscribed
with two spells: Chaos Shield, which concentrates chaotic
power around the target in a crackling field, and Mana Flux,
which draws energy from the surrounding area to regenerate
mana. Both spells sometimes have undesired effects.

name: black velvet gloves
descriptions: This is a pair of simple gloves made of a black velvet. Soft
and warm, they have a tingling feeling when touched. On
the palm of each glove is the image of a red eye.

name: blackened book
descriptions: A black silk cover overlaps the dark pages within, written
in an odd script it is somewhat hard to decipher. On the
cover has been drawn the picture of a mirror with a circle
moving around it.

name: blackened bracelet
descriptions: A circlet of some type of burnt metal it is impossible to
tell what it was before being made so crudely. Bizzarre
carvings dance around the large metal ring.

name: blackened dirk
descriptions: This short thick blade is flat black color with intricate
etchings circling the hilt. Light disappears into the
surface of the blade instead of reflecting back. Blending
easily into the shadows, it makes an excellent knife for
those who prey on the unwary.

name: blackened parchment
descriptions: Unrolling the parchment reveals a strange message written in
crimson, almost unreadable letters.

name: blackened scripture
descriptions: This book looks immensely burnt and clawed in several places
you are unsure if the contents can even be deciphered.
You open it anyway and find a single legible page...

name: blackened skin-bound book
descriptions: This ancient tome smells rank and seems to be made of the
blackened skin of a human! Inside contains many spidery-
runed pages.

name: blackened unicorn horn
descriptions: Wretched and evil, this three-foot-long horn emanates an
aura of damnation. As black as night it twists and turns
before coming to a blood tinged tip that is needle sharp and
just as deadly. Because it is so twisted it is somewhat
unwieldy, however it would still make an excellently vile
weapon.

name: blackened wrist guard
descriptions: Made from a flat black metal, this guard is a small disk
that straps cleverly across the palm of your hand and the
back of your wrist. The disk is designed to protect the back
of the hand and wrist while still allowing freedom of
movement to climb, wield a weapon, or cast a spell.

name: blacknight
descriptions: Made of the darkest black cloth these cloaks were
commissioned by Skeller himself for the most poweful of his
guild. Enchanted by an evil drow mage and riddled with
hidden pockets and tools it became the gifted thieves best
friend.

name: blackwood cudgel
descriptions: A crude weapon, it has been fashioned somewhat from the
root of some great blackwood tree. It is very thick, with
twine tide around it's narrow end to form a simple handle.
The base of the cudgel is very thick with knots causing its
target to bruise heavily if not break.

name: blackwood forest
descriptions: The trees of this forest are tall, reaching over you like
giant monsters from a bad dream. Red ichor drips like sap
from the bark and the long, spindly branches stretch out,
hanging its leaves over you like sharp claws.

name: blackwood harp
descriptions: This harp has been crafted from a nightmare. Jagged strings
look as if they were made from twine, with points sticking
out in some places. Fashioned from blackwood it has been
created to look as if the harpist were playing on a ribcage
of some beast, with a dark red polish shining from the wood.
A crimson sigil glows brightly, branded into the wood.

name: blackwood longbow
descriptions: A cruelly fashioned longbow, it looks to be made from
blackwood. The wood has been stained with some dark red
fluid, and the bowstring seems to draw with great speed. A
quiver does not accompany the bow and a practice draw forms
an arrow of darkness. Vile runes are carved on the front of
the bowshaft, that writhe in a twisted dance.

name: blackwood shield
descriptions: Carved from the bark of a blackwood tree, this shield is
very thick. Almost as light as a feather in comparison to a
metal shield, it still looks as though it would provide
protection against attack. The blackwood has been polished
making it dark enough to aid stealth-like abilities. Druidic
runes line the shield all around its edge.

name: blackwood staff
descriptions: This long staff is made of a thick black wood that feels
cold to the touch. Etched upon its length are vile runes
that glow a dark red color. You get a sickly feeling in the
pit of your stomach when you run your fingers along the
letters.

name: blackwood war-spear
descriptions: This menacing black spear has a three-foot long shaft made
of blackwood. It feels as hard as any metal and you suspect
some type of red resin has been used to harden its edge, as
the wood seems to have a reddish tinge. The jagged head
looks to be the fang of some savage beast, long, curved and
sharp enough to slice a finger with a wrong move.

name: bladed staff
descriptions: This exotic weapon consists of a four-foot shaft of hardwood
with two long, curved iron blades mounted on the ends. It
appears unwieldy but is in fact a deadly and effective
weapon when used in the right hands.

name: blades of balance
descriptions: These twin swords are exquisitely balanced and honed to a
razor-sharp edge. One is pure white, and engraved with
flowing, sinuous runes, the other is jet black and etched
with angular symbols. They cannot be wielded separately,
and in conjunction make excellent weapons.

name: bleeding main-gauche
descriptions: This long parrying knife appears to have come from some
crazed dream. Blood constantly drips from the blade and hand
guard and is a horrid sight to behold. You wonder what awful
magics are at work with this guard, and can think only one
of vile mind would think to grasp it.

name: blessed scroll
descriptions: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations
necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: blizzardfang
descriptions: This serrated dagger could easily be a sword in the hands
of a weaker person. It looks to be made of some magical ice
so cold that it would give goosebumps to anyone that wields
it.

name: blood-stained manual
descriptions: The dark stain of blood covers this wicked tome in every
page corner, and crevice. Turning each page, reveals text
more vile and grotesque then the previous. In the midst of
wicked gloats, and stomach-turning torture, a rite of
unholy power can be found.

name: blood gore
descriptions: Covering your mouth brings you little recovery as you vomit
your last meal onto the floor. Pieces of humanoid anatomy
can be seen all over this place, some whole, some sliced. A
truly disgusting spectacle, fueled by insanity or pure evil.

name: blood inscripted scroll
descriptions: Ancient dark parchment has been inscribed with unholy runes,
written with aged blood that has been caked heavily to
survive the years.

name: blood lance
descriptions: This seven-foot-long lance is coloured blood red, and is
wickedly barbed. Unholy symbols etched up and down its
length give off a smoky yellow light.

name: blood portal
descriptions: A vertical pool of blood seems to hang here, floating above
the floor with power of unknown darkness. Occasional screams
are heard as faces, twisted in agony and pain are seen. The
portal seems to arch its frame, as if grinning at you,
inviting you into its warm embrace.

name: bloodkrys
descriptions: Nearly the size of a shortsword, this weapon is permenantly
stained from the blood and gore of former victims. From the
large jagged edges along the blade it looks that it could be
easily baptised again. Under the blood you can see the black
blade has a smooth, almost bright shine to it, a long
serpentine letter wriggles under your scrutiny.

name: bloodstained broadsword
descriptions: This razor-sharp blade is over three feet in length. The
metal of the blade and hilt is a deep gray color and doesn't
look familiar. Each edge of the blade looks to be
permenently stained with blood and a single glowing crimson
rune lines the pommel.

name: bloodstained chakram
descriptions: Red stains cover this circlet of strange metal, and as you
grab it you feel an intense sense of evil. Black runes seem
to pulsate from the large circle, and you wonder what evil
deeds it has done. Much smaller then a regular sized chakram
it is small enough to use for stealthy attacks.

name: bloodstained shortsword
descriptions: This needle-pointed blade is about two feet long, and is
razor-sharp. It is made of some dark metal, and seems to be
permanently stained with blood. A red rune glows brightly
at the base of the blade.

name: bloodstone
descriptions: This small, semi-precious stone is red in colour, with
flecks and spots of blackness.

name: bloodstone orb
descriptions: This small, heavy stone orb is swirled with green and red,
and feels slightly warm to the touch. A single glowing rune
in the side pulsates with hidden power.

name: bloodstone ring
descriptions: This ring is made of four black iron bands, intertwined to
appear as if it were actually a small claw. Cradled inside
the claw is a stone the color of blood, with small flecks
of blackness that seems to swirl in its depths. For some
reason watching the swirling makes your stomach twinge and
you almost have to look away before you become dizzy.

name: bloodwood chest
descriptions: A chest that sends shivers down your spine it is a chest
made of some ancient wood that appears to be stained with
fresh blood. Foul runes are etched all along the sides
and even more archaic symbols adorn the handles and lock.

name: bloody meat cleaver
descriptions: This massive piece of cutlery has dried bloodstains covering
the thick metal blade. You can tell from the smell it hasn't
been cleaned for quiet awhile, and yet the black wood handle
appears to be freshly carved.

name: blue banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCBLUE.BAN

name: blue book
descriptions: A blue book with odd lettering on the wooden cover, you open
it and read the following...

name: blue book
descriptions: The cover of this book has a strange feel to it, as if it
were made of feathers. The wooden cover tingles at your
fingertips, and you hastily open it to the first page...

name: blue dragon boots
descriptions: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the
blue hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and
are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also
form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: blue dragon carving
descriptions: This three-foot-diameter lapis carving features a roaring
dragon's head, encircled by crackling lightning. Five odd
slots ring the carving, all but one of which are filled with
white, black, green and blue fangs.

name: blue dragon gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the
hide of a blue dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm
to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost
any attack.

name: blue dragon helm
descriptions: This is a sturdy helm of blue dragonhide, fashioned with
superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect
the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: blue dragon hide
descriptions: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon.
Blue as the sky it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes
jutting out in some spots. It seems to carry an electric
feel to it and you wonder if it could be made into some kind
of armour.

name: blue dragon leggings
descriptions: Dark blue dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings.
Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer
powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very
flexible.

name: blue dragon tunic
descriptions: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of blue dragonhide was
obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along
the back and shoulders give it almost a gleaming look.

name: blue fang
descriptions: This is a four-inch-long fang, azure blue and quite sharp.
The hair on your hand stands straight out when you hold it.

name: blue key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright blue,
you can assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: blue keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate blue keys.

name: blue pantaloons
descriptions: Bright, nearly electric, blue silk is pleated in between
vertical strips of shiney black leather. The pants are
almost an eyesore, being fairly snug at the waist and ankles
though billowing out at the legs. The silk shimmers oddly,
however, as silvery runes and tiny black diamonds have
been embedded into the cloth.

name: blue parchment deed
descriptions: A thick sheet of parchment sealed with sapphire-blue wax pressed
with the image of a fortress gate. The ink is formal and measured.
This deed grants the bearer ownership of a sizeable gang hall
with capacity for up to 900 members.

name: blue portal
descriptions: A large rectangle hangs in midair, a rippling pool of blue
light. A golden aura shines about it, little can be seen of
the other side, but there is no feeling of malevolence or
evil from the rift.

name: blue potion
descriptions: This is a small glass vial, filled with a thick, dark blue
liquid. An eye is burned into the cork.

name: blue robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: bone-handled headcutter
descriptions: This is a massive, double-handed axe with a shaft made out
of the petrified bone of some unknown creature. Its blade is
huge and heavy, and its single edge appears to be razor-
sharp.

name: bone charm
descriptions: This is a strange, yellowed bone amulet strung on a crude
string. it has unsettling symbols carved on its surface, and
it feels slightly warm in your palm.

name: bone club
descriptions: This large club has been fashioned from the rib-bone of some
mammoth beast, dead long ago. The head of the club is
covered with jagged spikes, and large protrusions that could
do a great deal of damage to its victim.

name: bone key
descriptions: This small, fragile-looking key appears to be made of bone.
It is quite cold to the touch.

name: bone leg boney
descriptions: Upon closer inspection you see the leg bone has been jammed
into a crevice in the floor, perhaps some sort of last
ditch effort to escape this place of death. The bone appears
lose enough that it could be pulled while stuck inside the
crevice, but it has been jammed so tight that it can not
be taken out of its resting place.

name: bone necklace
descriptions: Bones of all shapes are thread together by a single green
vine, tied at the back. Each one seems to rattle on their
own volition, causing you to think that they might be
imbued with some magic power.

name: bone ring
descriptions: This is a simple ring made of many small bones tied together
to form a circle. Easily fitting most fingers, an ebony
skull is imprinted upon the largest bone.

name: bone staircase
descriptions: This disturbing stair is seemingly comprised of hundreds of
bleached bones. There are bones of all types of creatures
here, including many odd, alien ones that must have come
from beasts you have never heard of. You cannot tell what
holds the staircase together, as its bewilderingly rickety
shape defies most natural laws of construction.

name: bonfire
descriptions: This huge, crackling bonfire shimmers and spits, its black
smoke rising up into the sky. A thick hunk of meat, held by
an iron spit, roasts over the flame, filling the air with
its aroma.

name: bookcase
descriptions: This bookcase is covered in full layers of dust. Once made
of maple, time has devoured it slowly, causing it to
eventually cave in, covering the tattered books that once
resided here in polished condition.

name: bookshelf
descriptions: This large, wide bookshelf is designed to hold a large
number of books of varying size.

name: boomstick
descriptions: This looks to be a twelve gauge double barreled Remington.
Very rare, it can be found in the sporting goods department.
Fashioned in Grand Rapids Michigan. It is known to be quiet
costly. The stock has been made of walnut, and the barrels
made of cobalt blue steel. The trigger looks to have a very
easy pull to it. Written up on it: "Shop Smart. Shop S-mart"

name: bottle of wine
descriptions: This is a small corked bottle of red wine. It is not of the
highest quality, but nonetheless has a slight tartness and
full flavour.

name: boulder
descriptions: This large boulder is somewhat suspiciously round, and looks
to have been carved out of the walls of the tunnel.

name: bow of silver
descriptions: angel weapon

name: brass key
descriptions: This shiny brass key has the image of a burning flame on its
handle.

name: brass knuckles
descriptions: These shining knuckles are gripped in the fist to increase
punching damage. Though they provide little protection,
they are definitely worthwhile if fists are the primary
form of attack. Used mostly by mystics, they are limited in
use to the more advanced practitioners.

name: brass lamp
descriptions: This is an ancient, heavily-etched brass lamp. It has been
polished to the point that you can see the reflection of
your face clearly in its surface. It is filled with a sweet-
smelling scented oil.

name: brass plaque
descriptions: This rectangular brass plaque has been engraved thus:
No form
No mouth with which to speak
Yet sings with a thousand voices
No legs upon which to stand
Yet runs faster than any man.

name: brass zills
descriptions: Finger-symbols, worn on the thumb and middle finger,
are used to distract and entice targets. Their strange
melodies, when used my knowing hands, infuse with the
zills' own powers to create unique effects. This particular
pair has been engraved with orchids, painted violet.

name: brick
descriptions: Searching the bricks in the fireplace, you eventually find
one whose deceptive newness is masked by dirt. It is
actually made of steel, and moves easily under your touch.

name: brigandine leggings
descriptions: This is a pair of leather pants with iron bands sewn around
them. They provide great protection, but are heavy, and make
considerable noise due to the clanking of the overlapping
bands.

name: brigandine tunic
descriptions: This is a suit of boiled leather reinforced with iron bands.
It is quite heavy, and makes noise when in use due to the
clanking of the iron bands, but provides excellent defense
in combat.

name: bright red plant
descriptions: This strange, crimson plant has many long sinuous branches,
and thick reddish roots which climb up the walls. Its five-
pointed leaves are of a shining golden colour, and it
evidently bears fruit as some are shriveled on the ground
beside it.

name: brimstone hammer
descriptions: This great sledge reeks of sulphur and ash. A massive rock,
black as night sits atop a long metal handle to make a crude
but effective cudgel. Black writing is scripted on the head
that seems to writhe and dance. The hammerhead litters ash
around your feet. You know not where this hammer came from,
but you can tell it is for immense destruction and evil.

name: broadsword
descriptions: This is similar to the longsword, but is double-edged and
is heavier. It hits hard, but is harder to wield than the
longsword.

name: bronze chakram
descriptions: A razor-sharp bronze circle, which when hurled, flies out
and returns to its wielder.  The blade is three inches wide,
with the weapon being one foot in diameter.

name: bronze statue
descriptions: This gargantuan statue of bronze stands thirty feet from
the ground. Three distinct figures have been sculpted,
one in full armour, another enshrouded by a cloak, and the
last in plain robes. Nothing else can be seen of the figures
for they have been posed with their backs facing outward.

name: bronze statue
descriptions: A statue of newly polished bronze stands before you.
Crafted in the vision of a crowned man, sitting atop a
rearing horse. He looks to be wielding a large shovel.

name: bronzewood forest
descriptions: The trees of this forest are quite large, towering far above
you, but not quite as tall as the ironwood trees. Their skin
is a dull, nonreflective bronze colour, and their leaves are
of a glossy black. They are straighter and their bark is
smoother than the other trees in this forest, and their
branches are longer and carry more leaves.

name: brown leather boots
descriptions: This is a pair of brown leather boots. They come up to the
middle of the shin, and look durable enough for long walks.
On the toe of each boots a lightning bolt has been branded.

name: bruised apple
descriptions: A semi-round fruit with spotchy red skin and slightly brown
flesh. A dry stem and small green leaf are still attached
to its crown.

name: bubbling black potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a jet black liquid,
constantly bubbles and shakes about. Its impossible to tell
the contents, but you think you see an eyeball floating
around in it. The potion is stoppered with a thick seal.

name: bubbling blue potion
descriptions: This flask rattles violently, as if the bubbling light
blue liquid were about to explode. A large iron stopper
covers the entire top of the flask.

name: buckler shield
descriptions: This is a tiny shield, mostly used in tandem with a fencing
weapon. It is light and can be moved quickly to deflect
attack, but does not provide very good protection.

name: bulletin board
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCRULES.BUL

name: burning black feather
descriptions: This feather burns darkly from a great fire. You fear as
if your skin will blister the moment your hand touches it.

name: burning key
descriptions: This key's head is shaped liked like a circled five-pointed
star. It burns your flesh to touch it, and the taint of evil
arises from it strongly.

name: burning scroll
descriptions: Reeking of sulphur, this scroll appears to be burning up,
but still the strange paper remains whole. Upon it are
written the rite of some wickedly evil prayer.

name: burning staff
descriptions: An item of myth or mystery, this staff smells as if it were
burning and yet you can see no fire. Grasping the staff
however causes your hand to almost blister from the heat
that erupts from the wood.  Lively golden symbols, scribed
into the staff, move and sway to their own beat. Abruptly
the staff begins to cool, allowing you to firmly grasp it.

name: burnt iron chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has
been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's
carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its
lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: bushes
descriptions: At first the bushes appear to dense to move through, and are
definitely too hardy to chop up. However, after some
searching, you find a small opening to the north which could
be passed through.

name: bushes
descriptions: This strange hedge seems to have been cultivated by someone.
Peering closer, an opening of some kind can be seen beneath
it!

name: cabinet
descriptions: Simple in design but otherwise pleasing to the eye, this
large cabinet has a great amount of room for storing
supplies.

name: Caladbolg
descriptions: This sword property of the ElfGod.

name: carnelian stone
descriptions: This small, semi-precious stone is dark orange in colour.

name: carrot
descriptions: This thick, bright orange root is capped with a crown of
tall, feathery green leaves. Small rootlets reach out from
around the carrot, adding to its grainy texture.

name: carved ivory mask
descriptions: This is an odd ivory face-plate, with two silken strings to
tie behind your ears to keep it in place. It has two thin
eye slits to see through, and is ornately carved with
delicate swirling designs.

name: carved statues
descriptions: These two statues flank the gate, each crafted in the form
of a tall dark-elf warrior garbed in chainmail and bearing
a long blade. Strangely, they seem somewhat warm to the
touch, almost as if life force pulsed within them.

name: carved wall face with design
descriptions: This smooth stone wall has been carved with the image of
a dancing demon, seemingly capering with glee. The carving
is about two feet in height, and is well-detailed. Even the
eyes, although they are stone, seem to glare at you evilly,
such was the skill of the craftsman!

name: cat's-eye pendant
descriptions: This small golden pendant is set with a chrysoberyl gem,
commonly referred to as a cat's eye. It is worn on a thin
gold chain, and, although quite beautiful, radiates an
unsettling aura.

name: cat-o-nine tails
descriptions: This long-handled whip has nine three-foot leather "tails"
attached to a knob at its end. Metal spikes and razors are
embedded in the lashes, and would cause immense pain to
anyone struck.

name: catoblepas eye
descriptions: This huge eyeball is about two feet in diameter, and glows
with a greenish hue. Its is fairly heavy and cumbersome.

name: cave roots
descriptions: These long, snaking roots are about an inch thick and are
greenish-yellow in colour. Their aroma is quite pleasant,
sweet and fragrant as flowers.

name: cedar rod
descriptions: This heavy cedar rod is about two feet long, and is
covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: chain coif
descriptions: This is a snugly-fitting chainmail hood, covering head and
neck. It is strong and durable, and fairly light.

name: chain gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair if elbow-length chain gauntlets, with cloth
underneath for comfort. They have a leather palm for better
weapon grip.

name: chained door
descriptions: This large wooden door is locked by a heavy iron chain,
bolted to iron loops affixed to the warehouse's walls.
Though on the surface the chains look unbreakable, they are
in fact old and somewhat rusted, and with some work and the
right tools they could be broken.

name: chained pile of bones
descriptions: Immensely thick chains clasp around a pile of bones here.
While the layers of dust speak of its untouched slumber for
many ages, closer inspection reveals something went to great
pains to break, and rebreak the bones. Undearneath it can
be seen some writing, scratched into the floor:

name: chainmail boots
descriptions: This is a pair of rigid leather boots, covered in steel
chain links. The links have been muffled, but still make it
more difficult for a person to sneak, despite this they
offer good protection in combat.

name: chainmail halter
descriptions: This is a chainmail halter-top, with cloth padding
underneath. It is worn by women wishing to be fashionable as
well as effective in combat.

name: chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This is a tunic of small interlinked iron rings, overtop of
a thin leather jacket. It is heavy, and makes some noise
when in use, but provides very good defense against attack.

name: chainmail leggings
descriptions: These leggings are made of a simple pair of cloth pants,
with linked chain-mail overtop. They provide good protection
in combat, but make some noise due to the noise they make.

name: chair
descriptions: This is a plain wooden chair, its little ornamental carving
smoothed away by much use. Its seat is likewise smoothed,
and its legs and back are nicked from being pushed into
things.

name: chameleon leggings
descriptions: You can tell by the ways the leggings change shade that they
were made from the skin of some color changing beast. They
feel extremely comfortable and look like they can afford
ample protection.

name: chaotic vortex
descriptions: Brilliant colours swirl about in midair here, as some sort
of extra-planar rift breaks the air. Energy shoots from it
violently, and the swirls seem to speed increasingly fast,
and the rift seems to widen slightly, as if it were about
to explode.

name: charred scroll
descriptions: This paper has been burned heavily and looks as though
it could turn to ash at any moment. Written carefully upon
the paper are fiery runes of power that dance and sway
in a druidic dance, revealing the translation of a spell.

name: charred spear
descriptions: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is
fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not
do great damage.

name: chipped obsidian key
descriptions: A large key fashioned from obsidian shows signs of use in
the jagged marks and scars along its edge. The teeth have
been chipped someone, and you are sure this key is totally
worthless.

name: chiseled key
descriptions: This key was chiseled from hard volcanic rock. The edges of
the handle are rough and unpolished. The key portion has
been smoothed down to fit a lock properly.

name: chrome key
descriptions: This small, shining key is made of brilliantly-reflective
metal. Etched into the end is a small, lidded eye.

name: claw glyph
descriptions: This is a carving of a cruelly-hooked, clawed hand. It is
inscribed in the centre of the marble wall, and is circled
by two concentric rings. Directly underneath the claw glyph
is a small, round button.

name: clawed gloves
descriptions: These heavy gloves are made out of stiff cloth, and they
each have three steel claws jutting off of their backs. They
are used by mystics to increase their hand-to-hand damage.

name: climbing harness
descriptions: This heavy leather harness is complete with hooks and rope.
It is used by climbers to anchor themselves while climbing,
and is invaluable when making the treacherous climbs up
mountains.

name: cloak of faith
descriptions: Devised by the first battle clerics, words of strength and
power are woven into the underside of this cape to charge a
cleric physically and spiritually in battle. Many an enemy
group has fallen to a cleric wrapped in this cloaks embrace.

name: cloth pants
descriptions: This is a pair of simple cloth leggings, with a leather belt
to cinch them up. They are light and unrestrictive, but do
not provide much in the way of defense.

name: cloth shoes
descriptions: This is a pair of light canvas shoes, with coiled rope
soles. They are not suited for action of any kind.

name: club
descriptions: This is a knob-ended piece of wood. It is generally a poor
weapon, doing decent damage but being comparatively slow.
Its main advantage is that it is readily available.

name: cobra earrings
descriptions: This is a strange pair of earrings, designed to resemble the
head of a cobra. The eyes of the snakes are made by polished
areas on the fine mithril earrings, and the fangs are made
by sharpened rubies. They attach to the ears with loops of
thin mithril wire.

name: coffin
descriptions: A plain coffin, made of thick granite. Dust is caked on
top of the coffin in a thick layer. Until now no one has
disturbed this final resting place, and as the hair on your
neck stabs you like needles, you begin to consider leaving
it be.

name: composite bow
descriptions: This long, fabulously-crafted bow is made of horn and light
wood, and is pulled taut by a gut string. The strength and
range of this bow are nearly unmatched.

name: contraption
descriptions: This is a heavy metal plate, about six inches thick and ten
by ten feet square. It is affixed to the wall here by some
unknown means. Covering its surface are many levers and
switches, buttons and knobs of all descriptions and sizes.
What the odd contraption could be for is anyone's guess.

name: copper amulet
descriptions: This small, round amulet is crudely stamped with a symbol
representing a roaring lion. It hangs on a heavy chain.

name: copper cross
descriptions: A simple cross made from copper, it has been carved with
great care and detail. It has been said that holy men hold
it in hand, to strengthen their faith in times of crisis.

name: copper key
descriptions: This is a large copper key. Its handle has an eye stamped
into it.

name: copper ore
descriptions: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of copper.
Somewhat valuable, copper is used in many everyday
applications. Before the copper can be extracted from the
ore, it must be smelted and the rock skimmed off the surface
of the metal.

name: copper ring
descriptions: This ring is made of three copper threads, meticulously
polished and lacquered, and braided together to form a band.

name: copperwood forest
descriptions: The trees of this forest are not as tall as the ironwood
trees, but they still tower far above you. Their bark is an
almost-glossy copper colour, and their leaves are shiny and
brown.

name: copperwood staff
descriptions: A piece of beautiful copperwood has been used to make this
staff. Still full of life, this staff carries a strange
numbness with it, and yet makes your skin tingle and your
hair stand on end. Various knots stick out of the staff
causing light to jump from knot to knot in random patterns.
Magic radiates from this staff with great force.

name: cosmic staff
descriptions: This long, slender staff shimmers under the glow of diffused
starlight. Glittering sparks encircling it spin about madly,
flashing brightly and emitting high-pitched noises. The
power of the cosmos is imbued within this staff, which, when
tapped, provides arcane strength.

name: cot
descriptions: Mold has ravaged this cot giving it a look of a sickly
green shade. You can tell it hasn't been used for many years
but you are unsure who would have found it comfortable at
all.

name: cotton gloves
descriptions: This is a pair of light cotton gloves, offering little
protection save from the cold.

name: crack
descriptions: There is a small crack in the wall here. Investigating it
further, you find a small button!

name: cracked obelisk
descriptions: This tall, pointed obelisk is night-black and as smooth as
glass. Intricate runes carved into its surface emanate a
strange aura of power. A large crack runs down through it,
however, and the emanation of energy fluctuates wildly,
sending prickles running along your skin.

name: cracked statue head
descriptions: The marble head or bust of a great warrior lies here
