in pieces. It looks as though it had been dropped or thrown
a great distance. Age and dust hide its guise, leaving the
tribute a mystery.

name: cracks
descriptions: Searching the table, you find a crack wide enough to put
your arm through. Looking inside, you see a sturdy iron
switch embedded deep within!

name: crane totem
descriptions: This tiny crystal statue of a crane is nearly transparent
and seems very delicate.

name: crater
descriptions: The crater is hot and blackened by the impact of whatever
meteorite crashed here. Metallic splinters litter the area,
and glitter with a strange, otherworldy light.

name: crescent moon staff
descriptions: This long, beautiful staff is crafted out of a hardwood with
a deep blue-grey colour. Carved along its length is a
winding pattern highlighted with silver. It is capped with
a silver crescent moon, the points facing outwards, which is
engraved with extremely fine letters that glitter in the
light.

name: Crest of Arlysia
descriptions: This necklace glitters has seen better days and those days
were long ago. Made of iron this crest once held some design
on it to symbolize Arlysia but now it is just a chunk of
useless metal.

name: Crest of Silvermere
descriptions: This necklace glitters brightly with its fine, crafted links
of silver. A graceful eagle of platinum spreads its wings
on the large silvery disc, signifying it the crest of the
great city town of Silvermere.

name: crested war helm
descriptions: This elaborate helmet is crafted from the lightest
high-steel, and is designed with only one thing in mind --
effectiveness in combat. Its visored face offers only a
small eyeslit to see through, and small enchanted jewels
set in the sides aid the user in combat.

name: crevice trail
descriptions: This is a narrow rocky trail passing along the bottom of a
natural crevice in the mountain. Occasionally there is a
small, but unfathomably deep crack to leap over, and often
the trail is nearly blocked by fallen rocks and rubble.
There is evidence of tracks of some sort, though the rocky
terrain makes them unidentifiable.

name: crimson-hilted morningstar
descriptions: This large, heavy weapon has a brightly enameled red hilt,
and its thick black iron chain is attached to a wickedly-
barbed ball. Crude runes have been engraved into every
surface, and it seems extremely cool to the touch.

name: crimson badge
descriptions: This fearsome-looking badge is hammered out of heavy red
metal. Crafted to ressemble a clawed fist, it is only worn
by the highest-ranking orc in a war band.

name: crimson blood robes
descriptions: The strong scent of old blood covers these robes as if it
were woven with the fabric. Perverse runes have been written
into the the hem and back of the robe, with hellish visions
and evil rites covering other parts. Wickedness radiates
from this cloth, and only such a mind could consider wearing
it.

name: crimson bracers
descriptions: These steel bracers have been lacquered a dull red. Curving
runes engraved along their length glow a faint orange, like
dim coals on a hearth. A small ruby is set in the centre of
the face of each bracer.

name: crimson chest
descriptions: This large chest has been crafted from a thick pine. Stained
a deep crimson, well-crafted designs have been carved upon
it's surface, including a large flame upon the lid.

name: crimson cloak
descriptions: This long cloak is made of fine, brilliant red silk, and is
embroidered with gold thread. A thick gold chain and clasp
hold it closed at the neck. A glittering diamond in the
clasp is engraved with a single angular rune.

name: crimson earrings
descriptions: Small crimson discs entwine around two thick adamantite
hoops.  On each disc a tiny flame insignia has been stamped.

name: crimson helm
descriptions: Fashioned from some crimson metal, this helm looks durable
enough to take on the worst punishment. It has a noseguard
fashioned from obsidian yet it does not seem to hinder
vision in the slightest. The symbol of an open flame is
stamped on the brow of the helm, the mark of its maker.

name: crimson inquisition mask
descriptions: These masks are worn by members of the Crimson Flame to hide
their identity and to intimidate prisoners put to the test
of witchcraft. This mask is composed of smooth crimson metal
and is featureless, save a pair of narrow eyeslits.

name: crimson potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering red
elixir with large bubbles floating in every direction. A
lead stopper covers the top, stopping its contents from
spilling out.

name: crimson ring
descriptions: This ring covers nearly the entire length of the inner
finger and appears to be master crafted from crimson
metal. The underside is finely textured, helping to
aid in the grip of a weapon. Set in the top is a
narrow ruby within an oval engraving much resembling
a burning flame.

name: crimson scale gauntlets
descriptions: This pair of hard leather gloves are made of some type of
black animal skin, the back of each hand has several
diamond-shaped crimson pieces of some alien metal sown into
the leather. On each piece of metal is stamped a small
flame.

name: crimson scalemail leggings
descriptions: This pair of leather pants are made of some type of
black animal skin, with diamond-shaped crimson pieces sown
around the front and back of the leather. The discs appear
to be of some type of alien metal, and each piece has a
flame stamped upon them.

name: crimson scalemail tunic
descriptions: Hundreds of crimson discs have been sewn into this suit of
armor. Each disc is of some strange metal and has been
stamped with a crimson flame. It feels lightweight but the
metal looks very strong for protection.

name: crimson shard
descriptions: This long shard of red crystal is almost blistering to touch
for it seems to possess an awesome amount of heat. Inside
the crystal you see flames dancing within, most likely
fueling the enormous heat it emits.

name: crimson spiked shield
descriptions: This is a medium sized shield has been fashioned from a
form of insect chitin. A large flame has been painted on it,
and a great spike protrudes from the center. Though heavy it
offers some protection along with dealing damage to boot.

name: crimson tankard
descriptions: This iron tankard bears the stamp of a crimson flame along
the bottom. It is almost overflowing with mulled wine.

name: crimson tome
descriptions: Crimson wood surrounds the pages of this scripture. A symbol
of a large flame adorns the cover, and it faintly smells
of incense. You open it to the first pages.

name: crocodile fang
descriptions: This sharp fang is about 3 inches in length, and half an
inch thick at the base. The tip of the tooth has been ground
smoothly from use, but the fang is still quite sharp.

name: cross key
descriptions: This heavy gold key's handle is shaped like an X. The barrel
and teeth are smooth and shiny.

name: crossbow
descriptions: This powerful weapon is comprised of a small, but extremely
powerful, metal bow affixed to a two-foot-long wooden stock.
The bow is extremely difficult to cock, making this a slow
weapon, but its steel-tipped bolts can pierce through
armour with ease. It comes with a quiver full of short,
sharp bolts.

name: crowbar
descriptions: This is a two-foot long length of iron, with a point on one
end and a hammer-like claw at the other. It is mainly used
for prying things open or for breaking chains, though it can
be used as a weapon in a pinch.

name: crown key
descriptions: This iron key's head is shaped like a flat crown, with a
cross at the very top of the head.

name: crowned spider skull
descriptions: A fearsome looking item, it looks to be the skull of a
large crowned spider. Ridges around the eye holes show where
the clusters once lay. The chitin is so sturdy it would make
an exotic, but sturdy piece of headwear to protect in
battle.

name: cruel bone greatsword
descriptions: The bone of some massive animal, this sword is immensely
heavy and hard to wield. Jagged ridges climb up either side
of the bone's sharpened edges, which could cause immense
wounds. The hilt is made of some strange, blackened metal
with the skull of some animal on the pommel.

name: crumbling bible
descriptions: This ancient religious tome has lost all of its pages, save
one which is in perfect condition. Upon this last page is
the holy incantation necessary to learn a spell to restore
flesh that has been transformed to stone by unnatural means.

name: crystal
descriptions: This piece of crystal looks newly polished and has an odd
cyan glow to it. You notice as you move closer to it, that
the glow seems to almost pulse, as if it were in time with
some heartbeat.

name: crystal ball
descriptions: As you gaze into the crystal ball, a swirly mist dissolves
and you witness what appears to be a a miraculous
underground city. Upon closer inspection, you notice that
all of its inhabitants are dwarves!

name: crystal club
descriptions: This large, heavy club is made out of a glittering,
multifaceted crystal.

name: crystal flask
descriptions: This crystal bottle is quite well crafted, and would hold a
few mouthfuls of liquid.

name: crystal gem
descriptions: Cut by the most acute eye, this gem shines brilliantly in
any light. It seems to have a bluish glow about it and
throbs quietly in your hand.

name: crystal gem
descriptions: Cut by the most acute eye, this gem shines brilliantly in
any light. It seems to have a yelloish glow about it and
throbs quietly in your hand.

name: crystal orb
descriptions: This small crystal orb is beautifully-made, and sparkles
mysteriously in the light.

name: crystal platemail
descriptions: This exotic suit of armour has apparently been made from
smoky black crystal. Runes embedded deep in its surface
give evidence of its magical origin, and pulse with a dim
green fire.

name: crystal shortsword
descriptions: This razor-edged blade is made of chiseled green crystal.
Its hilt is crafted out of black steel, and is bound with
silver cord.

name: crystal spear
descriptions: This is a four-foot-long spear made out of some glittering,
faceted crystal. It is extremely sharp, and its surface from
the head down has been smoothed and carved to provide better
grip.

name: crystal sword
descriptions: This is a light two-handed sword, made out of some
glittering multifaceted crystal. Its edges are sharpened to
the point where they could cut a hair.

name: cup of tea
descriptions: This small wooden cup is filled with a fragrant spicy tea,
whose aroma stimulates the senses.

name: cure poison potion
descriptions: This small metal flask is stopped up with a cork. Opening
it up, you see a thick violet liquid sloshing about. It
smells like sour berries, but none like you have ever
smelled before.

name: curved black dagger
descriptions: This large, thin-bladed dagger is extraordinarily heavy for
its size, and is nearly as long as a shortsword. Its blade
is heavily carved with softly glowing red runes, and there
is a decidedly evil aura surrounding it.

name: curved bone dagger
descriptions: This trully gruesome weapon, made entirely out of yellowed
bone carries a taint of pure evil. The jagged blade is very
cold to touch, and is only adorned with a single piece of
polished jet which hums faintly. Faded red stains on the
edge tell you it has been used many times to prey on
unknowing victims.

name: curved fang
descriptions: This four-inch fang belonged to some great beast of a
poisonous nature. It is black and hollow, and you can tell
that there is some liquid inside that sloshes when you
shake it.

name: curved heater
descriptions: This is a traditional knight's shield. It is not too heavy,
but is designed to deflect blows well. Its face is blank so
that a heraldric symbol or family crest may be placed on it.

name: cyclops eye
descriptions: This huge eyeball is about two feet in diameter, and glows
with a greenish hue. It is fairly heavy and cumbersome.

name: dagger
descriptions: This is a small, sharp knife, used primarily for stabbing.
It is easy to handle and to conceal, but it does minor
damage. It is completely useless against most heavy armours.

name: daikatana
descriptions: This is a large two-handed sword, five feet in length.
Though longer then a greatsword, the blade feels light and
is slightly curved. The edge glitters in the light, and the
hilt, shaped like that of a dragon's maw, tells you it was
crafted by the hands of a master.

name: dark blue orb
descriptions: This is a small, royal-blue sphere, roughly one foot in
diameter. It glows and pulses with an inner light,
practically oozing with dark power.

name: dark brown walls of stone
descriptions: These smoothed, naturally-carved walls are of a deep brown
earthy stone, mixed with the occasional darker mineral vein.
A pale green fungus or lichen covers many parts of the walls
here, and gives off a faintly acrid odour.

name: dark forest
descriptions: The forbidding forest north of Silvermere is an even more
ominous cousin of the eastern Darkwood forest. Its trees are
packed tightly together, as if suspiciously and consciously
forming a wall to keep out intruders. A sense of ancient
watchfulness pervades the air surrounding this oldest of
woods, and there appears to be no place to land at its foot.

name: dark hood
descriptions: This hood is made of some type of black velvet-like cloth.
When worn nothing can be seen of the wearer's face. Dark
blue runes annoint the brim of this hood, and you get the
feeling this item is not for the good of heart.

name: dark onyx ring
descriptions: A ring of pure blackness grasps an even darker onyx stone.
The ring is cold to touch, and seems to turn the air around
you colder still. You find putting this ring on dims your
vision, as if you were closing your eyes to sneeze and had
not yet opened them.

name: dark plated warchest
descriptions: This gigantic chest is made of a deep, black metal, that
devours all light. It looks as though it could easily weigh
more then a ton, and would be unliftable by any but a giant.
A massive lock keeps the chest safe from intrusion, however
the key has been left in the lock, easily allowing someone
to turn the key and unlock the chest.

name: dark temple key
descriptions: This heavy obsidian key is smooth and warm to the touch. Its
head is crafted in the shape of a horned skull, with glowing
rubies for eyes. The skull seems to grin at you maliciously,
and you get a feeling of disease while this is near you.

name: Darkbane
descriptions: A long slender blade crafted in a fashion long lost to
modern day. The name Darkbane is written in gold, and the
entire sword seems to glow with its own sublime divinity.
A platinum dragon, with wings outstretched, has been crafted
to be the hilt of this shining blade. It moves through the
air with a great flash of white, singing a hymn of prayer.

name: darkbone staff
descriptions: The long dark bone of some hellish beast clutches a pulsing
bloodstone at its top. Created from evil forces, sharp
pieces of bone jut from all around the staff, causing
enhanced pain for any that would be struck by its evil.
The bloodstone swirls with each pulse, dark and crimson
fluids moving in time, as if it were a beating heart.

name: darkened ironwood forest
descriptions: The trees of this forest are huge, towering skywards, their
tops unseen far above. Their bark is of a strange dull
metallic grey, the colour of iron. An aura of watchfulness
pervades this area, and while it is not overtly hostile,
you get the distinct impression you are not welcome here.

name: darkwood ring
descriptions: This polished black ring is made out of the wood of the
sturdy darkwood tree, which is known for its iron-like
strength. The ring is carved with elaborate sigils and
runes, and it radiates a faint warmth.

name: darkwood rod
descriptions: This heavy darkwood rod is about two feet long, and is
covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: darkwood shield
descriptions: This small shield is carved from the bark of an ancient
darkwood tree. It is very thick, so as to provide good
protection, but it is still much lighter than any metal
shield. A slight warmth seems to radiate from it, and its
surface almost pulses with life.

name: darkwood staff
descriptions: This is a living branch from a darkwood tree. It is warm to
the touch, and you can feel the lifeblood flowing within.
A silver sheath caps the bottom of the staff, and the centre
is carved with intricate looping designs to provide good
grip.

name: dead cat
descriptions: This is a stiff, stinking, dead cat. It once used to be a
cute little fluffy creature, but now it's dead!

name: death's shadow
descriptions: Rumored to be magically made from the shadows of the undead,
no item in existence is darker. It is said that a ninja who
owns this cloak will never go unarmed for the cloak is
hungrier for death then any owner.

name: death shroud
descriptions: This weightless death shroud barely appears to exist in this
world, fading in and out of view. The very fabric carries
the smell of death upon it, as well as a taint of supereme
evil.

name: deathblade
descriptions: This long blade is made of pure black metal and is extremely
cold to the touch. Its overpowering evil aura almost seems
to drain the life from you.

name: deathcoil
descriptions: This long, metallic whip has tiny sharp protrusions along
its length, designed to lacerate the target. Its heavy grip
is bound in a strange grey leather and it almost seems to
move with a life of its own!

name: Deathweaver
descriptions: This long blade is made of pure black metal and is extremely
cold to the touch. Underneath the shine of the weapon you
think you almost see helpless faces howling in agony.
You then notice serrations in the blade itself, almost as if
it were to drink the blood of its victims.

name: decapitated head
descriptions: The bloody head of some poor bastard stares outward with a
dead gaze. It could be any simple commoner that met this
horrid end. Blood is clotted and dried all over the neck
where it was chopped from its body with some grisly weapon.

name: deck of cards
descriptions: A simple deck of traveling cards, they have the stiffness
of cards never used before. Simple patterns adorn the backs,
while individual hand-painted pictures have been placed
with expert care on the face of each card. According to myth
card decks have been used to turn the tides of fortunes by
gypsies while traveling abroad.

name: demolished doors
descriptions: These huge steel-banded wood doors have been blasted asunder
by some fiery magic. The scorch marks appear quite fresh,
and it is probable that they have been made only recently.

name: Demon's Maw
descriptions: Rows of yellowed teeth line the blade of this hideous
greataxe. Vile symbols line the blackened obsidian haft of
the weapon, and they almost seem to reach for you. The
smell of brimstone and burnt flesh is thick from this weapon
and the heat that it radiates already cause you to perspire.
Beastly hair has been tied in knots on the handle.

name: demon's skull mask
descriptions: This mask is the skull of something hideous. Spikey
protrusions rim the eye sockets, adding to the thing's
demonic visage. The mouth is frozen into a hideously evil
grin, and its hollow black eye sockets appear to have a
reddish glow. You get a strong feeling of fear just looking
at the thing and have second thoughts about putting it on.

name: demon-carved halberd
descriptions: This hideous creation's blade is carved with all manner of
grotesquely-leering demonic faces. Its heavy edge is sharp
as a razor, and its thick haft is intricately carved to
resemble intertwined limbs.

name: demonhide bracers
descriptions: These deep red bracers are crafted out of the black-spined
skin of a demon. They are tough and form-fitting. On the
inside wrist of each bracer, a glowing blue symbol of the
Kai Lords is emblazoned.

name: demonhide sandals
descriptions: These blood red sandals are crafted out of the black-spined
skin of a demon. They are tough and thick-soled. On the
heel of each sandal, a glowing blue symbol of the
Kai Lords is emblazoned.

name: demonic pitchfork
descriptions: This long, nightblack two-tined pitchfork radiates an aura
of palpable evil. The shaft's metallic surface is engraved
with all manner of twisted, hideous faces. The three teeth
at the end are curved and sharp as demon's horns, the middle
tooth being the longest.

name: Demonslayer
descriptions: This is similar to the longsword, but is double-edged and
is heavier. The blade is made of some strange crimson metal,
that almost seems to dull your sense to touch. The hilt is
fashioned from silver, with a single crimson flame stamped
on the pommel.

name: Demontongue
descriptions: This long whip is alight with unholy fire. Crafted from
the skin of some underworld beast, spikes jut from the
entire length of the whip, each one bearing a tiny wisp of
a dark red flame. A massive cluster of spikes and beastly
fangs end the dark weapon, surely causing suffering to any
victim that it was used upon.

name: dented soup can
descriptions: This can has been crafted by some mechanical technique not
known to you. It has a large dent on one side, which
although brusies the can itself the can still holds a full
eight ounces of soup, just as it did before the dent.

name: dented wizard's hat
descriptions: This pointed hat is decades old, and from the dirt you
wonder if it has ever been washed. Despite the grime you
see many stars and magic runes running along it's length
and along the brim. You note some of the stains would
indicate the last owner had befallen tragedy.

name: desk
descriptions: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from
a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside
mansions of the rich.

name: diamond
descriptions: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering
blue-white in colour, and is highly prized for use in
jewelry.

name: diamond
descriptions: This large, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering
blue-white in colour, and is highly prized for use in
jewelry. Its beauty is only marred by the branding of the
letter "N" that has been burnt onto its surface.

name: diamond-encrusted bracelet
descriptions: Beautiful diamonds surround a metal band to create a
gorgeous bracelet of incredible splendor. It glitters
brightly, almost blinding you. No inscription or insignia
can be found anywhere on the arm-wear.

name: diamond-studded ring
descriptions: This is a small, fragile-looking silver band with evenly-
spaced diamond studs placed around its circumference.
Impossibly tiny runes inlaid with mithril glitter brightly
when exposed to light.

name: diamond earrings
descriptions: These tiny diamonds are set into a thin gold backing. They
sparkle brightly without catching the light, and give off a
humming sound so soft that you can barely hear it even while
wearing them.

name: diamond emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCDIAM.EMB

name: diamond longsword
descriptions: A long blade of a single cut diamond shines brightly with
an inner light. You are basked with a holy glow as you gaze
along the holy prayers inscripted along the three foot long
blade. platinum has been forged to form the hilt of this
sword. A sunburst of gold is drawn masterfully on the
pommel.

name: diamond pedestal
descriptions: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor.
Fashioned from some of the finest cut diamonds you have yet
seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is
amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the
structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a
diamond of large size to close the gap.

name: diamond scimitar
descriptions: You see a magnificent weapon of platinum and diamond. The
single cut of diamond is three and a half feet long, and
slightly curved. The blade is razor-sharp with silver runes
scripted by some priest or saint to show this blade as holy.
The hilt is platinum with a sunburst of gold as the pommel.

name: diamond willow staff
descriptions: Whoever created this staff had great crafting skill. It is
taller than most men and is the color of old Ivory with
veins of ebony. Where the veins swirl together in knots
you notice the staff looking back at you. There are hidden
in the wood the eyes of many creatures, you recognize
owl and hawk, lion and wolf, bat rat and mouse among

name: dirty obsidian key
descriptions: A large key fashioned from obsidian has been caked with dust
from its lack of use. You blow some of the dust away and
realize some of the teeth have been blown away with it. The
key appears to be totally worthless.

name: dirty parchment
descriptions: Inscribed on this parchment is a crude map, with sprawling
text in a child-like hand:

name: disfigured statue
descriptions: Once a beautiful sculpture, claws and other markings have
mutilated this statue beyond any recognition of what it was.
You can clearly see it once had limbs, but those have been
severed long ago, leaving the marble to slowly crumble and
further rot. As you seem to get closer to the statue your
ears pick up the sound of agonized screams.

name: displacer beast tentacle
descriptions: This is the jet-black severed tentacle of a displacer beast.
A mass of bony spikes protrude from the end, and it looks as
though it would make an effective weapon.

name: displacer fur cloak
descriptions: The skin of a displacer beast, fashioned into a warm cloak.
Magic of the creature has not left since it's death so the
wearer will appear like a fleeting cat, always one step away
from harm. A very powerful piece of magic.

name: door
descriptions: This large darkwood door is carved with elaborate swirling
patterns and sigils. A silvery doorplate set in the upper
middle of the door bears a single rune of warning.

name: door with puzzle lock
descriptions: This ingenious puzzle lock is crafted in such a cunning
manner that it would require a great intellect to solve it,
if the solution was not already known. No keyhole can be
seen to open the door, so solving the puzzle is necessary
to continue.

name: double-terminated quartz
descriptions: This is a six-inch piece of clouded quartz. It shines when
light strikes it, refracting off of its many facets.

name: double crossbow
descriptions: This strange contraption appears to be a heavy crossbow with
two bows, one on top of the stock, the other on the bottom!
The bolts are held in an ingenious auto-reloading magazine,
which must be reloaded every so often. Cocking both bows and
reloading the magazine makes re-arming this weapon fairly
slow, but the firing of it is quick as lightning.

name: dragon carving
descriptions: This three-foot-diameter granite carving features a roaring
dragon's head, encircled by double lines. Five odd curved
slots ring the carving.

name: dragon fang
descriptions: This razor-sharp fang is about 12 inches in length.
It glistens brightly in the light.  With enough
strength it could tear through flesh and metal alike.

name: dragon key
descriptions: This odd key has a head shaped like the visage of a toothily
grinning dragon. The barrel and teeth of the key are of a
black metal, and set in the barrel are five tiny stones, one
each of blue, red, green, black and white.

name: dragon totem
descriptions: This small statue of a dragon is made from lava rock and
seems to drain the energy from your hand.

name: dragonclaw staff
descriptions: This four-foot-long staff is crafted from pure adamantite.
Its slender shaft has been generously engraved with symbols
of power. Upon one end a small dragon's claw has been
affixed, an orb of polished sapphire in its grasp. Deep
within the orb, blue flashes spark occasionally.

name: dragonfang ninjato
descriptions: A magnificent one-handed sword. It is slightly curved with
a dangerous edge. The blade radiates a spectrum. It is
colored oddly, red, blue, green and black, all blending to
form an intricate design. The hilt is fashioned to make it
appear as if the ninjato was the breath of a dragon, mouth
agape.

name: dragonscale armour
descriptions: Gleaming with a permanent polish, dragonscale armour is
highly-ranked in its worth. The overlapping dragon scales
provide nearly-unsurpassed protection, making many other
suits of armour seem almost useless in comparison.

name: dragontooth trident
descriptions: This long, heavy, two-handed trident's shaft is made from
a single piece of witchwood, known to amplify the power of
spells cast into it. Its wicked-looking head consists of
three-forearm-length dragon's teeth, naturally as sharp as
razors and as strong as steel.

name: Draka's Blade
descriptions: This broadsword is crafted from rare black metal.  The blade
itself appears to have lost its luster but its edge gleams
due to the sharpness of it. Etched into its simple handle
is the name "Draka", obviously it's original owner.
Thoughts of great and mighty deeds flash in your mind as you
heft the weapon.

name: dresser
descriptions: This nicely-carved dresser has three drawers for holding
clothing, and is carved out of a nice light pine wood.

name: dunce cap
descriptions: this item reserved for jinx...I got your tricorne right here

name: Dusk
descriptions: A long spear fashioned from a glittering metal, it seems to
have a black aura about it, but you sense no evil. Marked on
the spear is a symbol of a full moon, fashioned in dark blue
metal. Great power radiates from the weapon, and it seems
to dim everything around you.

name: dusty papyrus
descriptions: Through the immense layers of dust that have taken residence
upon this paper you can barely make out the following...

name: dusty tricorne
descriptions: Dusty, black felt has been shaped into a wide cone, its
brims folded up and pinched at three corners. A faded,
white plume boasts out from the rear brim, for grand
display. Occasionally the faint, ethereal image of a
skull and crossbones pearlizes along the face of the cap.

name: dwarven-craft hammer
descriptions: This heavy, two-handed hammer is imbued with powerful
striking magics. It is used by the elite dwarven smiths to
craft the most precious of metals -- mithril. These hammers
are the only things that have the power to craft mithril,
and consequently make incredible weapons in battle; however,
they are lacking greatly in accuracy.

name: dwarven ale
descriptions: This is a large, heavy wooden mug filled with the strongest
alcohol known in the realm-- dwarven mushroom ale. It has
a bitter bite to it, and easily knocks non-dwarves off of
their feet.

name: dwarven axe
descriptions: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single
blade shaped like a half moon. Well-balanced and durable, it
is a fine example of the fact that daily dwarven handiwork
greatly surpasses most works of masters of other races.

name: dwarven chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This heavy suit of chainmail is a product of the masterful
skill of the dwarves. Made of two thin layers of tiny, but
unbelievably strong, rings, it provides a level of protectio
seldom seen in light armours.

name: dwarven hammer
descriptions: This light hammer has a rectangular head of the finest
dwarf-iron. It is easy to swing yet hits hard, and would
make an excellent weapon.

name: dwarven work boots
descriptions: These heavy leather boots are reinforced with steel bands,
and have heavy metal caps on the toes. They are of sturdy
dwarven manufacture, meant for durability and toughness --
ugly, but effective.

name: dynamite longbow
descriptions: This slender, curved bow is made out of a long branch of
supple wood. It is tightly-strung, and has a fair amount of
stopping power. Its pull is a little heavy, but it makes for
a good, accurate weapon. It comes with a quiver full of
black-feathered arrows.

name: eagle helm
descriptions: This fine steel helm is crafted to look like an eagle's
head. The beak is short, curved, and sharp, and the feathers
are engraved into the surface of the helm with remarkable
workmanship. The eagle's black eyes are of glossy stone.

name: ebony greataxe
descriptions: This large crystalline greataxe absorbs all light like a
hole in space. It is extremely cold to the touch, and is
surrounded with a sinister aura.

name: ebony kris
descriptions: This wavy-bladed dagger is nearly the size of a shortsword,
and is extremely sharp. Its blade is coated with a dripping
black ichor, which steams and foams when it hits the ground.

name: ebony ninjato
descriptions: This straight singled-edged blade is made out of some
strange black metal. Its hilt is forged into the shape of a
black panther with glowing amber stones for eyes.

name: ebony scroll
descriptions: Bound in bright crimson string this parchment of night
seems dull and unremarkable, letting loose the string you
read..

name: ebony triangle
descriptions: This is a triangular piece of ebony so black that it almost
appears to be a rip in space. It is inverted so that it
points toward the ground. A golden sun adorns the bottom-
most point, a silvery-white crescent moon is in the top left
corner, and in the top right corner is a seven-pointed star
of blue-tinged silver.

name: elevated rocky ledge
descriptions: It is hard to tell whether or not this stone ledge is
natural or has been crafted, as its shape appears normal but
has an unnatural symmetry to it. A few small "steps" lead
up to it from the cavern floor, and end in front of the
carved wall face.

name: elf-head
descriptions: This bloody head once belonged to a forest-loving wood-elf.
Now its blue tongue lolls grotesquely, its sightless eyes
staring out blankly in death.

name: elven boots
descriptions: These well-made boots are crafted from some soft, but
extremely durable leather. They come up past the knee, and
are normally folded over at the tops. Such boots are said to
aid a person in the arts of stalking.

name: elven cloak
descriptions: This lightweight cloak is made of a smooth, close-knit
cloth. It shifts and shimmers, and blends into the
surroundings, helping the wearer avoid detection. A small
silver clasp in the shape of a leaf holds it closed at the
throat.

name: elven harp
descriptions: This exquisite golden harp is crafted with intricate
swirling patterns. Its strings are fine and well-strung,
and the melody that it plays when its strings are plucked
is heavenly.

name: elven longbow
descriptions: This beautifully-made longbow appears to be made of
glowing Bronzewood, a sure sign of Elven origin. Graceful
runes have been carved along its length, and it's string
hums vibrantly as you pull it with ease. A quiver of green
accompanies the bow, full of silver-feathered arrows, eager
for use.

name: elven war-spear
descriptions: This magnificent spear has a three-foot-long shaft of pale
white wood as hard as steel. Its razor-sharp head is leaf-
shaped, and could cut a hair lengthwise. It is used by
grasping the centre of the shaft with one hand, and the butt
with the other, giving excellent maneuverability and
accuracy. This is a favourite of the elven hunters.

name: elven waybread
descriptions: This delicious-smelling cake is wrapped in the golden leaves
of the silverwood tree. Light, tasty and filling, they make
ideal rations for adventurers.

name: embroidered black gauntlets
descriptions: These heavy gauntlets seem to be made of some dull black
leather. They are stitched with heavy black thread, and
unholy symbols are stitched on their backs.

name: emerald
descriptions: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering
green in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry.

name: emerald-hilted rapier
descriptions: This long, diamond-bladed rapier sparkles endlessly, causing
you to fall into a slight daze. Its hilt, gleaming with
emeralds, emits a faint green glowing aura. Examining the
blade closer you realize that it is razor sharp and you
notice the words "Lord Chance Nifield" engraved upon its
pommel.

name: emerald-studded bracelet
descriptions: Crafted of adamantite, and studded with large emeralds, this
bracelet was crafted by someone of great skill. Each emerald
seems to glow with an inner light, giving the bracelet a
life of its own.

name: emerald-tipped crozier
descriptions: This long cherrywood staff has been polished to a mirror
shine and gilded with elaborate designs along its length.
At its end, an emerald curl glitters and shines in the the
light. This holy weapon allows a priest to channel divine
intervention from his or her god!

name: emerald emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCEMERA.EMB

name: enchanted dagger
descriptions: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly
bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and
is both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: enigma gloves
descriptions: Several pieces of coloured, stiff, cloth have been wrapped
to form a pair of myriad gloves. The straps have been
shaped in bizarre patterns that almost seem to throw you
into a rapture. On each glove, the symbol of the Kai Lords
glows a bright crimson.

name: enigma sandals
descriptions: Several pieces of coloured, stiff, cloth have been wrapped
to form a pair of myriad sandals. The straps have been
shaped in bizarre patterns that almost seem to throw you
into a rapture. On the heel of each sandal the symbol of the
Kai Lords glows a bright crimson.

name: etched adamant broadsword
descriptions: This double-edged blade has been fashioned from adamant with
masterful hands. The edge is very sharp and seems to move
with great agility. Etched on the base of the blade are the
ancient words "Morte o Mau".  No signs of magic are evident
on this blade, from the blade to the leather that binds
the hilt, or the pommel ends in a simple silver ball.

name: etched adamant greatsword
descriptions: This massive sword can only be handled with two hands and
could easily cleave a man in half. Crafted from fine adamant
the blade has been sharpened to a keen edge. Carved with
care on the base of the blade are the words "Perdere Magia".
The hilt has been covered with rigid leather, and the pommel
fashioned in the image of a star.

name: etched adamant warhammer
descriptions: This long-shafted warhammer has been crafted of purest
adamant. The only markings are carved into the hammers head,
"Destrua o Magia". The silvery hammer moves with great speed
and can still deliver a crushing blow, knocking its oppenent
to the ground. The long shaft of the hammer ends with a
flame carved on the bottom, painted a bright crimson.

name: Eternal Fire
descriptions: This flaming ball burns with a bright, warm light that
doesn't harm but is warm and comforting. Its radiance
penetrates into every dark corner, and lifts the spirits
just to see it.

name: ethereal amulet
descriptions: This is a smoky piece of glass hung on a thin silvery chain.
Some small, dark-coloured object is set in the centre of
the glass, and radiates an eerie, shifting aura.

name: ethereal chakram
descriptions: This circle is made of some strange glass-like material,
with strange smokey runes radiating from its edges. As you
look at the circlet closer it seems like some shifting cloud
is inside.

name: ethereal dagger
descriptions: Made of some smoking, glass-like, material this dagger is
almost weightless to hold. Cold to touch it almost leaves a
misty trail through the air. Glittering with a deadly gleam
this supernatural weapon could become useful.

name: ethereal sabre
descriptions: Smoking black glass make up the blade of this other-worldly
weapon. A strange silver metal forms the hilt and a single
grinning skull is the pommel. It weaves through the air
leaving a trail of smoke behind, and it seems very sharp.

name: executioner's hood
descriptions: A massive black hood, wrought of black cloth. It is used
fully hide the face of anyone wearing it so they made commit
murderous deeds with their identity secret. Two narrow slits
are the only openings and a vile rune, stitched with some
glittering black thread, sits atop the crown of the death
mask. Only one of evil intentions would consider this hood.

name: eye of the beholder
descriptions: This large globular eye radiates anti-magic intensely. It is
somewhat heavy, and gives you the creeps as it stares
lifelessly at you.

name: eye socket
descriptions: At first nothing can be seen when looking into the empty
socket, but as you gaze more into the gaping blackness, a
small grey circle can be seen. Deep within the recesses you
see a button.

name: eye socket
descriptions: This is a dark eye socket in the face of the carved skull.
Hidden inside is a large stone button!

name: faded shawl
descriptions: This is an ancient piece of cloth with holes almost showing
in spots. Once brightly colored with checkers of green and
brown it has seen decades of use and wear. It gives very
little protection and you wonder if it could be of any use
at all.

name: faith keeper
descriptions: A cape reserved for the most zealous missionaries. It is
told to bring help to those troubled by the beasts and
hardships of the road, in times of need it can bring the
wearer into a zealous frenzy to keep faith in the wayward
heathens. It is a pure white cloth, with a sun emblazoned
brightly on the back, and a platinum star for the clasp.

name: falchion
descriptions: This is an end-heavy sword, with a slight forward curve. It
is large and heavy, and does considerable damage in combat.
It is a little unwieldly and slow.

name: fangblade
descriptions: Made from the tooth of a giant viper and crafted by a master
weaponsmith, few weapons are the equal to its elegance and
deadliness. Bone white with a jewel encrusted pommel it
seems as though it has a mind of its own and helps to guide
its weilder to draw blood.

name: farming hoe
descriptions: A six foot long wooden pole attaches to a flat metal blade
to form this implement of soil destruction. A simple
farming tool, it can be used for a weapon in a pinch.

name: feather-tipped hat
descriptions: A hat made from some rich, fine leather, it is the color
of royal purple. A smooth silk band encricles the hat,
keeping a bright, flamboyant, feather in place. Trying to
identify the color of the feather only makes your head hurt
as it seems to be constantly changing colors through the
entire spectrum.

name: feathered key
descriptions: The hard thick shafts of bird's feathers have been shaped
into the odd semblance of a key. There are no strings or
glue, and you can only assume they are held together by
magic.

name: Feyr
descriptions: A fearsome greatsword, it would require massive power to
wield. Kissed with black fire, it shines as if it were made
of darkest onyx. The hilt is fashioned from a blue metal,
with the word "Feyr" inscripted along the handle. A horrid
decoration is upon the pommel, that of a baleful eye, full
of hate and evil.

name: filthy nests
descriptions: These nests are extremely disgusting and dirty, being filled
with rotting meat, debris, and various worthless odds and
ends. Bits of bone and leather are scattered about, as well
as broken pieces of weapons and armour.

name: fine breastplate
descriptions: This marvellously-crafted breastplate is made of the finest
tempered steel, designed to be light and extremely strong.
It is the armour of choice for many knights and heavy
footmen.

name: fine broadsword
descriptions: This is an extremely well-crafted blade of high steel. Its
apparent age has not affected its condition, and it still
holds a sharp edge.

name: fine chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This exquisite chainmail shirt is crafted from the finest
high-steel. Painstaking work has gone into its shining
interlinked rings. It would provide good protection from
blows in combat.

name: fine greatsword
descriptions: This heavy, two-handed sword has an extremely sharp four-
foot blade that can punch through even the heaviest armour
with ease. It is made from high steel and is commonly seen
in the possession of high ranking officers.

name: fine mace
descriptions: This sturdy weapon is crafted out of high-steel, and has
been fashioned in such a way that it is excellently
balanced. This allows for heavier hitting with no reduction
in speed.

name: fine platinum chain
descriptions: This is a long, extremely thin chain of brilliant platinum.
Gold thread is intertwined in between the shining links.
This type of chain is commonly worn wrapped about the waist
by wealthy women.

name: fine silvery broadsword
descriptions: This is an extremely well-crafted blade of a strong,
brilliantly shining metal. It appears to be razor-sharp, and
is surprisingly light for its size. Its wide blade is
engraved with sinuous runes up half its length. The straight
hilt and crossguards are inset with gold and small jewels.

name: fine throwing knife
descriptions: This well-balanced, razor-sharp blade makes a formidable
weapon at short range. It is both accurate and damaging in
the hands of an expert.

name: fingerbone bracelet
descriptions: This is a simple leather thong strung with fingerbones from
various races... some very familiar. The bones are carved
with crude shamanistic runes.

name: fingerbone key
descriptions: This small, fragile-looking key appears to be made of bone.

name: fire opal
descriptions: This small gem is a fiery red in colour, and glitters in the
light.

name: firebrand cape
descriptions: Worn by paladins of all faiths during the Great Wars,
these bright red cloaks acted as beacons signifying a person
looking for a honorable duel to the death. Tales of clashes
between armoured juggernatus wearing these cloaks abound
through the songs and tales told by bards.

name: firepit
descriptions: A large circular pit of flame sits here, surrounded by
stone. A magical blaze licks at the air above it, causing
waves of immense heat to blast anything that would come
near it.

name: fireplace
descriptions: This large stone fireplace is covered in soot, and holds a
bubbling cauldron full of a rank-smelling stew. The fire is
burning some of the evil-looking weeds taken from the
garden outside, and they give off a greasy black smoke that
makes you gag.

name: fireplace
descriptions: This squat, gaping fireplace is completely blackened with
soot. A large iron hook hangs inside for a pot which isn't
there, and the bricks which it is made of are beginning to
crumble and fall out.

name: fist glyph
descriptions: This is an image of a mailed, clenched fist carved into the
wall. It is surrounded by a pair of concentric circles. One
of the circles appears to be outlined, as though it were a
button carved into the glyph.

name: flail
descriptions: This is a large, two-handed morning star. It is heavy and
extremely damaging, as well as being slow and poor on the
defensive side. It is a good weapon for brawny warriors who
prefer blunt weapons.

name: flail of oblivion
descriptions: This heavy flail sports eight whirling, spiked heads. It is
made from a light silvery metal, which gleams with a
brilliant shine. The vortex flail can be swung with blinding
speed for its size, its multiple heads spinning in deadly
arcs. Each spiked head has the marking of a crimson skull.

name: flamberge
descriptions: This is a medium-sized, wavy-bladed greatsword. It is
lighter and faster than a conventional greatsword, and
inflicts less damage. It is still extremely effective in
combat, however.

name: flame glyph
descriptions: This is a carving of a stylized flame, surrounded by two
concentric rings. Directly underneath it is a small round
button.

name: Flamemasher
descriptions: A large hammer, magically fashioned from hot magma with a
black steel handle. The magma is shaped like the head of
a massive warhammer, waves of blistering heat flow from the
hammer. A set of black and white scales are the only
markings on this weapon.

name: flametongue
descriptions: This long, needle-pointed blade is made of shining high
steel. Its hilt is carved obsidian, and is inlayed with
small rubies. When drawn, the blade bursts into flame,
burning those whom it hits.

name: flaming portal
descriptions: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic
power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving
you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure
death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty
heroes.

name: flaming scimitar
descriptions: This metal of alien origin projects an intense, magical
flame. The curved blade sprouts from an obsidian hilt, which
is strangely cool to touch. A single ruby set in the pommel

name: flaming star
descriptions: This strange object appears to be a piece of magical fire,
fashioned into a four pointed star. The heat is intense from
this weapon, and it looks as though it would make a deadly
projectile weapon.

name: flat black tome
descriptions: This large black book appears to be almost fake, as it does
not appear to have any pages. Upon closer inspection, you
discover a switch.

name: flowery apron
descriptions: A garment, fastened around the waist in the back, worn over
the lower front of the body to protect clothing. The fabric
is embroidered with tiny flowers around the edges, and the
letters "W.W." boldy read from the bottom right corner.

name: fluked trident
descriptions: This large spear-like weapon has small ridges along the
shaft and in the three prongs that form the head. On closer
inspection, it appears that small holes, long and thin were
forged into this weapon to decrease weight and improve
balance.

name: folds of worship
descriptions: Cloth lighter then the sheerist silk, these cloaks are
rumored to be from the robes of the gods themselves wore
when they walked the lands. Merely wearing these poweful
artifacts is said to bring you much closer to the greater
powers.

name: forgotten scroll
descriptions: Detailed upon this ancient, rotting leather parchment is a
form of divine incantation. It provides the chants required
to draw power from the forgotten gods, allowing you to
sacrifice your health to benefit another.

name: fountain
descriptions: This beautiful alabaster fountain gleams in the light. It is
carved to ressemble the arched neck and head of a dragon,
and it spews water into a large circular dish in the form of
a clamshell.

name: frost sceptre
descriptions: This heavy glass sceptre feels as cold as ice. Its broad,
flat head is engraved with a single, brightly glowing rune.
The handle is wrapped in white leather, and a thong hangs
from the pommel.

name: Frosthand
descriptions: Your bones chill merely gazing at this instrument of
destruction. Almost clear it is a large mace fashioned from
ice. Gold runes are chipped into the ice, deep under the
surface of the galacial globe. Fashioned around the rod of
cold is a piece of leather wrapped around it so that one
may hold the weapon without immediate frostbite.

name: frothing brown potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a disgusting brown
liquid. The cork barely keeps the vile smell from your
nostrils and you are caused to think that perhaps this
is some stool sample instead of anything magical.

name: frothing pink potion
descriptions: This fragile glass vial is filled with a pale pink elixir.
The liquid is bubbling and churning up white foam. Three
lines are stamped into the cork.

name: frozen giant
descriptions: This thirty-foot-tall giant is encased in a living tomb of
ice three feet thick. His massively-muscled arms are frozen
reaching out as if grasping at something, and his face is
fixed in an outraged frown.

name: frozen hydra
descriptions: This huge, seven-headed beast is covered in a three-foot-
thick prison of ice, its snarling visage forever frozen. It
appears heavily armoured and armed, its teeth being long and
swordlike, its necks long and agile. Gripped in one of its
mouths is a large, glittering icy hammer, maul-sized for
someone of human stature.

name: frozen orb
descriptions: This large orb of solid ice makes your teeth almost chatter
with its glacial aura. Oddly you see faint crimson writing
around it, which looks similar to druidic script.

name: frozen shard
descriptions: This is a triangular shaped piece of magical ice.
Occasionally when an ice golem dies, it shatters and yeilds
shards. This piece is about a foot in length and an inch in
diameter. You are forced to handle it carefully so the
edges don't slice your hand open.

name: full plate corselet
descriptions: This is a heavy platemail corselet, with a chainmail vest
underneath. It is so heavy you can barely pick it up, and it
clangs noisily when moved, but it is nearly unsurpassed in
the protection it provides in combat.

name: full plate leggings
descriptions: This is pair of heavy plate greaves, with chainmail
underneath and at the joints. They are extremely heavy and
noisy, but provide excellent protection.

name: fungus walls
descriptions: What you can see of the walls, they appear to be made of
light grey stone. However, most of it is covered with great
patches of mold and fungus.

name: fur-lined pouch
descriptions: This pouch fastens around your waist like a belt, except
it's two sizes too big.  Upon opening you see many bits of
bone, wood and herb inside, it obviously belongs to someone
schooled in witch doctoring.

name: fur boots
descriptions: These boots are made from a thick white pelt, that feels
almost like velvet. Thick and very durable, they reach to
the knee. Warm and snug they would allow one to traverse
wintery conditions.

name: fur cloak
descriptions: This large cloak is made from a thick white pelt that feels
like velvet. It is thick and durable, but also heavy. The
cloak was hand crafted by villagers living near a snow
topped mountain range and designed to provide extra
protection from the elements in winter.

name: fur gloves
descriptions: The insides of these gloves are tanned to a soft and
supple consistency, to allow freedom of movement for
your fingers. The velvety white hair on the outside
has been cut short enough to allow more dexterous
movements, while still being thick enough to provide
protection from the climate.

name: gambling sign
descriptions: Play Dragon's Dice or Crowns and Skulls for lower wages,
or ask for a fortune by the gypsy girl here!

name: gargantuan stone maul
descriptions: This looks like a gigantic rock with a metal shaft coming
out of it.  The head is two feet in diameter, and is very
heavy.  It is so massive you have a hard time lifting it off
the ground.  You try a couple of practice swings and the
weight almost takes your arms off.

name: garnet
descriptions: This small, precious stone is clear and deep red in colour.

name: gate key
descriptions: This simple key is fashioned of a strange black metal.
Impossibly tiny teeth line both sides of it, suggesting an
incredibly-complex locking mechanism. For some reason, you
get a sick feeling in the pit of your stomach and want to
dispose of the key quickly.

name: gauntlets of power
descriptions: These heavy plate gauntlets are made of strong black iron.
Engraved in the centre of the back of each gauntlet is a
glowing yellow rune.

name: gavel of justice
descriptions: This weapon is surrounded by a faint holy aura. Made
entirely of platinum from handle to hammer-heads, it has
been fashioned to appear like that of a massive gavel.
Symbols of justice are etched on each head.

name: giant apparatus
descriptions: This massive steel and glass device appears to process a
fluid which flows into it from a huge wooden vat. Noxious
clouds of yellow fumes puff out occasionally, filling the
air with a deadly reek.

name: giant crab shell
descriptions: This chitinous shell looks to be well worn. Dents and scuffs
scar the surface, but it still seems very well suited for
protective purposes.

name: giant pearl
descriptions: This pearl is large enough to take both your hands to lift.
It's not necessarily heavy, but awkward to lift. The
milky-white color reflects rainbow colors in the light.

name: giant spiked collar
descriptions: This collar is crafted from hard leather and appears to have
belonged to some giant animal. On its lowest fastening, you
think you could probably make it fit. Its sharp spikes are
wickedly curved, and anyone wearing this would definitely
look cruel and menacing.

name: gianthair vest
descriptions: This is a thick padded vest made of giant's hair. Giant hair
is widely used in the making of ropes and is used in the
construction of many armours, as it is tough and durable.
A vest made of giant hair is both protective and light, and
provides protection from the elements.

name: giantwood club
descriptions: This was obviously a tree branch of some thousand year old
tree before it was fashioned into a rough club.  It is
gigantic in size and would have to have belonged to a huge
monster. It is six feet in length, you could barely lift it
yourself, however you can tell anything struck with this
would have to take a step back or be flattened.

name: gilded robes
descriptions: These gorgeous robes are made out of glittering cloth of
gold, and have golden buttons and trim. Small glowing runes
are etched into the collar.

name: glaive
descriptions: This is a heavy blade mounted on the end of a six-foot pole.
It is only bladed on one side, and is used with a harsh
chopping motion. It is slow and clumsy, but does very good
damage.

name: glass jug
descriptions: A large clear container, bowled out at the center and
funneling to a thin nozzle at the top. A small brown cork
is stuck in the nozzle.

name: glass key
descriptions: This two-pronged glass key emits a faint magical aura.

name: glass mirror
descriptions: This is a circular glass mirror, set in a carved wooden
frame. It is a fairly common sight, and one can be found in
nearly every maiden's possession.

name: glass orb
descriptions: This small glass orb is beautifully-made, and sparkles
mysteriously in the light.

name: gleaming contraption
descriptions: This large, box-like object gleams like polished silver,
greatly in contrast to the surrounding junk. There is a wide
opening in the front, the High Guild of Magery's seal on one
side, and a plaque covered with instructions on the other.

name: gleaming dagger
descriptions: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly
bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and
is both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: gleaming shard
descriptions: This long, straight shard glitters with an otherworldly
bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and
it both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: gleaming steel device
descriptions: This shiny metal contraption is smooth and seamless. Its
myriad parts fit together bewilderingly, so that you do not
know where one part begins and the next ends. You have never
seen anything like it. Its tall, pillar-like shape is broken
by three dark slots spaced evenly about its surface. A faint
hum comes from within, and it is slightly warm to the touch.

name: glowing broadsword
descriptions: This beautifully-crafted broadsword is honed to a razor-
sharp edge. Silvery runes etched along its blade glow
softly.

name: glowing crystal flask
descriptions: This small crystal bottle is filled with some sort of slowly
bubbling green liquid.

name: glowing key
descriptions: This small key is slightly translucent, and has no teeth or
lock interface whatsoever. Circular runes are carved around
the small head, and the key glows from within with a pale
blue light.

name: glowing pearl
descriptions: Suprisingly heavy for such a small object, this pearl
radiates a light from within.

name: glowing red amulet
descriptions: This heavy iron amulet is surrounded by a dull red glow. It
is inset with rubies and is carved in the shape of a black
sun. It hangs upon a fine chain of black metal, and seems
warm to the touch.

name: glowing ruby
descriptions: This is a perfect, head-sized star ruby, the likes of which
you have never seen before. You cannot even begin to imagine
its worth. It glows with a pulsing inner light, seeming to
throb in time with your heartbeat. It alone is cool within
this searing heat, and it seems to beckon to you, its
shimmering glow a call for your touch.

name: glowing vine
descriptions: This is roughly a six foot length of thick jungle vine.
These plants grow near the Tasloi village and have a soft
glow about them. You recognize that the tasloi nets are
probably crafted from these vines. The material is sturdy
and could be used for a number of purposes.

name: glowing warhammer
descriptions: This large, one-handed warhammer shines with a soft blue
glow. It appears to be made of a dark metal, and although
looks heavy is in fact quite easy to swing. Its flat, broad
head is ornately carved with sigils of power.

name: gnarled wand
descriptions: This foot-long wand seems to be made out of a blackened oak,
its length filled with twisting convolutions. Carved in the
side of the wand in a crude, jagged script is the word
"Shirzak".

name: gnomish fish-helm
descriptions: This strangely-crafted device is made to ressemble a fish's
head. Covering the mouth and nose is an airtight wooden
device that hooks up to a small pack of sort on the back. It
allows breathing of water, but only under extremely cold
conditions. Somewhat fragile, it is not useful in combat
situations.

name: gold-coin sash
descriptions: Hundreds of bright, rune-stamped, gold coins have been
hammered and chained together to form a grand hip scarf.
Triangular in shape, the coins cover all down your thigh
on one side, raising to a tied knot on the other. It can be
fairly noisey while walking, if attention is not paid to
move fastidiously.

name: gold banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCGOLD.BAN

name: gold emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCGOLD.EMB

name: gold jeweled ring
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCRING.DSC

name: gold key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted gold, you can
assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: gold keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate gold keys.

name: gold ore
descriptions: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of yellow
gold. One of the most valuable metals around, gold is used
in most jewelry and embellishments, and is a favourite of
the dwarves. However, the ore is nearly worthless until it
is smelted.

name: gold parchment deed
descriptions: A magnificent sheet of cream vellum with a brushed gold border,
sealed with gilded wax pressed with a crown. Penned in deep amber
ink by a master scrivener, this deed grants full ownership of a
prestigious gang hall with capacity for up to 1,750 members.

name: gold ring
descriptions: This glittering golden ring is quite large, and is studded
with opalescent black jewels.

name: gold signet ring
descriptions: This small golden ring is worn by heavy use, and bears a
striking symbol on its face. Circular, with a skull and two
crossed axes, the symbol is a mystery.

name: golden amulet
descriptions: This amulet is made of heavy yellow gold, worked masterfully
into the form of a stylized sun.

name: golden armbands
descriptions: This matched pair of golden armbands are made of heavy
yellow gold with the texture of honey, and are unadorned.

name: golden battleaxe
descriptions: This heavy, double-bladed hand axe appears to be made of a
glittering gold. Its razor-sharp blade gleams in the light,
illuminating the miniscule runes covering its surface.

name: golden belt
descriptions: This wide belt seems to be made of golden chain links, and
is fastened with a solid platinum buckle crafted in the
shape of a coiled cobra.

name: golden box
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: golden box
descriptions: This elaborate wrought-gold box is inlaid with beautiful
filigrees and designs. Something inside rattles about
noisily when the box is moved or shook.

name: golden braided belt
descriptions: This belt is fashioned out of thick golden bands, to form
a wide braid. It is encrusted with small rubies and
diamonds, and the buckle is a large platinum star.

name: golden breastplate
descriptions: This elegant golden breastplate has been crafted to look
like a muscled torso, the model of which must have been
impressive indeed. It is polished well enough that you can
clearly see your reflection in its surface, and is
surprisingly light for its size.

name: golden broadsword
descriptions: This long, leaf-bladed broadsword shines with a mirrorlike
golden finish. Its crossguard is fashioned to look like a
pair of spreading wings, and the pommel is a bird's claw
clutching an amber stone. A strange, stylized five-pointed
star is etched into the blade near its base.

name: golden chalice
descriptions: This large, heavy goblet is encrusted with jewels, and is
exquisitely carved with flocks of angels. A holy prayer is
inscribed in flowing letters about its base.

name: golden chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is heavily embellished with
intricate dwarven ornamentation. The symbol of King Kulgar
is emblazoned on the lid, and it is obvious that it is full
of valuables.

name: golden egg
descriptions: This large, heavy egg is warm to the touch, and glimmers
beautifully in the light. Its surface is mirror-smooth and
is completely unmarred.

name: golden harp
descriptions: This exquisite golden harp is crafted with intricate
swirling patterns. Its strings are fine and well-strung,
and the melody that it plays when its strings are plucked
is heavenly.

name: golden headdress
descriptions: This elaborate gilded headdress is typically worn by the
royalty of the desert peoples-- specifically, the pharaoh.
It consists of a tiara-like crown of gold, crafted to
ressemble a rearing serpent. Bands of fine gilded cloth hang
down from the crown, and lay over the shoulders of the
wearer.

name: golden hide
descriptions: This glittering hide is covered in coarse golden hair. It is
extremely dense for its size, making it very heavy and quite
a nuisance to carry around. It could possibly be made into
armour, but only by a skilled craftsman.

name: golden hide tunic
descriptions: This heavy shirt is made out of a dense golden hide, which
glitters beautifully in the light. It is covered in coarse,
almost wirelike hairs of gold, and appears to have been
bolted together with shining steel rivets.

name: golden honeycomb
descriptions: This large, delectable honeycomb drips with the glittering
golden honey of the killer bees.

name: golden idol
descriptions: Made of the purest gold this small caricature of a warrior
looks fierce even with its oversized proportions. Normally
gold of this type is very soft and malleable though the
detailed working of this figurine shows no wear and no
matter what you try a scratch cannot be left upon it.

name: golden key
descriptions: This small, heavy key is made of pure reddish gold. Its
smooth surface is unadorned, but seems to radiate a strange
force that makes your hair stand on end.

name: golden lion key
descriptions: This small, heavy gold key's head is crafted to ressemble a
roaring lion. It is smooth and warm to the touch.

name: golden locket
descriptions: This small golden locket strung with a light silver chain.
Inside is a tiny painting of a very beautiful woman.

name: golden pike
descriptions: This large, heavy weapon is crafted from a glittering gold
that seems harder than steel. It has two pike-heads, one at
each end, with black blades that can cut through steel with
ease.

name: golden pillar
descriptions: A massive pillar of gold stands here, reaching high up into
the sky. A myriad pattern of grooves spins around the pillar
making it appear like a twisting screw with no beginning or
end. In each groove you see several letters inscribed:

name: golden plaque
descriptions: A plaque made in fine gold, it has been etched with cryptic
writing, the plaque reads:

name: golden plaque
descriptions: A plaque made in fine gold, it has been etched with cryptic
writing, the plaque reads:

name: golden plaque
descriptions: A plaque made in fine gold, it has been etched with cryptic
writing, the plaque reads:

name: golden plaque
descriptions: A plaque made in fine gold, it has been etched with cryptic
writing, the plaque reads:

name: golden rod
descriptions: This four-foot-long rod glows brightly, casting everything
with a golden shimmer. Words of a long dead language line
its length, and it seems unusually light for being fashioned
from a heavy metal. The top of the rod appears to be
threaded, as if something should be attached upon it.

name: golden sickle
descriptions: This foot-long sickle is wickedly curved, and gleams
brightly in the light. Its golden surface is engraved with
images of trailing ivy and mistletoe. The razor-sharp edge
of its blade glitters unnaturally.

name: golden snake earrings
descriptions: This pair of small golden earrings is crafted in the shape
of sinuous serpents biting their own tails, thus forming
hoops. Their eyes glitter with tiny emeralds, and the scales
seem to have been carefully crafted one by one.

name: golden sun robes
descriptions: These robes are made of white cotton and look unfaded.
Sewn into the cuffs is the symbol of a radiant, glorious
sun, along the hem you can see tiny words in holy script.
A blessed calm exudes from the robes, and they feel as if
only a person of virtue could wear them.

name: golden sun symbol
descriptions: This simply-wrought sun symbol seems to be made of a fine
yellow gold. It is not embedded in the ebony triangle, but
appears to be affixed to it somehow. Upon closer inspection,
you see that although you cannot remove it, it may be
possible to move it somehow. It occupies the southern point
of the triangle.

name: golden vial
descriptions: This long, elegantly-crafted crystal vial is filled with
a brightly-glowing golden fluid. The light from the liquid
pulses and hums with a strange force, causing the crystal
of the vial to ring musically!

name: gorilla totem
descriptions: This small jade statue of a gorilla feels warm to the touch.

name: gouged walls
descriptions: The gouges in the walls are quite large, indicating that
whatever beast chewed its way through here has large,
unnaturally sharp teeth. Embedded deep in the gouges are
tiny slivers of a glittering metal, though what that means
is anyone's guess.

name: granite coffin
descriptions: A plain coffin, made of dull, grey granite. Dust is caked on
the lid in a massive heap. On the sides you see massive
holes as if someone had tried to nail the lid shut, but by
the various cracks around them it would seem that failed.
Something terrible has already broken out and is loose.

name: granite orb
descriptions: This small granite orb is beautifully-made, and quite smooth
to the touch.

name: granite tablet
descriptions: This massive grey stone smells of fresh soil and rock dust,
it weighs you down heavily but you not various runes and
symbols of druidic tongue have been carved onto it.

name: gravestone
descriptions: The resting place of Tomster FistsOfFury, he shaped the
dark caves into his own private lair. The smell finally got
to him.

name: gravestone
descriptions: BlueSky the mage, we miss him so,
It's really too bad, that he had to go,
But an  overconfident mystic, convinced him to try,
To get his death pile back, and now we cry,
Into the dying grove they journeyed, never to return,
But got ambushed by killer bees, their poison did burn,

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies JenGhis, Paladin Leader of the House of Lords.
He served truth and justice until betrayal overcame him from
an unholy idol.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Pandabear, Paladin of the Dark Blades, always lended a hand
to any in need. Tolerant and patient with those who did not
heed. Done away in dead of night, by most foul and dastardly
deed. Unavenged goes her death, and she will be missed.

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1396.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: Damien Xcelcier a friend, a foe, To whom honor ment the most
He stood with pride, but alas, he died.
He warned us about fear, he should have been more
sincere. He warned of the wrath, but it was Dark Phoenix;
who got the last laugh. He will be remembered over many beer
it is to him, that we say 'Cheers'

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1395.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Conan. Many people were heard to exclaim
what a mighty warrior he would be, if only he like the
sword better than his ale.

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1399.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: Jehan JDC
He could always put a smile on someone's face
He knew the right things to say and stood up for them
He loved his family and loved his mmud
Our prayers and thoughts go out to you John
Rest in Peace Jehan. You will be missed.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Raise a glass, raise a toast,
Here lies Itoshu, he was made to roast,
On his last visit to the black dragon.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Lute SilverSong, Who was as tall as he is long,
We will miss that halfling bard, How he made us laugh hard,
But the last joke he had done, He picked the wrong someone,
For it you accuse someone of the fart, It better not be
Sheriff LionHeart. We Sa-Lute you Silversong!

name: gravestone
descriptions: The final resting place of Brother Luke, with patient and
even hand he guided many novices through the harsher parts
of the realm, he moved on in life and rests easy now.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Akmad, wild warrior always on the edge. He swore
to everyone he was endowed like a camel, he only showed
the wrong kind of woman.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Lying here be Kasdon, the goblin thief that stole many
hearts as well as wallets. He was well loved by all and
sorely missed.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Tiberius the Ninja, graceful and deadly, sleek and silent.
It didn't help much against the dragonfire.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Og Skullsplitter, his favorite food was horseapples.
His last words, told in a mumbled delirum, only mentioned
the taste of the last horse.

name: gravestone
descriptions: KiLee the Ranger, she had more fun romping through the
forest then is healthy for any one person.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Rab, the rabid Ranger, twisted and demented he
always had a true sense of loyalty.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Cougar Darkblade, Lord Paladin, rescuer of countless who
were lost in the infinite twisting passages of the labrynth.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Fleet the Wise, Mage extraordinare, he was wolfbait for many
moons until he discovered the secret of serpentkin, but the
secret waned on his soul and he faded away.

name: gravestone
descriptions: In memory of Miss Teri, who vanished mysteriously into
the mist, and is missed.. rarely has the realm seen such a
perfect example of charm and beauty.  We are sure wherever
she found harbor is made better by her presence, and hope
that the Angel watching over her fares well.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Dougan, Paladin of the House Of Lords, he
proclaimed himself the flaming cow god of doom, until he
met the minotaurs.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Rugal BlackNoah, a Kang Mageslayer that vowed to dominate
the world and purify it of all that is magical. His ashes
were found in the obsidian tunnels.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Lagerhowen, Forest King of Genocide, for the women
and the wine did he live, but in the end one of them did him
in, nobody knows for sure which it was

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Ares, he brought war and plunder to the innocent,
ninety bounties later and his Nigrescence is no more.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Jyhad, he always tried to start one, and ended
up starting too many.

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Delirium, doer of many dastardly deeds, it is said
his spirit is that devilish voice whisipering in your ear.

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1393.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: Here lies Satire Shilligan, the warrior punk. They stabbed
him forty six times before burning the corpse.

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1394.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1397.STO

name: gravestone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCC1398.STO

name: gravestones
descriptions: This grave was once dug very neatly but something from the
inside or out has undone the work. Large clumps of dirt have
been tossed to the side. Nothing can be guessed of what was
buried here as the gravestone is indecipherable from the
jagged claw marks that have torn into the rock.

name: greasy leather bracelet
descriptions: This heavy, thick bracelet is filthy and looks well-used.
A single strange rune has been burned into one side of it.
Upon closer inspection, you notice that the leather is in
fact the skin of a human!

name: great blackwood chest
descriptions: A large chest of unremarkable creation. Thick blackwood
surrounds the contents of this chest, and a simple iron
lock. The weight of the blackwood makes it immensely heavy.

name: great bronzewood club
descriptions: This massive club appears to be a branch hewn from one of
the far-off bronzewood trees, with the smaller branches
removed. Its grip is bound tightly in leather, and the
weapon swings surprisingly well for its size.

name: great hydra statue
descriptions: This massive statue is a monstrous sculpture. Fashioned from
stone, it is carved into the form of a great draconic beast
with two huge heads sprouting from its shoulders. Each head
is nearly split in half by the maw it bears. The fangs of
each head are easily the size of greatswords, and count into
the hundreds.

name: great mithril battle-hammer
descriptions: This large, two-handed sledgehammer is made from the purest
ore of mithril you have yet seen. It looks somewhat unwieldy
and slow, yet it seems to move with ease. Runes are stamped
along the handle, written in flowing platinum. A massive
holy symbol is stamped on the head, showing the crafter made
it for fighting against evil and only for the just to wield.

name: great spiked club
descriptions: A great stone club with huge spikes, it is a weapon in the
crudest fashion. Gigantic in size, it could be stood on its
end and be taller than most men.  Anyone who could even
wield this would be a force to be reckoned with.

name: greataxe
descriptions: This is a heavy, long-hafted, double-bladed axe. It is very
sharp, and its massive head can inflict horrible wounds on
an opponent. It is very slow and unwieldly, but armour is
almost useless against it as it punches right through.

name: greatbow
descriptions: This great, heavy bow has been carved from the trunk of some
large tree. It is strung tightly with the sinew of some
beast. Though quiet large it can obviously pack a large
punch to any target. It comes with a quiver full of
blue-feathered arrows.

name: greatcloak
descriptions: This is a massive animal skin cloak. It is thick and is
good protection, and provides great defense against the
weather, but is heavy and would get in the way of any
stealthy maneuvers.

name: greater black dragon scale
descriptions: This huge black scale is larger than a tower shield and
as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size,
though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be
impossible to lift.

name: greater blue dragon scale
descriptions: This huge bluish scale is larger than a tower shield and
as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size,
though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be
impossible to lift.

name: greater green dragon scale
