descriptions: This huge greenish scale is larger than a tower shield and
as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size,
though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be
impossible to lift.

name: greater hellhound hide
descriptions: This is the thick, heavy hide of a greater hellhound. Its
black fur is dry and straight, and reeks of brimstone.

name: greater red dragon scale
descriptions: This huge reddish scale is larger than a tower shield and
as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size,
though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be
impossible to lift.

name: greater white dragon scale
descriptions: This huge white scale is larger than a tower shield and
as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size,
though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be
impossible to lift.

name: greatsword
descriptions: This is a long, heavy, four-foot-long sword. It is quite
sharp and deadly, and is bladed on both sides. This two-
handed sword can inflict massive damage in battle, but can
only be used effectively by the very strong. It can punch
through the best platemail with ease.

name: green banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCGRE.BAN

name: green bubbling pool
descriptions: This wide, bubbling pool smells light and sweet, like the
scent of flowers on a breeze. It is illuminated by a
soothing green glow that comes from within. The shore of the
pool does not seem treacherous, and it would be easy to drin
straight from the pool, or to fill up a container with its
liquid.

name: green dragon boots
descriptions: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the
green hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and
are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also
form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: green dragon carving
descriptions: This three-foot-diameter green jade carving features a
roaring dragon's head, encircled by wispy fumes. Five odd
slots ring the carving, three of which are filled with
white, black and green fangs.

name: green dragon gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of masterfully crafted gauntlets, made from
the hide of a green dragon. Very supple, they are soft and
warm to the touch, yet give excellent protection against
almost any attack.

name: green dragon helm
descriptions: This is a sturdy helm of green dragonhide, fashioned with
superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect
the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: green dragon hide
descriptions: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon.
Green as the forest, it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes
jutting out in some spots. You wonder if it could be used
some kind of armor.

name: green dragon leggings
descriptions: Emerald green dragonhide make up this pair of leathery
leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings
offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are
very flexible.

name: green dragon tunic
descriptions: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of green dragonhide was
obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges
along the back and shoulders give the wearer a powerful
prescence.

name: green fang
descriptions: This is a four-inch-long fang, coloured deep green. Holding
it in your hand makes you feel somewhat sick.

name: green key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright green,
you can assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: green keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate green keys.

name: green metal key
descriptions: This large, heavy key is made of some rough green metal. Its
many teeth jut out at strange angles. The key's head is
crafted in the shape of a serpent's head.

name: green parchment deed
descriptions: A fine sheet of linen paper sealed with deep green wax pressed
with a stylized ironwood tree. The script flows with care. This
deed grants ownership of an established gang hall with capacity
for up to 750 members.

name: green potion
descriptions: This is a small steel-banded glass bottle, filled with a
dull-coloured green liquid. The stopper is branded with a
small symbol in the shape of a crescent moon.

name: green robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey bushes
descriptions: The bushes are fairly unremarkable. Their bark is a dark
grey, and is extremely dry-- their leaves are small, round
and light grey.

name: grey bushes
descriptions: The bushes are fairly unremarkable. Their bark is a dark
grey, and is extremely dry-- their leaves are small, round
and light grey. Upon closer inspection, a narrow crack can
be seen lurking behind them!

name: grey leather-bound tome
descriptions: This huge, heavy tome is covered with swirling silvery runes
and symbols. Inside, yellowed parchment pages are inscribed
with spidery black letters.

name: grey potion
descriptions: This heavy metal flask is filled with a disgusting grey
fluid that smells of dead earth and burnt wood. Blobs of
matter float about in it revoltingly.

name: grey robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey rolled parchment
descriptions: This thin piece of parchment is covered in spidery letters.
After scanning the document, you discover it is instructions
on the learning and casting of a spell named Frenzy!

name: griffon
descriptions: The carved griffon is detailed exquisitely. Each claw and
feather is defined so exactly that it must have taken years
to complete. The griffon's beak appears as sharp as a sword
blade, and its eye shines like a star... but upon closer
inspection, you see that the eye is actually a button!

name: griffon shield
descriptions: This golden kite shield looks as if it has separated from
some wall or fixture. It is rough around the edges but has
an inner beauty and shine to it. An intricate carving of a
rearing griffon is shown on the shield, showing it to be a
symbol of Silvermere. Inscripted on the front of the shield

name: gunsen
descriptions: This compact shield folds out quickly into a large iron fan.
It is ideal for deflecting blows in close combat, and then
snapping shut to give extra room for a counter blow. Ornate
lettering lines each partition, unfolding into a haiku about
death.

name: halberd
descriptions: This is six-foot pole with an axe head mounted at the top.
It is extremely slow, and is quite clumsly to wield, but the
damage its huge, arcing swings can inflict is quiet high.

name: half-plate corselet
descriptions: This is a corselet of thin steel, worn over a leather
jacket. It is very heavy and cumbersome, but provides
excellent protection against attacks.

name: hammers of balance
descriptions: Two hammers of adamantite, a matching pair of power and
strength. The head of one hammer is crafted of diamond, a
sunburst of gold imprinted upon it. A piece of jet sits atop
the other hammer, a crimson skull imprinted as well. They
appear as if crafted in pure unison, never to be used apart.

name: handful of brown nuts
descriptions: These small nuts are round and hard, and smell quite
appetizing. They have tiny black speckles around their
width.

name: hangman's noose
descriptions: This is a long piece of rope, tied together into a formation
commonly known of as a hangman's noose. The circular bottom
is wide enough so that almost any head could fit in it.

name: hard leather gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of rigid leather gauntlets. They are long,
coming nearly up to the elbow, and give good defense. They
are the gauntlet of choice for most adventurers.

name: hard leather helm
descriptions: This is a rigid leather helm studded with iron rivets. It is
much heavier than a regular leather helm, but the iron studs
deflect blows.

name: hardened leather boots
descriptions: This is a pair of rigid leather boots. They come up to the
middle of the shin, and are tough and well-made. They give
good protection in combat.

name: hatchet
descriptions: This is a short-hafted light axe, not designed for throwing.
It is bladed only on one side, and attacks with this weapon
are fairly fast and damaging.

name: head of the orc warlord
descriptions: This beaten and bloody head once belonged to a dreaded black
orcish warlord. Now blank eyes stare dully in silence, as
foul bloody ichor leak from its fanged mouth and severed
neck.

name: head of the woodelf lord
descriptions: Even in death, the elf-lord seems to have an air of
serenity about him. Too bad he's worm food now.

name: Heartstone
descriptions: This heavy, glittering jewel is blood red in colour. It
shines with a thousand facets, and is warm to the touch.

name: heavy-mace
descriptions: This is a heavy steel ball mounted on a wooden handle. It is
fairly large and heavy, and does good damage. It is mainly
used by the stronger of the Priesthood.

name: heavy black boots
descriptions: Thick black leather make up this large pair of boots. The
skin is so rigid you would think it were iron but for the
supple feel of tanned skin. Covering from toe to shin
it seems to have a menacing look to them, an unending well
of blackness as if it were going to stomp mountains into
the ground. Small spikes jut from around the sole.

name: heavy black rod
descriptions: This three-foot-long rod flickers from light grey, to
charcoal, to night black, then back to grey again in an
endless cycle of shifting shades. It is completely unmarked
and is as smooth as glass.

name: heavy bone mace
descriptions: This massive mace is seemingly carved from the legbone of
some huge animal. Its head is knobbed and is covered in
wicked-looking protrusions.

name: heavy box
descriptions: This large box is stamped on one side with the Tolgard's
trader symbol. It is difficult to tell what is contained
within, as the contents are carefully packed to avoid
breakage.

name: heavy crossbow
descriptions: This is a more powerful version of the standard crossbow.
Its bow is very tightly strung, and requires much strength
to re-cock, making it very slow to fire. Nonetheless, it is
extremely accurate, and armour is nearly useless against its
heavy bolts. It comes with a quiver full of the small,
weighty, steel-tipped bolts it requires.

name: heavy spear
descriptions: Larger then a normal spear, this weapon is made for those
that possess exceptional strength. Many would argue that
this is a ballista bolt not a hand to hand weapon but those
that have the strength to wield one make a definate argument
for its deadliness when skewering opponents.

name: hell-flail
descriptions: This massive, three-headed flail is made of some heavy,
soot-coloured metal. It reeks of brimstone and charred
flesh. Evil-looking runes glow like the fires of hell on the
brutally-spiked head.

name: hellblade
descriptions: Dark fire rises from this blade, even as damnation is
spelled out in twisted runes along its length. Screams
of agony can be heard as this sword weaves through the air,
its keen edge unstoppable against most protection. Swords
such as this can only come from the netherworld, and most
carry a horrific price for wielding its power.

name: helmet key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of a visored helmet.

name: hematite stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is a silvery grey-black
colour.

name: hero's tabard
descriptions: This deep brown cloak would weigh less if it were lined with
lead. Sewn from the cocoons of the temprite moth they
provide one of the sturdiest protections possible in cloth.
Though not the easiest cloak to wear its sturdiness has
saved more then a few warriors of lore.

name: hide inscripted scroll
descriptions: Tattooed upon the hide of some ill fated humanoid are the
words to an unholy prayer, giving power to those wicked
enough to accept it.

name: hideous altar
descriptions: This massive altar is crafted out of red stone, in the shape
of a horned skull. Its features are picked out with
exquisite skill, its open mouth filled with needle-sharp
teeth. Its huge eye sockets gaze at you hollowly.

name: hideous face
descriptions: A face of unspeakable evil and glee juts from the wall here.
Fashioned to appear almost as some kind of lustful gaze,
this face looks as though it has been badly scarred. A large
eye socket appears vacant, and its wide, demonic grin
seems to have a gaping hole where a tongue should be.

name: hideous face
descriptions: A face of unspeakable evil and glee juts from the wall here.
Fashioned to appear almost as some kind of lustful gaze,
this face looks as though it has been badly scarred, and
its wide, demonic grin seems to have a gaping hole where
a tongue should be.

name: high-necked robes
descriptions: These long, voluminous robes have a stiff, high-necked
collar which gives a very dramatic appearance to the wearer.
The deep green of the robes is offset by brilliant golden
runes which adorn the cuffs and hem, and a golden sash
around the waist keeps it closed.

name: hills
descriptions: These hills are made of a light grey rock, almost the colour
of powdered bone, and are run through with veins of a deep
metallic red. Their faces are sheer, sharp, and unscalable,
and rumour tells that the red veins are actually rivulets of
blood from adventurers who have tried to scale their
heights.

name: hole
descriptions: This jagged hole is about four feet in diameter, and looks
as if it was made by some extremely powerful beast. Peering
in, you can see the shadowy recesses of a cavernous tunnel!

name: hole
descriptions: The black hole in the ceiling here is too high to reach, and
appears to lead upwards at a steep slant.

name: hole
descriptions: This four-foot-wide hole appears to have been roughly carved
out with some extremely-sharp digging instrument... or
perhaps, claws.

name: holy avenger
descriptions: This long, straight blade is crafted from adamantite, and
polished to a silvery sheen. Its cross-hilt is wrapped with
golden cord. Engraved up and down the blade's length are
holy inscriptions, and an aura of power protects the wielder
from evil foes, making him more difficult to hit.

name: holy medallion
descriptions: This beautiful platinum medallion is exquisitely crafted
with the symbols of the gods. It seems to vibrate quietly
when you touch its smooth surface.

name: holy miter
descriptions: This tall, elaborately-decorated hat is worn by the upper
levels of the clergy. It is inscribed with holy symbols of
protection.

name: holy vestements
descriptions: These elaborate white robes are decorated with gold lace and
small precious gems. Holy symbols are woven into the hem and
cuffs with golden thread.

name: holy water vial
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with pure, clean water. A
stopper keeps its contents inside, and you see a single
holy symbol inscribed upon it.

name: Holy Wrath and Righteous Fury
descriptions: Two longswords, twin in every fashion, meant only for use in
combination with the other. Ivory hilts embossed with gold
meet glowing white blades made of almost pure and holy
might. Sacred symbols are written like flowing grace and
beauty. On one blade it is written "Holy Wrath" and on the
twin it is written "Righteous Fury".

name: holy writ
descriptions: This thin manual describes the ways of properly praying to
one's deity in order to be filled with righteous power! This
Righteousness gives the target an increase in combat power,
coupled with a small healing of one's wounds over time.

name: honeycakes
descriptions: These small, round delights are sweetened with honey, and
are the primary dessert for the peoples of this area. They
are as nutritious as they are delicious.

name: hooded mask
descriptions: This mask is made out of a flat black material, specially
treated to not reflect the light. It conceals the wearer's
head, leaving nothing but a slit to see through.

name: horned helmet
descriptions: This is a solid iron helm, neck-length and horned. Its
massive horns curl upwards, like a bull's. It is heavy, but
is strong and protects well.

name: horned spider skull
descriptions: A fearsome looking item, it looks to be the skull of a
great horned spider. Ridges around the eye holes show where
the clusters once lay. Two great horns jut from the helm,
allowing one to possibly gore an opponent, causing harm and
knocking them to the ground. Though odd looking it could
make for a sturdy helm.

name: huge broken willow
descriptions: This massive, ruined willow tree stands by the water. A
wide crack in its side appears to lead within it!

name: huge darkwood chest
descriptions: This heavy chest is crafted from silver-bound planks of
darkwood. Its massive, rectangular frame holds objects of
value, for when it is moved rattling sounds can be heard
from within.

name: huge darkwood club
descriptions: This massive club is about six feet in length, and is banded
about the hilt with a thick strap of greasy leather. It
would be nearly impossible for any normal being to wield
this, much less even pick it up!

name: huge darkwood tree
descriptions: This massive, twisted darkwood tree is so huge it is wider
than a house. Its thick branches droop down heavily, laden
with deep green leaves. It is covered in a variety of
odd-looking knots.

name: huge fallen tree
descriptions: This massive tree appears somewhat bent and twisted, and is
scorched all down one side, presumably by lightning. It is
stuck in some rocks in the centre of the river, and careful
navigation is required to get around it.

name: huge keg
descriptions: This massive wooden barrel is nearly large enough to stand
in without stooping. An ornate silver tap is set securely
in the centre of the front of the keg, and glimmers in the
light.

name: huge stone
descriptions: This gigantic stone almost looks like a giant tortoise. It
sits off to the north of the river, its rocky foundation
forcing the river's path to the south.

name: huge tree
descriptions: This massive ironwood tree could not be encircled by any
less than thirty people with their arms outstretched. Its
many branches would make it easy to climb up into, though
to reach any heights would be tiring.

name: hydra key
descriptions: This large stone key's head is shaped to ressemble the
hideous serpentine form of a hydra.

name: ice chest
descriptions: This massive chest was once made of some fine metal, except
ages of being locked in solid ice have made the metal
brittle. Years of being put away in some icy, dark cavern
have made this chest weight ten times what it seems. Your
skin almost sticks to the surface as you brush your hand
across the lock.

name: ice crystal falchion
descriptions: This sword has a bluish white hilt which attaches to a
crystal blue blade of what looks like pure ice. The blade
has a heavy end with a slight curve forward. It feels large
and heavy but seems to be easy to weild.

name: ice crystal staff
descriptions: Magic of great power is the only explanation for this staves
existance. Pure ice has been carved and formed into a tall
staff. Chills exude from this crystalline wonder, causing
the skin on your arms to become a terrain of goose bumps.
Near invisible sygils of silver have been carved into
various parts of the staff, making its power more evident.

name: Ice Tear
descriptions: This small, smooth object glitters like ice but is as hard
as diamond. Bluish-white and cold, it radiates an aura of
sorrow that is unmistakeable.

name: iceforge anvil
descriptions: This huge black-iron anvil seems to have been made for a
giant, as it is six feet up to its flat hammering surface! A
thick coating of ice surrounds the anvil, and waves of cold
emanate from it. Upon close scrutiny, glowing blue runes can
be seen etched into its surface. Ancient rumours have told
of enchanted anvils being used to craft magical armaments.

name: icehammer
descriptions: This massive sledgehammer seems to be made out of solid,
glittering blue ice. It radiates an aura of intense cold,
but despite this it can be handled without harm.

name: icy scroll
descriptions: This scroll is tinged blue and tied by a bright blue ribbon.
It seems to let off a vapor of some sort, and as you touch
it, your whole body begins to shiver, as if an arctic wind
blew down on you.

name: icy scroll
descriptions: This scroll is freezing to touch and gives off wisps of
steam as if it were made entirely of ice, oddly enough you
can unroll it to reveal swirling runes in the language of
druids.

name: icy scroll
descriptions: This scroll is tinged blue and tied by a bright blue ribbon.
It seems to let off a vapor of some sort, and as you touch
it, your hands began to flare with pain, as if they had
been cut by something very sharp and cold, but no marks
appear on them.

name: incense
descriptions: This is a small stick of incense. It is sometimes burned in
religious ceremonies as it has a somewhat soothing effect
when inhaled and helps concentration.

name: inquisitor's cloak
descriptions: Small scales of metal hammered thinner then paper look like
a shimmering dragon hide on the outside of this soft deep
grey cloak. The witchunters of old were rumored to wear such
cloaks during their first attempt to purge magic from the
realm.

name: inscribed leather scroll
descriptions: This worn writ instructs the reader in the holy incantations
required to cast a powerful healing spell. It makes no sense
to anyone other than a devoted Priest.

name: iron-banded chest
descriptions: This medium-sized chest is made of thick wood, and is bound
with sturdy iron strips. When moved, objects rattle about
inside.

name: iron-capped staff
descriptions: This is a staff with iron caps on the ends. It does more
damage than a conventional staff, but is also slower due to
the added weight.

name: iron badge
descriptions: This heavy iron badge is crafted in the shape of a clawed
fist. It is commonly seen on the low-ranking leaders of the
band who command only a few orcs.

name: iron crown
descriptions: This light circlet is surprisingly finely-crafted, despite
the fact it is only iron. An eye-sized amber stone set in
its front glitters brightly.

name: iron door
descriptions: This massive iron door must be at least twelve feet in
height, and six feet across. It is heavily riveted and
reinforced, and although you cannot possibly know how thick
it is, you surmise it would be nearly impossible to batter
down. A black hole about an inch in diameter is located on
the right edge of the door.

name: iron earrings
descriptions: These are a pair of simple iron hoops, crafted well enough
to not be called sloppy, but not magnificent either.
Each hoop ends in a spike which can be moved for fastening.

name: iron key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of a coiled serpent.

name: iron key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of a bird claw.

name: iron key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted to form a
circle, allowing easy storage.

name: iron ore
descriptions: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of iron.
Useful in creating weaponry and eveyrday items, it can be
refined to make steel. Before being usable, however, the
iron must be extracted from the ore by smelting it.

name: iron pedestal
descriptions: Round and sturdy, it is a wonder this pedestal has not
melted under the intense heat which surrounds it. Floating
above the pedestal, out of reach is a large crimson shard,
which appears uneffected by the blazing chamber.

name: iron ration
descriptions: This is a small package containing specially-preserved and
cured meat, some dried fruits, and sack of varied nuts. It
is the staple of far-ranging adventurers who either have no
hunting skills or who don't have the inclination to hunt for
their food.

name: iron ring
descriptions: This is a plain iron ring, polished so that is gleams
brilliantly.

name: iron ring
descriptions: This is a plain iron ring, polished so that it gleams
brilliantly.

name: iron sign
descriptions: A small iron plaque is riveted to the wall here, and it
reads: "Bank of Rhudaur: Admission charge is 5 gold
crowns, non-negotiable."

name: iron sink
descriptions: This large iron sink is crudely fashioned to resemble a
toad, its gaping mouth open wide. Four webbed feet hold it
high off of the ground. Upon further examination, you think
that the inside is extensively rusted... until you notice
the pool of red liquid on the floor beneath the sink and
realize that the 'rust' is actually dried blood.

name: iron staff
descriptions: This is a wooden staff with an iron core. It is quite heavy
for its size, and is not as easily maneuvered as a regular
staff, but it also does more damage.

name: iron tube
descriptions: This is a strange contraption indeed. It consists of a
wooden handle, which is attached to an iron sphere, which
in turn is affixed to the end of a two-foot-long iron tube.
A metal stud is affixed to the top of the sphere, and small
objects can be heard rattling about inside.

name: iron wand
descriptions: This foot-long wand is fashioned from thick black iron.
It is entirely unremarkable except for the clear, silvery
blue rune that has been carved on the head of the wand.

name: ironwood shield
descriptions: Crafted from an ironwood tree, this shield is thick and
offers good deflection of attack. Hardened by magic, it is
lighter then metal, and a warmth pulses from its surface,
much like a heartbeat.

name: ivory bracelet
descriptions: This simple-looking, but nonetheless beautifully-crafted,
bracelet is made from the purest ivory. Bands of yellow gold
and platinum are staggered at evenly-spaced intervals all
around its length, and there is an inscription written in an
ancient tongue on the inside.

name: ivory bracers
descriptions: These beautiful ivory bracers are carved with intricate
animals, many of which you have never seen before. They
are light and delicate, and seem well-used.

name: ivory crozier
descriptions: This staff of ivory radiates holy power. Bronze runes run
along its length, radiating a bright glow. An angel crafted
from gold shines from atop the crozier, wings outspread it
points to the heavens. Under the angel are holy words of
prayer.

name: ivory statue
descriptions: This small ivory statue is crafted to ressemble a head with
eight faces. Each face has one single glaring eye, each a
different colour; one red, one orange, one yellow, one
green, one blue, one violet, one black and one white.

name: jade amulet
descriptions: This small, circular pendant is carved and polished from
a deep green jade. It is inscribed with a single exotic
rune.

name: jade wave carving
descriptions: Beautifully crafted from a single block of jade, this
sculpture is carved to ressemble a curved wave crashing down
upon the rocks. It is affixed to the stone altar, but for
some reason seems moveable.

name: jagged bone key
descriptions: This key looks to be the chipped fingerbone of something
long dead. It is extremely yellowed and almost seems
petrified. The sharp edges look as if they could easily
pierce the flesh of anyone using it.

name: jail cell
descriptions: This is a small, cold, stone cell. It has a crude wooden
bench to lay on, and a glory-hole in the corner, but
other wise the room is bare.

name: jail key
descriptions: This rusted iron key has seen many years of age, but little
use. It appears by the emblem on it that its some type of
offical Silvermere key for city use. On the opposite side of
the emblem is the letter J which you assume would mean Jail.

name: javelin
descriptions: This long wooden pole runs six feet in length. Vine is
used as a grip in the middle of the pole, and the ends
have been carved into several fine points,
causing great agony to it's victim.

name: jewel-encrusted warhammer
descriptions: More a treasure then an actual weapon, jewels of all shapes
adorn this weapon. Sapphires, emeralds, rubies and diamonds
glitter all around this massive hammer of war. Jewels are
inlaid so thick that it is not possible to tell what it is
made of underneath.

name: jeweled adamantite longsword
descriptions: This is a cobalt blue longsword, forged of the finest
adamantite. Its hilt is lined with deep crimson rubies that
are carved with intricate runes and shimmer with magical
luster. At the tip of the hilt is a large black skull that
seems locked in a permanent grin.

name: jeweled adamantite ninjato
descriptions: This straight singled-edged blade is fashioned from pure
adamantite. Its hilt is forged into the shape of a panthers
head, and the letter "R" has been carved onto the base of
the blade.

name: jeweled altar
descriptions: This large golden altar would bring a fortune if it were
melted down, but it is far too massive to move. Embedded in
its surface in a circle are many gems: an amethyst, a
diamond, and emerald, an onyx, a pearl, a ruby, a sapphire
and a topaz.

name: jeweled dirk
descriptions: Onyx and diamonds of all sizes decorate the hilt of this
dirk. The short thick black is crafted of silver, with
many runes adorning the blade. The edge is razor sharp that
could easily cut through flesh or armor, at the base of
the blade is a black and white serpent intwined.

name: jeweled longsword
descriptions: This exquisitely-crafted blade is honed to a razor-sharp
edge, and its blade is embellished with highlighted runes
and engravings. Its hilt is encrusted with glittering gems
of all sizes, and its pommel is fashioned in the form of a
dragon's claw gripping a blue sapphire.

name: jeweled main-gauche
descriptions: This long-bladed knife is meant to be wielded in the left
hand as a defensive weapon. It has a wide guard and strong
blade, which allow it to turn aside most weapons. It is
quite ornate, and an eye-sized ruby is set in its pommel.

name: jeweled maul
descriptions: A large crimson metal rod of eight foot length attaches to
a massive round ball encrusted with onyx and diamonds.
It looks impossible to lift, but somehow it is manageable,
you find nothing significant about the gems, other then they
seem to have been treated by some chemical to be solid and
unbreakable. Defintely a weapon that could splat most foes.

name: jeweled scimitar
descriptions: This elaborately-worked scimitar is made of the finest
high steel, and is worked with many exquisite gems. Its
hand guard is delicately worked to portray a snake biting
its own tail.

name: jeweled turban
descriptions: This elaborate headpiece is made of bright red silk and
glittering gold. A sapphire the size of an egg is set in the
headband, and sparkles with an unnatural light.

name: Judicator
descriptions: This heavy-looking hammer appears painful in the capable
hands. Fashioned of some crimson metal, it dulls your
senses as you touch it. Created by a master it is flawless
in weight and speed. A single crimson flame is stamped on
the head, and under it, in ancient tongue are the words
"Judicator".

name: jug of cider
descriptions: A large glass jug, bowled out at the center and funneling to
a thin nozzle at the top. It is filled with a clear,
honey-colored liquid, that smells quite strongly of apples
and alcohol when uncorked.

name: jug of dark ale
descriptions: This is a fair-sized earthenware jug of dark brewed ale. It
is quite strong, and has a slightly bitter taste.

name: Kai battle-staff
descriptions: This long, slender staff is a creation of the ancient Kai
Lords. It is extremely potent in battle, being perfectly
balanced and imbued with incredible power.

name: katana
descriptions: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a
half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a
greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and
the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its
black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: Kher grass
descriptions: This is a bundle of black, unclean-looking weeds. It smells
sour, and is almost greasy.

name: khopesh sword
descriptions: This is an end-heavy sword, with a slight forward curve. It
is large and heavy, and does considerable damage in combat.
It is a little unwieldly and slow.

name: king crab claw
descriptions: This large claw is awkward to hold because of its bulk. It
is about 4 feet in length, including a portion of the arm.
The shape of it would make it an effective tool for scooping
large amounts of dirt or sand.

name: kite shield
descriptions: This is a long, thin shield, useful against arrows. It is
heavy and somewhat cumbersome, but if you stand sideways it
is possible to shield most of the body from attack.

name: knife
descriptions: This is a wicked-looking curved knife. It is heavier than
a dagger, but is also harder to wield.

name: kote
descriptions: These armoured sleeves connect behind your shoulders with a
thick strip of leather. They are made from tiny metal plates
stitched together with a coarse black thread, and an
intricate camouflage pattern has been painted on the them.
plates.

name: kusari gama
descriptions: This huge flail consists of a sickle on one end attached
to a large weighted chain.

name: lacquered battle armour
descriptions: This leather tunic is crafted from stiff, black leather, and
has been emblazoned with swirling golden emblems. Small
semi-precious gems glitter in adornment on the breast. From
the look and quality of it, it was likely the personal
armour of a high-ranking leader.

name: laen longsword
descriptions: The longsword is made of an unknown crystal-like substance.
You notice it gleam with power when it reflects the sun's
light.

name: lantern
descriptions: This is a small iron lantern, its glass bulb protected by
shutters. When filled with oil and lit, it provides very
good illumination.

name: large black gem
descriptions: This gem is finest cut diamond you have seen in your life
of adventure. It seems to pulse with a deep, seductive
blackness. A large O has been chiseled on top of the diamond
in red lettering.

name: large boulder
descriptions: This massive stone is charred and heavily gouged by some
huge clawed animal. However, at your touch it moves
slightly, and you think that it may be possible to turn it!

name: large broken tree
descriptions: This twisted black tree juts out over the edge of the chasm
here. Upon closer inspection, you notice a path hidden by
bushes surrounding the base of the tree. The path leads down
onto a concealed ledge, where a pair of stairs lead down the
face of the cliff!

name: large canvas tent
descriptions: This is a simple, but effective, heavy cloth tent. It is
quite big, having room for about a dozen well-sized people,
and seems to be populated by at least that many, if the
sprawled bedrolls and miscellaneous debris are anything to
go by.

name: large chest
descriptions: This appears to be a large, ordinary-looking wooden chest. I
bound with iron bands, and sits upon four short steel feet.

name: large iron key
descriptions: This massive iron key is quite crudely made. Its solid
construction makes it fairly invulnerable to damage,
however.

descriptions: Made of simple granite, this rock is very large and looks
immenseley heavy.

descriptions: A newly painted sign sits here in the middle of the road,
in bright, obnoxious lettering it reads:
Coming Soon! The most majistical marvelous myraid misfits
in the land! The travelling comedy groupe of
M. Alevolience and Co.

name: large sign
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
NEWHAVEN.TXT

name: large sign
descriptions: This is a large wooden pole with three ancient slabs nailed
to it. Through the faded writing you can see a black arrow
pointing east with the words "Arlysia". Another faded arrow
points north, with "Lake" inscripted on it. The last arrow
is more ominous, written in fresh red ink, scraggled on it
displays the words "Gravyard, Dange".

name: large sign
descriptions: A brand new sign sits here, pointing to a boarded up
building to the north, the sign reads:
Coming Soon! Phezik's Manual Labor Emporium
Instant Work for Anyone!

name: large silvery cross
descriptions: This is the fabled Cross of Vengeance, which, when used,
imbues its wielder with a mighty power. Its heavy, foot-long
body is etched with glowing red runes, and its surface is
untarnished despite its seemingly incredible age.

name: large tree
descriptions: This massive copperwood tree could not be encircled by any
less than twenty people with their arms outstretched. Its
many branches would make it easy to climb up into, though
to reach any heights would be tiring.

name: lava-rock
descriptions: This sheet of what appears to be cooled lava is rough and
textured with several small rocks inbedded within its
surface. Looking closely, you discover a large opal
stone that appears to be moveable.

name: layered sun skirt
descriptions: The top layer of this skirt has been dyed yellow, with
blazing suns worked into its surface. It is solid around
the upper thighs, dividing at center into long strips
that are tipped with topaz-stone suns. The under layer,
visible lower thigh down, is bright yellow and orange,
cut into vertical strips as though sunfire.

name: leaf blade
descriptions: This seems to be half of a large leaf forming a perfect
semicircle. Amazingly rigid for a leaf, the rounded edge is
sharper than most blades made of metal.  No handholds appear
along the flat edge which makes it awkward for anyone to
wield.

name: leafwoven cloak
descriptions: Tiny vines still producing small green leaves make up this
cloak. Created by the first druid to give disciples
knowledge of how the earth mother supports her children this
magical clothing brings a druid closer to one with nature.

name: leather belt
descriptions: This is a plain leather belt, with a square iron buckle to
hold it closed.

name: leather gloves
descriptions: This is a pair of soft leather gloves. They are longer than
most gloves, coming up to the mid-forearm, and give decent
protection versus attack.

name: leather pants
descriptions: This is a pair of soft leather pants. They are comfortable
and flexible but are not too heavy, and provide decent
defense.

name: leather skirt
descriptions: This is a soft leather skirt, coming down to just above the
knees. It is comfortable and flexible, and has a slit up the
side for ease of movement.

name: lever
descriptions: This simple iron lever is set in the centre of a steel
plate. Its round knob is dull and smoothed by much use.

name: levers
descriptions: Two iron levers, side by side clearly show the abuse they've
taken from the many scars and scratches upon their shaft.
Left and right, they both look protrude here in an upper
position, but they look easy enough to manipulate downard.

name: lifestealer
descriptions: The lifestealer blade is nearly four feet long but
unbelievably thin for its size. Made of an orcish metal it
reflects no light and mysteriously makes no sound as it
moves through the air.

name: light ball
descriptions: This pale white ball radiates a bright light, but exudes no
heat and is almost cold to touch. It seems light weight and
almost looks as though it could float, keeping your way
lighted until its magic expired.

name: light plate corselet
descriptions: This is corselet of light steel plate, worn over heavy
leather. It is very heavy and noisy, but the incredible
edge it gives in combat may be worthwhile, if you are strong
enough to bear its weight!

name: light plate leggings
descriptions: This a pair of steel plate leggings, with heavy leather
underneath and at the joints. They are quite heavy, and make
tremendous noise, but are invaluable for their defensive
potential.

name: lightning whip
descriptions: A large leather handle connects to a thin, long tail of
shocking pain. Electricity shoots from the handle to the tip
in sparking waves of fury. The whip seems to sway around
as if to mimic a snakes hypnotic dance.

name: lionskin belt
descriptions: This fine belt was made from the hide of some animal and
then tanned. It feels very thick, and is buckled with a
piece of gold, finely crafted into the image of a lion.  It
is heavy to wear around your waist, but still makes a nice
fit.

name: lionskin tunic
descriptions: This tunic is made of dyed animal skin, tanned to a golden
brown. The center is inlaid with a finely crafted symbol of
a lion. From the feel of the tunic it's very hard to pierce,
and the lining is made from a fine fur. The craftsmanship
looks a little clumsy, but still durable in a fight.

name: lock of fiery hair
descriptions: This lovely lock of hair still burns with energy. Each fine
strand is a different color of flame, and is warm to the
touch.

name: locked wooden box
descriptions: This small, heavy, rectangular box appears to be made of
polished darkwood. Its corners are capped with shining iron,
and it has a heavy lock on it.

name: lockpicks
descriptions: This small pouch is filled with all the necessary tools and
picks to aid one in unlocking tricky doors.

name: log raft
descriptions: This small floating platform is simply a number of small
logs lashed together with rope. It is somewhat heavy and
extremely cumbersome to carry.

name: long-spear
descriptions: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is
fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not
do great damage.

name: long-spear
descriptions: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is
fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not
do great damage.

name: long battle shield
descriptions: This long, rectangular shield is used by elite armies to
form walls, behind which they can fight safely. Semi-
circular holes are cut on either side, through which spears
or other thrusting weapons have room to attack.

name: long bridge
descriptions: This long, arching bridge spans the Silver river, connecting
Silvermere to the fenced-in graveyard. It is of ancient
make, and excellent quality -- although it appears overly
slender for a bridge of its length, its strength is
surprising. The river passes swiftly beneath it, and it is
raised up high enough that it is not possible to climb up.

name: long golden chain
descriptions: This is a long, extremely thin chain of bright gold. It has
been threaded with some strange red material that almost
makes it look like blood has stained this chain. A clasp at
one end has been broken off, but it looks like it could be
repaired by skilled hands.

name: long golden staff
descriptions: This long golden staff is exquisitely carved with intricate
symbols all along its length. At one end is a circular head,
with a blazing emerald glittering in its centre.

name: long table
descriptions: This simple, sturdy table is similar to those found in most
common rooms of taverns and inns. It is heavy and is built
solely to last.

name: longbow
descriptions: This slender, curved bow is made out of a long branch of
supple wood. It is tightly strung, and has a fair amount of
stopping power. Its pull is a little heavy, but it makes for
a good, accurate weapon. It comes with a quiver full of
black-feathered arrows.

name: longsword
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword1
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword2
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword3
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword4
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword5
descriptions: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed
along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for
thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: lunar chain gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair if elbow-length chain gauntlets has been
fashioned in a bizarre fashion. Through intricate patterns
it has been crafted to appear so that the hand were the head
of a wolf, and the fingers forming the maw. It appears
stylish without degrading the protection of the gauntlets.

name: lunar chainmail boots
descriptions: This is a pair of black leather boots, rising from the toe
to just above the ankle. Sewn tightly about the boots are
links of a strange blue metal. The chain seems to glow
a metallic dark blue, and look strong enough to give decent
protection in combat.

name: lunar chainmail coif
descriptions: Links of blue steel mesh together and form a tight fitting
coif. The metal has a strange glow that gives it a strange
alien quality.

name: lunar chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This suit of chainmail shines as if the moon were captured
in its very rings. Shining with a blue tinge, a silver wolf
head is sewn into the chestcloth, howling at the moon.

name: lunar chainmail leggings
descriptions: Tiny chain links have been woven with a strange blue metal
to form an unbreakable pair of leggings. The way they glow
it would seem as if they had fallen from the night sky.

name: lyrist's companion
descriptions: An indescript off-white, the magics within these cloaks
could turn an unruly audience into a peaceful mob or move
a quiet group of commoners into a dancing frenzy. Many of
the secrets of these cloaks left with the original sages.

name: mace
descriptions: This is a steel ball mounted on a two-foot wooden rod. It
is a well-rounded weapon, providing adequate defense and
attack. This is the weapon of choice for Priests and the
like.

name: mage statue
descriptions: Enduring granite has somehow kept this statue from
disrepair, though the age of centuries can still be seen
in the layer of dust upon it. Carved into that of some great
and powerful mage, he points his finger northward, as if
releasing powerful magic to the oncoming darkness.

name: Magebane sword
descriptions: This long, wickedly-sharp sword is crafted from the finest
steel possible. It is named the Magebane for its edge, which
is covered in many small serrated points. The combination of
the sharpness and these tiny barbs cause painful, jagged
wounds in the target, disrupting concentration (and thus
spellcasting).

name: magical quartz rod
descriptions: This short quartz rod pulses with a pale, spectral light.
Its strange enchantment causes it to hum slightly, and it is
warm to the touch.

name: magical rune
descriptions: A magical rune crafted by a mage of great power, it
symbolizes the person has done a great service for the
crafter and can return it for reimbursement for that deed.

name: MagiRavager
descriptions: This massive greatsword shows the hands of a master smith in
its creation. Made from some strange crimson metal, it moves
with incredible quickness for a blade its size. Touching
the sword dulls your sense and you see the stamp of a flame
upon the base of the blade. You can also see written
"ManaRavager" in ancient tongue.

name: magma amulet
descriptions: This dully-glowing pendant is made of grey iron. Set in the
centre of its face is a smooth red stone, and it hangs upon
a braid of thick black hair.

name: magma chunk
descriptions: This chunk of magma looks as though it would easily char
the flesh off anything but surprisingly it radiates no heat.
In glowing runes of druidic tongue phrases are written upon
the lava rock.

name: magma key
descriptions: Magma was dripped into a mold and slowly cooled to form this
key. It is small enough to fit within the palm of your hand,
or a tiny lock.

name: magma rock chest
descriptions: This large chest is made from magma rock, long since cooled
since the day it was first made. It has trully been made
from magical means, for the weight of it is quiet late for
being made of such heavy stone.

name: Magus Ripper
descriptions: A long serrated talon gives this scythe a very sinister
appearance. Crafted from a strange crimson metal, the blade
is held by a large metal haft, ancient words scripted along
its length. One of the words you catch "Magus Ripper."

name: mahogany wand
descriptions: This long, slender mahogany wand is smoothly carved, and is
engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: main-gauche
descriptions: This off-handed dagger is designed for parrying, and is used
in conjunction with another weapon such as a rapier. It is
finely made from the best steel.

name: malachite ring
descriptions: This heavy malachite ring is carved in the shape of a snake
biting its own tail. Small, fluidly-engraved runes are set
in the inside of the ring.

name: malachite stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is coloured a rich light and
dark green.

name: mamba fang
descriptions: This wicked looking fang is over 3 feet in length and comes
to a very fine point. As you shake it you can hear fluid
rolling about in what must be a hollow within the fang. With
proper preperation this could be a formidable weapon.

name: manastone
descriptions: This is a cool blue stone of unknown origin, and it pulsates
brightly and appears to have some great magical power held
within its core. A chain of gold is attached to the stone
for wearing around one's neck.

name: mandible
descriptions: This long, unwieldly item is a jaw ripped from a giant sized
insect. Razor-sharp, it can tear through armour with ease
but it is difficult to wield.

name: manhole
descriptions: This is a three-foot-wide hole in the centre of the street,
concealed by a perforated stone cover which allows the
stream of water and refuse to drain into the sewers.

name: manriki-gusari
descriptions: You see a length of black chain with weights at each end.
The manriki-gusari is easily thrown at your opponent's
ankles for tripping and hindering retreat. Used at the
correct time, it can give you the upper hand in combat. The
length of the chain is just right for tying about your waist
and concealing it beneath a belt or sash.

name: manticore tail
descriptions: This huge, heavy tail is tipped with a heavy bone ball
covered in long spikes. The spines are iron-hard and sharp
as razors, and make this tail a deadly weapon, although its
extreme weight doesn't allow much in the way of speed.

name: mantle of the woodsman
descriptions: The rangers that first scouted these lands were proud owners
of these deep green cloaks. Imbued with protection from
various elements these cloaks allowed them to withstand the
harsh wilderness for months at a time.

name: marble
descriptions: This large marble square is beautifully-made, and has a
bright shine as if just polished. Its beauty is only marred
by the letter "N" which has been carved onto it's surface.

name: marble orb
descriptions: This small marble orb is beautifully-made, and quite smooth
to the touch.

name: marble pedestal
descriptions: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor.
Fashioned from some of the most exquisite marble you have
yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor
is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the
structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a
large block of marble to close the gap.

name: marble pedestal
descriptions: This intricately designed pedestal was most likely magically
crafted out of raw marble. Four prongs break out from the
top to grasp a magnificent crystal gem which sits directly
in the center of the pedestal. You notice the crystal seems
to glow with an inner blue light.

name: marble statue
descriptions: This is a white marble statue of a ten foot tall knight in
full plate armour. He stands before you, wielding a
greatsword high in the air. It hangs just above the pedestal
as if prepared to drop it down at any moment upon the
crystal.

name: marsh light
descriptions: This strangely-crafted lamp is made out of a slightly opaque
glass. A pale, flickering green light dances within it,
seeming to whisper odd and disturbing things. Around the
lamp is a black iron frame, with a handle affixed to the
top.

name: massive black doors
descriptions: These huge, ominous doors are crafted from jet-black stone,
and tower a good twenty feet above you. They are simple and
unornamented, and their only significant feature is the
smaller, locked entrance door providing a way through.

name: massive black gem
descriptions: This gem is finest cut diamond you have seen in your life
of adventure. It seems to pulse with a deep, seductive
blackness, each one throbbing your temple, pounding
against the back of your skull. You find it hard to resist
the urge to grasp the gem and claim it as your own.

name: massive boulder
descriptions: This massive stone is the color of dried blood and smells
heavily of sulphur. It is hot to the touch, as if a fire
burned deep within. It has been squarely placed in your
path, blocking any further passage through here.

name: massive canvas tent
descriptions: This huge tent appears to be of relatively good make, and is
supported in the middle by a heavy wooden pole. Apparently
it only houses one being, as there is only one bed, the rest
of the room being filled with odd knicknacks, large skulls
hung on the walls, and an impressive collection of dull
shoddy weapons.

name: massive chest
descriptions: This huge black chest is carved from some sort of glossy sto
surface is smooth and marbled with grey.

name: massive wooden chest
descriptions: This huge wooden chest is crafted from heavy pine. It is
simply made, but very sturdy. It has no lock, and when moved
things can be heard rattling around inside it.

name: massive wooden club
descriptions: This huge wooden club is over six feet in length. Wieldable
by only the strongest fighters, this weapon is not an
elegant weapon in combat, but it deals massive damage.

name: maul
descriptions: This huge, two-handed mace is nearly six feet in length. It
is so massive that you have difficulty even lifting it, and
the damage it does in combat must be incredible, although it
is incredibly slow. Only the strongest can wield this weapon
with any effect.

name: medal of flame
descriptions: This medal has been formed into the a flame from some type
of alien, white metal. Crimson paint has been used to colour
it in spots, and inscribed upon it are the words:
"Order of the Crimson Flame"

name: metal plate
descriptions: This square metal plate is somewhat larger than a human's
hand-span, and is set in the side of the passageway's wall
beside the dead-end.

name: metallic parchment
descriptions: A thin metal sheet crackles with powerful energy, sparks
jet from all over the page. Bright blue sygils of power
can be seen very clearly on this metal page and they appear
to be written in the language of druids.

name: meteorite rod
descriptions: This three-foot rod is crafted from one of the few metals
available in the desert-- meteorite ore. Heavy and ornately
engraved, it is curved around at the end like a cane. It is
a symbol of the pharaoh's eternal rule, and feels warm to
the touch.

name: midnight glare
descriptions: Used traditionally this knife would most likely be the
fastest weapon ever created, the blade however is not
built well for this, designed specifically to be thrown
at the opponent. This knives blade is about five inches
long, and the handle about two inches. The blade is made
of a strange blue metal that when held is nearly invisible.

name: midnight sash
descriptions: This sash is made of some type of material which feels as
fine as silk, but it seems to absorb any light around it.
Holding it in your hands it seems to tingle your fingers,
and you can see tiny runes stitched into the thread in some
alien language.

name: mine pass
descriptions: This small wooden card is etched with the symbol of the
Miner's Guild of Khazarad. Only people bearing this pass
may enter the mines.

name: mining helm
descriptions: This is a large metal hat with a hollow at the top for
placing a candle or other light source. Currently a glowing
stone has been placed there, naturally glowing with a
phosphorescent tinge. It can offer decent protection for the
head as well as decent light for underground tunnels.

name: minor healing potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering red
elixir. It is closed by a simple cork stopper.

name: minotaur horn
descriptions: This curved black horn is three and a half feet in length.
As you examine the tip and see the dark stains of dried
blood it is evident that it once belonged to a very mighty
minotaur of great brute strength. According to ancient myth
the horn of a minotaur can be used for magical components or
as a musical instrument.

name: minotaur statue
descriptions: This crudely-wrought statue easily fills the entire wall
from floor to ceiling. It depicts a hideous bull-headed
creature with the muscular torso of a man, and hairy legs
with cloven hooves. It wields a massive greataxe, and the
expression on its face is one of sadistic joy. You notice
some words scratched into the floor next to the statue.

name: mirrored choli
descriptions: Strips of variously colored and printed fabrics have
been stiched together to form this tight fitting,
long-sleeved, raffish blouse. Paired swirls draw attention
to the upper chest, while each horizontal layer of fabric
is alternated with a row of mirror-embedded cloth.
Silvery runes glimmer near each mirror eyelet.

name: mirrored shield
descriptions: This is a perfectly round shield of steel. Its face has been
polished to a literally mirrorlike shine, and its
reflection is dazzling.

name: mithril-runed tunic
descriptions: This light, exquisitely beautiful tunic is made of the
finest leathers, engraved with spectacular mithril-inlaid
runes. An aura of power radiates from its surface in waves.

name: mithril bracelets
descriptions: This pair of finely crafted metal is made of dwarven
mithril. They are snug fitting and cover your wrists, almost
reaching your elbows. The left is adorned with black
etchings, and the right hand is detailed in white.

name: mithril chain leggings
descriptions: Several very tiny chain links, are all woven together
to form an almost impenetrable pair of leggings. You
can tell by their shine that they've been made of
dwarven mithril, and wonder if they belonged to some
lord or powerful warrior.

name: mithril chainmail boots
descriptions: This is a pair of elven leather boots, covered with
dwarven-crafted mithril links of chain. It is exceedingly
rare for the elves and the dwarves to combine their
methods of craftsmanship, but the result is
precious indeed. The boots provide excellent protection
without hindering stealthy movement.

name: mithril chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This chainmail shirt is crafted from mithril, the strongest
substance known to exist. The dwarves are the only ones
known to have the skill to fashion mithril, and such exotic
wonders are rare and precious.

name: mithril cutlass
descriptions: This three-foot-long blade is crafted out of the finest
metal known -- mithril. Its blade is so keen it could cut a
hair, and its balance is perfect. Its slightly-curved blade
can slice through steel and flesh with equal ease.

name: mithril dwarven axe
descriptions: This razor-sharp axe has been crafted with the hands of a
master. Form from mithril, the crescent moon blade has the
markings of dwarven tongue inscripted in gold upon it. You
are awed by the balance and sharpness of this weapon.

name: mithril earrings
descriptions: Tiny rings of mithril have been linked together to form a
circular pattern. Looking closely you see that one has a
small dent in it, and realize they have been worn before.

name: mithril executioner's axe
descriptions: This huge axe has a gigantic, single-edged blade crafted
from pure mithril. Its fine edge could cut stone as easily
as flesh, due to such cruelty in combat it is only useable
by those soley dedicated to evil. While it is large and
heavy, the blade moves marvelously quick.

name: mithril helm
descriptions: This gorgeous full-helm has been crafted to look like the
head of a dwarven king. Atop it a golden crown has been
affixed, and the faceplate is crafted in the likeness of a
stern dwarf-face. The helm glimmers slightly and is
completely unscratched.

name: mithril plate gauntlets
descriptions: This pair of gauntlets are made of the purest mithril,
shining brightly in the light. They appear very heavy,
but are surprisingly light when you pick them up. You
can tell from the craftsmanship that they were
fashioned by a master-smith.

name: mithril plate leggings
descriptions: This pair of leggings are made of the purest mithril,
shining brightly in the light. They appear very heavy,
but are surprisingly light when you pick them up. You
can tell from the craftsmanship that they were
fashioned by a master-smith.

name: mithril ring
descriptions: This small, intricate ring is made of pure mithril, and is
carved in the shape of many intertwining bodies. Tiny
diamonds are set for eyes, and the ring glitters brightly
in the light. Its exquisite craftmanship means it was likely
a dwarf lord's prized possession.

name: molding parchment
descriptions: Parchment written on paper now molding with age, you can
only interpret the following before the scroll becomes
unreadable...

name: moldy key
descriptions: This large, heavy iron key is covered with a thin layer of
mold and fungus. It appears to be quite old and abused.

name: monkey totem
descriptions: This small golden statue of a monkey is nearly freezing
to the touch.

name: moon-lamp
descriptions: This intricate creation is an invention of the desert-
dwelling Nekojin. It is a specially-enchanted crystal orb,
which when exposed to the moon's rays captures this light
and radiates it. It is held in a wooden box, much like a
lantern.

name: moonblade
descriptions: This finely-made sword glows with a silvery light. It is
extremely sharp and seems to be made of some sort of
translucent metal. Pale yellow runes engraved into its
surface glow softly.

name: moonstone
descriptions: This small, semi-precious stone is semi-opaque, and is white
with a pale blue hue.

name: moonstone
descriptions: This large, semi-precious stone is semi-opaque, and is white
with a pale blue hue. Its beauty is marred by the letter "N"
that has been burnt onto its surface.

name: moonstone pedestal
descriptions: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor.
Fashioned from some of the highest quality moonstones you
have yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor
is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the
structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a
moonstone of large size to close the gap.

name: moonstone ring
descriptions: This beautiful silvery ring is made of three intertwining
bands. Set in the centre is a cluster of three moonstones
which glow with a soft light.

name: moonstone rod
descriptions: This rod of moonstone glows a spectrum of pale blue, white
and gold. Three feet in length, it is engraved with silver
markings that run along the rod. At one end of the rod you
see it is wrapped in some type of silver metal to use as a
grip for this crushing weapon.

name: morning-star
descriptions: This is a spiked steel ball, attached by chain to a two-foot
wooden rod. It does good damage, as when it is swung the
ball reaches great speeds, but is not too fast or wieldy.

name: morningstar ring
descriptions: A beautiful ring, crafted of platinum and gold, it has been
fashioned to appear as if sunlight were clustered around
your finger. Written inside the band are the words of holy
tongue, they speak "Bless the Sun, Lifegiver."

name: mountain of rubble
descriptions: This gigantic cave-in has completely sealed the entrance to
this cave. There is no apparent way out...

name: mouthpiece
descriptions: You see a mouthpiece used for a musical instrument made of
platinum. A single rune that of an O with a swirl in the
center is the only marking on it.

name: mulled wine
descriptions: This small wooden cup is filled with a quantity of strong,
heated wine.

name: multicoloured sash
descriptions: This is a six-foot-long, rainbow-coloured silken sash, worn
about the waist. Its brilliant patterns are the result of
a cunning dye process. Sewn into the edges are runes of
a mithril thread so thin that it is almost invisible.

name: multicoloured staff
descriptions: This sparkling staff is crafted out of four colored pieces
of alien metal. Blue, red, brown, and yellow light seem to
dance up and down its length, glowing about your fingers in
delight. A single, silvery ball is set atop the staff,
clutched by each of the four coloured pieces.

name: mummified miner
descriptions: The twisted shape of a dead miner lays here in a corner.
Mummified by the heat and dryness, his face remains forever
locked in a horrible soundless scream. His legs have been
crushed beneath a heavy sandstone boulder. One of his arms
is outstretched, and sitting on the ground a few feet away
from his clawlike hand is a tattered leather pouch.

name: mutilated corpses
descriptions: Many disemboweled bodies have been hung by meathooks here
to allow easy access by whatever filthy beast consumes them.
The stench here is incredible, making you gag and forcing
you back.

name: mutilated corpses
descriptions: Several bodies lie in piles along the floor here, all of
them with various parts cut from them, sliced away as if
they were choice cuts of meat. Some of the bodies you can
tell have been here for some time, others look recently
fresh.

name: naginata
descriptions: A lightweight 6-foot long pole wiht a curved blade on the
end. The naginata reminds you of a halberd, but is lighter
and easier to maneuver in combat. The pole is made from some
unrecognizeable wood. It is thick and sturdy, but very
light. The blade at the end is long enough that it could
easily have been crafted into a sword instead.

name: net
descriptions: This net is crafted from the vines of a strange plant that
grows near the tasloi village. It is perfect size and weight
to carry comfortably and toss easily. It is also perfect
size to entrap a man.

name: netherworld hammer
descriptions: This massive, heavy weapon is crafted from the essence of
tortured souls. Their low moans continually escape from the
grotesquely shifting surface of the hammer, and the stink
of rot and burning flesh exudes from every pore of the
weapon. A single crimson fang is carved into the top of
the head.

name: nexus blade
descriptions: This blade crackles with immense energy. Made from a strange
silvery metal it glitters along the edge of the blade.
The hilt is elaborately wrapped with a single piece of fine
silk, which seems to cause the air around it to tingle with
power. The entire sword hums and it seems desperate to be
used in combat.

name: nexus chakram
descriptions: This exotic weapon is a razor-sharp circle of gleaming
steel, which, when thrown, magically returns to its wielder.
The blade is three inches wide, with the weapon being one
foot in diameter. Strange runes inscribed upon its surface
glow fiercely.

name: nexus ore
descriptions: This dense metal is shocking to touch and almost seems to
tingle your every sense. The large chunk of ore is about the
size of someone's head, and is very heavy.

name: nexus portal
descriptions: This square block of energy seems to pulsate violently with
life. Power reaches out from all sides, seeking release from
its prison. Visions of a dark passage seem to erupt over the
surface intermittently, and you realize this is a physical
portal, leading to places unknown.

name: nexus spear
descriptions: This long, slender spear is crafted out of a glittering
silvery metal. Blue sparkles of energy crackle forth
periodically, leaving the smell of ozone in the air. It
radiates an aura of intense power, and is lethal in the
hands of a skilled fighter.

name: nightblack portal
descriptions: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic
power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving
you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure
death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty
heroes.

name: nightblack portal
descriptions: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic
power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving
you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure
death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty
heroes.

name: nightblack scythe
descriptions: This huge, heavy scythe is as black as eternal night, and
radiates a strange aura of death. Its shaft is set with
ivory skulls, its blade is long, curved, and sharp as a
razor. A sense of evil invades your senses, and you feel as
if gazing at this grisly weapon taints your soul.

name: ninja battle armour
descriptions: This cunningly-crafted suit of armour is made from bamboo
and a strange, thin black leather. It is very light yet
strong, and provides ample freedom of movement with a
maximum of protection.

name: ninjato
descriptions: This finely-crafted steel blade is honed to a razor-sharp
edge, and bears an ornately-designed wooden hilt.

name: oak chest
descriptions: This medium-sized chest is of simple but elegant
construction. Long, interlocking planks of sanded oak form
its rectangular shape, and the clattering of object can be
heard from within when it is moved.

name: oak chest
descriptions: This medium-sized chest is of simple but elegant
construction. Long, interlocking planks of sanded oak form
its rectangular shape, and the clattering of object can be
heard from within when it is moved.

name: oaken staff
descriptions: This heavy oaken staff appears to be carved with strange
druidic runes and symbols. It is extremely hard and sturdy.

name: obsidian claymore
descriptions: A massive one-handed sword, it has been crafted from the
stone of obsidian. Waves of fire erupt from the blood red
symbols that run up the blade. The hilt is entwined with a
strange black fabric that allows you to handle it. It hisses
as it moves through the air, leaving a trail of flame.

name: obsidian field plate
descriptions: This is a corselet of finely-crafted obsidian, inlined with
a thick layer of soft leather padding. Its shoulder guards
each have three large spikes protruding from them, making
side attacks difficult. Swirling runes cover the surface,
seeming to dance mesmerizingly in grand, complex patterns.

name: obsidian key
descriptions: This is a large shiny key carved from obsidian stone. Its
handle is wrapped with silver thread.

name: obsidian mountain carving
descriptions: This exquisite sculpture is carved to represent a jagged,
treacherous mountain range. It is affixed to the stone altar
upon which it sits, however it seems able to be moved
slightly.

name: obsidian obelisk
descriptions: This tall, pointed obelisk is night-black and as smooth as
glass. Intricate runes carved into its surface emanate a
strange aura of power.

name: obsidian runestaff
descriptions: This is a six-foot-long staff of a glossy jet black
substance. Its surface is heavily carved with swirling runes
which seem to pulse and glow redly with an inner light.

name: obsidian stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is glassy and jet black in
colour.

name: obsidian talisman
descriptions: This small, circular disk is heavily engraved with intricate
runes, and emanates a strange aura of power. It is quite
heavy for its size, and when touched makes the hair stand on
end.

name: obsidian trident
descriptions: Three prongs of obsidian stick froth from a shaft of burnt
silverwood. Two-handed it is somewhat heavy to wield, yet
the prongs look to be crafted to dole out the most pain of
traditional weapons. A single crimson flame is stamped on
each spearhead, showing the markings of some lost order.

name: ogre-skin baldric
descriptions: The elegance of this baldric is found in its simplicity and
its plain utility. The thick hide of an ogre has been
tanned and studded with steel to provide excellent
protection.

name: ogre-skin shirt
descriptions: This heavy shirt is made from the thick, boiled skin of an
ogre. Known for their toughness, Ogres are usually unwilling
to part with their skin, but when the occasion arises it
makes excellent armour.

name: ogre bone bracelet
descriptions: Strange magical runes dot the length of the leather thong
that holds together the bones of a monstrous ogre.

name: oily potion
descriptions: This large glass bottle is brimming with an oily fluid that
looks to be filled with large crimson blobs, floating and
congrealing together, sloshing the bottle around makes a
quiet revolting appearence.

name: onion
descriptions: This globe-shaped bulb is slightly smaller than your hand,
and is composed of many concentrically arranged layers.
It is yellowish in color, and each layer is paper-thin.

name: onyx earrings
descriptions: Dark onyx set against an ebony backing make up this pair of
earrings. Crafted with great percision and expertise, these
show no sign of tarnish or age. Obviously of great value,
these earrings may be of vast worth at a jeweler.

name: onyx emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCONYX.EMB

name: onyx stone
descriptions: This small, semi-precious stone is black and shiny.

name: opal
descriptions: This small gem is a pale blue in colour, with green and gold
mottling.

name: opal brooch
descriptions: This intricate brooch is heavily encrusted with small opals
arranged into the official royal insignia of the monarchy.
It is a sign of very high rank or achievement.

name: opal ring
descriptions: This heavy platinum ring is set with a massive opal, carved
by some magical means in the shape of a skull. Sinister
runes are etched along the length of the shining band.

name: orange banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCORAN.BAN

name: orange key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright
orange, you can assume to match whatever house it belongs
to.

name: orange keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate orange keys.

name: orange parchment deed
descriptions: A moderately worn piece of parchment sealed with orange wax,
stamped with an anchor and rope. The handwriting is plain but
clear. This deed grants ownership of a gang hall capable of
housing up to 350 members.

name: orange potion
descriptions: This is a large glass flask, the bottom half of which is
wrapped in a leather covering. A thick orange liquid sloshes
about within. Upon the stopper is carved a clenched fist.

name: orange robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: orc-head
descriptions: This bloody head once belonged to a foul, vicious orc. Now
its blank eyes stare out dully in death, and ichor leaks
from its ruined neck.

name: ornate black key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted black with a single
onyx in its head.

name: ornate blue key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of sime kind. It is painted dark blue and a single
sapphire is set in the head.

name: ornate dragon carving
descriptions: Made from some ornate blackened wood, it depicts a dragon
claws outstretched and flame ablaze in full splendor. A
magnificent depiction it seems lifelike from the tiny eyes
to the sharp fangs of the tiny maw. The carver was immensely
skilled in the ways of working wood.

name: ornate gold key
descriptions: This key is made purest gold, with complicated ridges from
handle to end, indicating the lock probably belong to a
vault of some kind. A single crown is stamped on the head.

name: ornate green key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted dark green and a single
emerald is set in the head.

name: ornate orange key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted dark orange and a single
topaz is set in the head.

name: ornate panther carving
descriptions: Made from a single piece of darkest blackwood, it depicts a
panther, ready to strike. A superb representation, it seems
lifelike from the brutal fangs of the gaping jaw to the
razor-sharp claws on the meticulously detailed paw.
The artist must have been quite an expert at carving.

name: ornate red key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted a dark red and a single
ruby is set in the head.

name: ornate silver key
descriptions: This key is made of purest silver, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. A single horse head is stamped on the
head.

name: ornate violet key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted dark violet and a single
amethyst is set in the head.

name: ornate white key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted white and a single
massive diamond is set in the head.

name: ornate yellow key
descriptions: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges
from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to
a vault of some kind. It is painted dark yellow and a single
piece of amber is set in the head.

name: padded black boots
descriptions: This is a pair of padded black boots. They come up to mid-
shin and are quilted as to reduce noise. This is the
footwear of choice for stealth-minded adventurers.

name: padded boots
descriptions: These knee-length boots are made of heavy quilted cloth,
with coiled rope soles. They provide little protection, and
are fairly heavy, but they are better than nothing.

name: padded gloves
descriptions: These heavy gloves are made of a canvas-like cloth, crudely
stitched. They are a common sight on any working man's hands
as they protect well from chafing, and provide some
protection from damage.

name: padded helm
descriptions: This is an open-face helmet made out of heavy quilted cloth.
Its multiple layers of crude cloth make it fairly heavy for
