its meagre protection, but it is better than entering combat
without one. A bare head makes an inviting target to
opponents.

name: padded pants
descriptions: This is a simple pair of heavy cloth pants. They are of
questionable quality, and are tailored to fit nearly anyone.
A rope is tied about the waist to keep them up.

name: padded vest
descriptions: This is a heavy vest made out of crudely-quilted cloth. It
is one-size-fits-all, with a rope belt to cinch the waist.
It provides decent protection, but is very heavy for its
combat worth.

name: painting
descriptions: This large painting is set in a plain wooden frame. It is
covered with a thick layer of dust, and is somewhat worse
for wear. However, this couldn't possibly make the woman in
the painting less attractive, as she is possibly the ugliest
woman you have ever seen. A face only a son could love, and
that must have been the case, as at the bottom is "Mother".

name: paired dragonblades
descriptions: Twin blades, masterfully crafted, they have been honed to a
razor-sharp edge. One is pure white, with glowing blue
scales that make it look like a serpentine tail. The other
is black with a dark red pall to it, glowing in counter
with its white twin. A small dragons claw make up the hilt
of each blade. The white holds a jet, the black a diamond.

name: palace key
descriptions: This intricate golden key is engraved with the name of King
Yeshuz.

name: pale green lichen
descriptions: This tough, acrid-smelling lichen looks quite unappetizing.
Bits of dirt and moisture can be seen trapped within it.

name: palm tree
descriptions: This tall, slender tree is topped with long, jagged green
leaves, and bears a cluster of round brown fruit.

name: papyrus scroll
descriptions: This ancient, crumbling scroll is made from a coarse-grained
papyrus plant. Printed on its surface in faded ink is a holy
prayer.

name: partially concealed hole
descriptions: This large hole is somewhat hidden by a number of tentacle-
like organs forming a crude door. The pulse and move as you
watch them. The hole is easily wide enough to allow entry.

name: partially digested body
descriptions: This is the body of a creature of unknown race, its skin
melted away, a milky fluid covering it. Its flesh is
embedded with pale, oval-shaped eggs the colour of maggots,
though they have all been broken and ooze liquid. It is
impossible to determine who, or what, the body once was.

name: patch of black mushrooms
descriptions: These small mushrooms are jet black in colour, and have a
distinctly distasteful odour. Their stalks are long and
spindly, their caps wide and thin.

name: path
descriptions: This is a narrow gravel path, threading its way through the
confusing labyrinth of hills known as the Dragon's Teeth. It
is somewhat difficult to keep one's bearing, as all the
hills look nearly the same, and the sheer rocky faces are
too tall and jagged to climb for a good look at the
surroundings.

name: pearl
descriptions: This small, precious stone is pure white and seems to glow
in the light.

name: pearl
descriptions: This large, precious stone is pure white and seems to glow
in the light. Its beauty is marred by the letter "N" which
has been charred onto its surface.

name: pearl pedestal
descriptions: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor.
Fashioned from some of the most perfect pearls you have yet
seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is
amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the
structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a
pearl of large size to close the gap.

name: pearl ring
descriptions: This elaborately-carved platinum ring is set with a huge
opalescent pearl. The band is made to resemble intertwined
vines, with small leaves forming the clasps which hold the
pearl.

name: peasant cloak
descriptions: The humble look of this ratty cloak hides it's true power.
Owned by generations of quiet monks who spent life times
training in the arts, these cloaks provide the insight and
fighting knowledge of generations past.

name: Pen and Paper
descriptions: "Kill Oz"

name: petrified mace
descriptions: A mace fashioned from wood has now been aged into stone,
it has been fashioned to appear as if two snakes were
intertwining to grasp the head of the mace in either maw.
Despite the heavy look it is very light to wield.

name: petrified stone corselet
descriptions: A gigantic piece of stone makes up this "corselet".  It is
roughly chiseled to look like plate armor, but that doesn't
change that it's still a massive piece of rock. It would
fend off just about any attack on your torso, you only to
worry about the rest of your body when wearing this
massive chest protector.

name: pew
descriptions: A plain church pew, with a simple cushion spanning its
length. It looks to be made of oak, and still smells faintly
of it. There is nothing remarkable about this seat of faith.

name: pewter door
descriptions: These massive pewter doors are beautifully carved with all
manner of wild beast, including a good many who obviously
are not from this land. They must be enchanted as they open
with ease, despite their obvious weight.

name: pewter tankard
descriptions: This is a heavy pewter tankard, dented from extreme use in
bar brawls. Traces of vomit can be seen within.

name: phoenix feather
descriptions: This brilliant golden feather burns with a fiery hue. Rare
and priceless, feathers of the legendary phoenix are only
ever found in the possession of those who have aided the
creature in some way.

name: pickaxe
descriptions: This large tool has a heavy metal head, one side of which
has a curved spike, the other sporting a broad axe-like
blade. It is indispensible to miners, who use it to hack
out the rock and then to break it up to expose the ore. It
also makes a good weapon.

name: piece of amber
descriptions: This small, fancy stone is a transparent golden colour, and
is highly prized in certain primitive villages.

name: piece of black chitin
descriptions: This is a large, mostly undamaged piece of a violet-black
chitin. It is flexible, able to be bent fairly easily, but
is also extremely strong and hard to puncture.

name: piece of crystal
descriptions: This small, semi-precious stone is clear and multi-faceted.
It shines brilliantly in the light.

name: piece of jade
descriptions: This small, fancy stone is a milky green in colour.

name: piece of shell
descriptions: This section of turtle shell is about one foot in diameter.
It is extremely thick and seems almost unbreakable. A very
heavy blow must have shattered the original shell.
Unfortunatly, it appears to be too small to use as a shield.

name: pig on a spit
descriptions: This is a fat, greasy, roasted pig impaled on a wooden spit.
Slowly cooked over a fire, it is delicious but extremely
fattening.

name: pike
descriptions: This is a six-foot-long spear. It is too long to be used
very well, but provides good defense, and does considerable
damage.

name: pile of digested bodies
descriptions: This is probably the most disgusting sight you have ever
seen. A dozen or so bodies have been partially eaten away by
the milky-white fluid which covers them, and pale white eggs
embedded in their flesh lay broken and oozing. It is
impossible to distinguish what race each body is, as they
have been mutilated beyond recognition.

name: pile of rubble
descriptions: Examining the piles of massive rock that lie here, you see a
crack close to the wall, just big enough to walk through.

name: pile of spectral webbing
descriptions: This is a wet pile of webbing that looks to have come from
some beast of an undead nature. It is very cold to the touch
and almost feels as if it were sucking the life from you.
It is most beautiful to behold and while it appears
delicate, feels as sturdy as the thickest rope.

name: pine wand
descriptions: This long, slender pine wand is smoothly carved, and is
engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: pipe
descriptions: This thick, silvery pipe glistens with cool condensation.
Seams in the metalwork are sealed tightly with rivets, and
fresh water drips down periodically. Judging from the
workmanship, it is likely the handiwork of gnomes.

name: pipe
descriptions: This filthy, slimy pipe reeks with a disgusting scent.
Partially concealed just inside, however, is a two-way
switch!

name: pixie wings
descriptions: These wings are very durable, despite how thin they are.
When you hold them up to the light, rainbow patters shine to
the floor below. They are beautiful to look at, and silken
to the touch.

name: plain scroll
descriptions: A plain scroll made of simple paper, it appears to be
some sort of official document from years ago...

name: plaque
descriptions: The scripture of the name is in very old fashion, possibly
ages old. You notice in the center of the O appears to be a
small indentation, a button of some sort.

name: plaque
descriptions: This rectangular plaque is inscribed with the following:
"This Recycler Cube is used to get rid of old or unwanted
items. It will only accept select items, but the items it
does accept are those which most shopkeepers do not. Simply
SELL the item here, and an appropriate gold reimbursement
will arrive through the slot."

name: plaque on gate
descriptions: This ornate iron gate is tall and spike-topped, and would
easily prevent entry by scaling. Its thick bars make any
thought of bashing it down immediately flee your head. A
beautiful platinum plaque set in the gate sports seven
glittering stones -- ruby, emerald, diamond, amethyst,
sapphire, onyx and topaz -- and looks somewhat like this:

name: plate boots
descriptions: This is a pair of steel plate sollerets, lined with leather
on the inside for comfort. Despite this precaution, however,
they are not comfortable at all, although they provide great
defense against attack.

name: plate gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of steel plate gauntlets. They are heavy and
durable, and provide great protection. They have an open
leather palm for increased grip.

name: platinum bracers
descriptions: These thin silver bracers would be plain if not for the
strange, swirling runes engraved along them. The metal seems
warm and strangely pliant, as if some unnatural life lurked
within.

name: platinum greathelm
descriptions: This is a massive helm of platinum that once belonged to a
knight or noble lord. It still shines brightly and it seems
to tell a story of chivalry and deeds of valour.

name: platinum greatsword
descriptions: This is a massive platinum blade four feet in length. It
appears incredibly sharp and you wonder if it could cleave
a man in two. Requiring two hands to wield, and massive
strength to even use, this sword would cause huge amounts
of damage in battle and you can only hope you will never
face such a weapon in combat.

name: platinum key
descriptions: A small key made of platinum it seems to weigh as much as
a feather. Something is enscripted on the key, but it is not
in a language you recognize.
worthless.

name: platinum mace
descriptions: This well-balanced mace has a round head made out of
reinforced platinum, with a shaft of black iron. Its head is
inscribed with holy symbols, and there is a powerful aura of
power surrounding it.

name: platinum plate boots
descriptions: This is a pair of plate boots, lined with soft leather, and
fashion from platinum. The plates shine with a life of their
own, and ornate carvings show great mastery was used in the
making of these boots.

name: platinum plate gauntlets
descriptions: These heavy plate gauntlets have been fashioned from the
finest platinum you have seen. They look very sturdy and
able to protect hands from harm. Great care has been taken
to inscribe silver words of prayer upon each knuckle.

name: platinum plate leggings
descriptions: This is pair of heavy plate greaves, made using the purest
platinum you have ever seen. They are extremely thick and
provide excellent leg protection. They almost shine with an
inner glow of magic.

name: platinum ring
descriptions: This small, shiny platinum band is unadorned but is very
beautiful in a simple sort of way. It is perfectly round,
and isn't scratched in the slightest, which is a testament
to its maker.

name: platinum tiara
descriptions: This light crown is extremely simple but classically made.
It is a single band of platinum, delicately etched and set
with a single eye-sized sapphire at the brow.

name: poisoned shuriken
descriptions: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding
from its edge. A dull black substance has been smeared on
the points.

name: poisoned shuriken
descriptions: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding
from its edge. A dull black substance has been smeared on
the points.

name: polished key
descriptions: This key is made from hard black volcanic rock. It's been
polished to a high sheen. When you hold it too tightly in
your hand, you have a slight feeling in the pit of your
stomach.

name: pot-helm
descriptions: This is an iron helm with noseguard and leather neck-guard.
It is the helm of choice for most guardsmen and warriors, as
it is not too heavy, but protects well.

name: potato
descriptions: This swollen root has brown dirty skin and yellow starchy
flesh. It is oblong and round, though quite unevenly, as
in some places it seems concaved in.

name: potion of levitation
descriptions: This small glass vial has a bulbous round bottom, and is
filled with a bubbling white liquid. Stamped on its cork is
a pair of wings.

name: practice dummy
descriptions: This large stuffed dummy hangs from a wooden frame, and is
used to test combat skills and weapons. It is mildly
enchanted so that it can take a hearty beating and still
remain intact.

name: prismatic claymore
descriptions: This blade of four feet has been crafted from an alien metal
of ever-changing colours. The sword looks quite sharp and
hums with magical energy. Five gems have been fashioned into
the hilt: amber, amethyst, onyx, ruby and emerald. Each one
is marked with a small silver rune and they all seem to glow
in unison.

name: prismatic gloves
descriptions: Fashioned from a magical cloth, these gloves sparkle with
ever changing colours. The outside feel smooth to the touch,
but the inside of the gloves seem more sturdy, and a feeling
of warmth flows from them.

name: prismatic robes
descriptions: These brilliant robes reflect the light in the myriad
colours of the rainbow. They are smooth and light like silk,
but are far more durable and are obviously of magical
origin.

name: prismatic skirt
descriptions: This flamboyant skirt glows in a spectrum of colour. Woven
from a fine cloth, the wrap offers comfort and some
durable protection from the ankles to the waist of the
wearer.

name: prismatic slippers
descriptions: This pair of fine slippers are woven out of a cloth that
displays every colour of the rainbow. Smooth as silk,
they are incredibly comfortable, and the warmth that
radiates from them show they are of great magical quality.

name: prismatic trousers
descriptions: These flamboyant pants glow in a spectrum of colour. Woven
from a fine cloth, these leggings offer comfort and some
durable protection from the ankles to the waist of the
wearer.

name: pristine coffin
descriptions: The fashioning of this coffin was done with great care, even
after the many years it has been buried. The coffin is
fashioned of fine oak, with a crest of gold set engraved
into the lid. On the crest the word "Darkbane" is scripted
in graceful, flowing script.

name: pristine scroll
descriptions: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations
necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: pristine scroll
descriptions: The runes of this magical scroll seem to burn into your
brain as you look at them, yet for some reason you cannot
make them out. Only by reading the scroll completely could
anything be learned from it.

name: pulsating heart
descriptions: Thrag's heart continues to pulse with life, long after his
body has given up. By putting this in a magical container,
you could probably preserve it for quite some time. The size
of it reflects how large the beast actually was, and makes
it awkward to handle.

name: pumpkin
descriptions: A massive, telltale orange globe sits at the end of a
long prickly vine. It is naturally pleated, and is
flattened on the side it was laying on to grow. Within
it is a mess of stringy flesh and almond-like seeds,
seeming kind of hollow.

name: quarterstaff
descriptions: This is a six-foot wooden staff, bound about the middle with
strips of cloth. It is a simple weapon, and does not deal
very much damage, but provides good defense as it is quite
quick to use.

name: quartz shard
descriptions: This long shard of quartz is painful to touch for the many
razor sharp points that protrude from it. Pieces granite,
quartz, limestone and other stones jut from it at every
angle, cutting any who touch it.

name: quest token
descriptions: A token signifying you have completed a quest, turn this in
to the proper person and receive your prize.

name: rainbow potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with an ever changing color,
with giant bubbles bursting and reforming inside. It looks
somewhat violatile as if it might explode at any moment.

name: rainbow stone
descriptions: This small, beautiful gem is shaped like a bird's egg, and
glows with a soft light. Its colour slowly cycles through
rainbow's hues in an almost hypnotic fashion. It is hung
upon a fine platinum chain, to be worn about the neck.

name: rapier
descriptions: This excellent weapon has a three-foot length of thin
sharpened steel, designed for thrusting and lunging. It is
marvellously balanced, and greatly improves defense as it is
so quick to maneuver.

name: raven claw
descriptions: This short, thick, double-edge blade is made of a shimmering
material that has a purplish hue to it. The blade itself is
a little over two feet long, and comes straight out of
the hilt before coming to an abrupt, vicious curve.
For those fighting in close quarter, or in stealth attacks,
this weapon looks as though it would fit the job nicely.

name: reading glasses
descriptions: This is a pair of simple reading glasses, known to be worn
by scholars and librarians of old. You note that there is
a second lens inlaid within each frame.

name: red banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCRED.BAN

name: red book
descriptions: A red book with odd lettering on the wooden cover, you open
it and read the following...

name: red chitin armour
descriptions: This red suit of armour is made up of several shells of
some massive crab-creature. It feels incredibly tough
and has been tied together by several glowing vines,
and they seem to have been treated with some strange
mixture that makes it give off a glow.

name: red chitin gauntlets
descriptions: These strange gauntlets appear to have been made out of the
shell plates from some gigantic red crustacean. They are
tied together by some glowing vines, and it appears to have
been treated with some mixture that gives it a fine sheen.

name: red chitin helm
descriptions: This red helmet has been made out of the head plate of
some monster crustacean. It feels very durable for its
slight weight, but the two holes left from the eye
stalks still remind you of its origin.

name: red chitin leggings
descriptions: These bizarre leggings appear to have been made out of the
shell plates from some gigantic red crustacean. They are
tied together by some glowing vines of some sort, and it
appears to have been treated with some mixture that gives
it a fine sheen.

name: red chitin shield
descriptions: This strange shield looks to be crafted from the red
chitin of some large sea-monster. They are interlocked
together and tied by some strange glowing vines. It is
very light and you wonder if any weapon could pierce
its surface.

name: red dragon boots
descriptions: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the
red hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and
are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also
form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: red dragon gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the
hide of a dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the
touch, yet give excellent protection against almost any
attack.

name: red dragon helm
descriptions: This is a sturdy helm of red dragonhide, fashioned with
superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect
the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: red dragon hide
descriptions: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon.
Red as blood it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes jutting
out in some spots. It seems to carry a warmth of its own,
and you wonder if it could be used for some kind of armour.

name: red dragon leggings
descriptions: Blood red dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings.
Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer
powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very
flexible.

name: red dragon tail
descriptions: This long slender tail is aproximately 12 feet in length.
Long black  spines cover it from base to tip. It  is
relativly light in weight and is quite durable In the
hands of a master, this tail could be crafted into a fine
weapon.

name: red dragon tunic
descriptions: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of red dragonhide was
obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along
the back and shoulders give it an almost hellish look,
making its wearer look fearsome indeed.

name: red dragonscale whip
descriptions: This long slender whip is aproximately twelve feet in
length. The handle is made of soft black leather which gives
you excellent control. A large dragon fang is mounted at the
tip of this fine whip.

name: red enameled scalemail
descriptions: This heavy scalemail shirt is crafted from the finest steel.
The scales have been individually lacquered with a crimson
substance, and are polished to a brilliant shine. It feels
unnaturally cool to the touch.

name: red fang
descriptions: This is a four-inch-long fang, red as blood, and somewhat
warm to the touch.

name: red iron axe
descriptions: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single
blade shaped like a half moon. It is crafted from a dark
red metal, that shimmers with an oily sheen. A fine example
of quality dwarven handiwork.

name: red iron dagger
descriptions: This long, heavy dagger is practically the size of a
shortsword. Its blade is razor-sharp, and is made from an
odd blood-red metal that shimmers with an oily sheen. The
weapon is a great example of typical dwarven handiwork.

name: red iron hammer
descriptions: This heavy warhammer has a broad striking head that can
easily beat down the target. It is made of a strange, blood-
red metal, which shimmers with an oily sheen. The weapon is
a good example of quality dwarven handiwork.

name: red iron key
descriptions: This short, heavy key is made of a deep-red metal, and is
somewhat crudely made.

name: red iron ore
descriptions: This dense metal is blood-red, and is extremely hard, with
an almost oily sheen. The chunk of ore is about the size of
someone's head, and is very heavy.

name: red key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple, tellin
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright red,
you can assume to match whichever house it belongs to.

name: red keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate red keys.

name: red leather book
descriptions: A large leather book dyed red, it bears a large yellow flame
on the cover, encircled by birds flying in a clockwise
pattern. On the spine of the book are the letters "A.I."
You open it and turn to the following...

name: red leather book
descriptions: A large leather book dyed red, it bears a large yellow flame
on the cover, encircled by birds flying in a clockwise
pattern. On the spine of the book are the letters "A.I."
You open it and turn to the following...

name: red paisley bandanna
descriptions: A large red cloth square, stiched with a white and black
paisley print, is folded along it's diagonal and tied around
around the head. It looks well worn, so worn in fact, that
the voices of the previous wearers can occasionally be heard
whispering indiscernibly.

name: red parchment deed
descriptions: A crinkled piece of tan parchment sealed with a lump of red wax
pressed with a crude skull stamp. The writing is rough but the
town registry seal makes it binding. It grants ownership of a
basic gang hall with capacity for up to 150 members.

name: red robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but it quite light.

name: red rock key
descriptions: The porous red volcanic rock has been shaped into a thick
key. It seems to absorb body heat and constantly gives off
a warm feeling.

name: red rose
descriptions: An illustrious shade of red paints this rose a magnificent
color in any light. Freshly cut it is still full of life,
as if it inhales the air around it with a new breath each
time. In full bloom the petals seem a delicate piece of
glass, together making a masterpiece only nature can create.

name: red skull
descriptions: This huge horned skull is carved right into the face of the
wall. It is so finely made that is appears to be alive,
leering hideously at you. Its large eye sockets are like
bottomless pits, with no light reflecting from within the
polished holes whatsoever. Its strong jaw is clenched shut,
and its apparently razor-sharp teeth fit perfectly together.

name: red skull
descriptions: Iron, painted red, has been used by expert hands to form a
skull. Two gaping holes form the eye sockets, and the teeth
have been chisled to give the skull a frightening, fanged
leer. Ridges along the back of the skull allow for one hand
to grasp it, as if to show any who would see it's wicked
visage.

name: rigid leather pants
descriptions: This is a pair of soft leather pants with rigid leather
plates sewn onto them for protection. They are only slightly
bulky, and provide fairly good protection.

name: rigid leather tunic
descriptions: This is a boiled leather cuirass. Only slightly flexible, it
has soft leather at the joints and on the arms, and provides
good protection.

name: road
descriptions: This is a poorly-maintained gravel road, covered with dirt
and debris. Black weeds occasionally poke through its
surface. It is hard to tell whether the road is frequented
by a few people, or traveled infrequently by many, as the
tracks are obscured by those of what you presume to be
animals.

name: roast mutton
descriptions: This is a greasy, but well-done joint of mutton. It smells
wonderful!

name: rock outcropping
descriptions: This outcropping of rocks seems to bulge from the sides of
the cavern here. You note they do not seem very attached
to the wall, and could possibly be wrenched from the walls
if someone had adequate strength.

name: rocky waterfall
descriptions: Here the Silver river cascades down a rocky face inside the
cave, crashing down into a dark, frothing pool with a
thundrous roar. Up the side of the waterfall, a crudely-hewn
stair can be seen leading up into the darkness, presumably
to the top of the waterfall.

name: rod of might
descriptions: A rod made from simple iron, it seems almost weightless to
hold. A single marking is the only thing remarkable about
this tool of a ruler. It radiates a certain serenity about
you and piece of mind. This must be the symbol of some great
and powerful lord from long ago, the last remnant of an
extinct dynasty of order that fell to the chaos.

name: rolled parchment
descriptions: Thorand, dire times have caused the writing of this letter.
The fortress is weakening, and Xarthick has fallen to
temptation, the she-devil has gotten to him. If you have any
one that can aid us, send them now. I do not think we can
last another fortnight. Give them this parchment so my
men know not to fight them, they do not trust anyone else.

name: rolled parchment
descriptions: To chieftain Ss'keth'an -- Affairs are proceeding as
planned. You shall be well rewarded for your defense of the
crystal pass. We have many slaves that would suit your needs
admirably. Remember, it is VITAL that no one passes through
the crystal tunnel. See that none do. You know what swift
vengeance would be exacted otherwise.  -- Lord Cambron

name: room ticket
descriptions: This small ticket is good for a night's rest in an inn or
tavern. Usually worth the price, as resting in a comfortable
inn bed is more beneficial than anywhere else.

name: roots
descriptions: These long, snaking roots are about an inch thick and are
greenish-yellow in colour. Their aroma is quite pleasant,
sweet and fragrant as flowers-- a strange find in these
gloomy tunnels. A handful could be gotten with some small
difficulty, by ripping or cutting them out.

name: rope and grapple
descriptions: This is a coil of braided hemp rope, strongly woven and
well-made. It could hold the weight of even the heaviest
adventurer. It is attached to a heavy four-pronged iron
grapple, and is useful for climbing up out of pits or over
obstacles.

name: rope bridge
descriptions: This slender rope bridge is made of plaited elven rope, and
is much stronger than it looks.

name: rosewood rod
descriptions: This heavy rosewood rod is about two feet long, and is
covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: rosewood staff
descriptions: This long, straight staff is quite slender and looks as if
you could snap it in two, but in actuality cannot even be
bent in the slightest. It is plain and unadorned, with the
exception of small runes encircling the top and bottom ends.

name: rotted book
descriptions: Age has not treated this book well, you can barely read
the title:
"Great.....Volume XXVIX"
You open it and find a single coherent passage...

name: rotted tongue
descriptions: The massive, lifeless, tongue of some creation, it is
putridly black, with some off shades of purple. You can
hardly stop from retching at the sight of this dead member.

name: rotted tree
descriptions: This large, twisted tree stands here before you, hunkered
down by disease and rot. It seems on the verge of collapse
were it not for the numerous roots that still stick into the
ground. A large hole surrouneded by mud and gunk is squarely
below the plagued tree, leading below into places unknown.

name: rotted worm skin
descriptions: A large, hollow piece of skin from some great worm, it reeks
of filth and vileness. Though digusting it seems to have an
unending durability that would make avoiding attack
difficult, but deflect the force of the blow.

name: rotten eye
descriptions: White and pupiless, this grotesque organ was once the eye of
some massive beast, but is now totally lifeless and smells
of great decay. It is totally revolting to hold, and
is very squishy.

name: round shield
descriptions: This is a medium-sized round shield. It is a popular shield,
as it is moderately heavy, and provides good defense.

name: round table
descriptions: This massive oak table could easily seat forty people. It
is well-crafted and inlaid with rosewood panels in an
intricate spiralling pattern.

name: rubble
descriptions: Searching through the rubble, you find a stone tile set into
the floor.

name: ruby
descriptions: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering
crimson red in colour, and is highly prized for use in
jewelry.

name: ruby-encrusted bracers
descriptions: You hold a pair of intricately crafted bracers, made of a
the purest mithril, found deep in the dwarven mines of
Khazarad. Encrusted into the metal are many fine, medium
sized rubies. The bracers seem to have a magical magnetism
to them, and naturally pull towards each other. Engraved in
black on the inside of the left bracer is the name: Cyan.

name: ruby-eyed skull ring
descriptions: This shining black ring seems to be made out of an unknown
dark, glittering metal, and is extremely cold to the touch.
A tiny, perfect dark skull is affixed to it, its eyes
burning with an unnatural red flame. The ring has a
noticeable aura of evil surrounding it, as well as one of
extreme suffering.

name: ruby earrings
descriptions: The rubies used to make this pair of earrings have been set
into a white gold backing. They have been shaped into roses.
The petals are so well defined, it must have taken hours to
complete each. At the base of each one is a tiny pair of
emeralds, in the shape of leaves.

name: ruby emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCRUBY.EMB

name: ruby hairpin
descriptions: This sturdy hairpin is covered in tiny diamonds, with 5 tear
shaped rubies making a flower at the tip.

name: ruby key
descriptions: This is a large silver key, with an eye-sized ruby set in
the handle. It is set upon a thick leather thong.

name: ruby key
descriptions: This is a large shiny key carved from ruby. Its
handle is carved in the shape of a flame.

name: ruby necklace
descriptions: This glittering necklace is made of a fine silver chain,
with small rubies set about it in mountings shaped like the
leaves of flowers.

name: ruby ninjato
descriptions: This magnificent blade is amazing to behold. Fashioned from
a collection of bright, crimson rubies, it is single edged,
yet that edge could slice great wounds in any foe. An aura
of heat seems to come from its jeweled surface, and runes
of power have been etched into the stone. A mithril hilt
has been fashioned as a claw, grasping the blade mightily.

name: ruby staff
descriptions: Carved from a maple, this six-foot staff shines as if
freshly polished. A large blood red ruby sits atop the head
of the staff, a faint humming sound can be heard from it.
Strange red runes encircle the staff from the foot to the
head, each glowing of their own accord.

name: rug
descriptions: This beautifully-woven rug is decorated with angular
designs in intricate patterns. Painstakingly handmade, it is
a treasure to own.

name: ruined book
descriptions: This book may once have held the secret to life, the secrets
of the realm, and everything thereafter, but it is now a
novel of dust, with pages flaking into nothingness
as soon as you grab it.

name: ruined book
descriptions: This book may once have held the secret to life, the secrets
of the realm, and everything thereafter, but it is now a
novel of dust, with pages flaking into nothingness
as soon as you grab it.

name: rune-carved staff
descriptions: This four-foot-long oaken staff is etched, rather crudely,
with several tribal sigils and pictograms of some unknown
culture. Several of the pictograms depict a figure holding a
staff in battle against a large ape-like beast, under which
is a strange, unknown script.

name: rune-etched sceptre
descriptions: This golden sceptre is about three and a half feet long, and
is decorated from head to handle in glowing runes. Jeweled
studs ring the head and seem to shine with a life all their
own. Easily swung with one hand, the sceptre seems magically
guided to where you want it to strike.

name: runed cape
descriptions: Flawless white with runes of various colors creating a
tangle of magic upon it these robes have been donned by the
most powerful of magi since the beginning of time. A slight
hum of magical power can be felt by anyone near it.

name: runed chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This steel-link chainmail vest is reinforced with thin
metal plates. It is of exquisite craftsmanship, and the
runes engraved in its surface seem to glitter in the light.

name: runed cowl
descriptions: This midnight-blue hood is inscribed with spiralling silver
glyphs. A fine silver chain attached to it is used to fasten
it to a cloak or shirt.

name: runed farming hoe
descriptions: Six feet of blackwood attach to a black glittering metal
blade. Fiery runes are etched all along the farming tool and
glow with a rhythm of its own. You can only assume some mage
was a farmer in a previous job and created this for some
purpose. You at least hope it was a sane mind.

name: runed key
descriptions: This small red key is inscribed with glittering black runes.
It is very heavy for its size, and seems to glow warmly when
you hold it.

name: runed longbow
descriptions: This slender, curved bow is made of some strange dark wood.
Bright, glowing runes are burned all over the wood from tip
to tip. The tight string that runs down appears to be made
of some strange silk but pulls back as if it were the
strongest cord. A quiver of arrows, also made of the same
darkened wood, come with the bow, their tips a dull red.

name: runed petrified staff
descriptions: This twisted rock staff was once the branch of a bronzewood,
however time has caused it to become unbreakable. Even still
various black and brown runes glow from the staff, carved
long ago, they still have a life to them giving the staff
great magical power.

name: runed robes
descriptions: These midnight-blue robes are inscribed with spiralling
silver glyphs. Silver bands adorn the cuffs, collar and hem.
An aura of arcane power radiates from within.

name: runed sacrificial robes
descriptions: Robes of midnight cloth are adorned with vile runes the
color of blood. On the cuff and color the symbol of a
crimson horned skull is plainly seen. These robes carry an
aura of absolute damnation.

name: runed wrist guard
descriptions: This ornate wrist guard is crafted of fine steel, with
glittering runes of power engraved along it's length.
Artfully cured leather straps bind it's cool, smooth surface
to your wrist and hand, offering superior protection as well
as mobility.

name: runic key
descriptions: This key is inscribed with many strange, intelligible
symbols that seem to writhe as you look at them.

name: runic warhammer
descriptions: This massive, heavy hammer's granite head is intricately
carved with jagged runes of a crude sort. The runes glow
a fierce red and seem to pulsate to your heartbeat. Its
haft is of leather-bound ironwood, and appears well-worn.

name: rusted gate
descriptions: This tall, rusting ironwork gate must once have been a fine
work of art, as its intricate spirals and curves show. Now,
however, it is bent and cannot even fulfill its use as a
gate, for the rust has fused it to the fence. Thick creeping
weeds once entwined through its bars, but have since been
cut and thrown to the side.

name: rusty fence
descriptions: This high ironwork fence is topped by rusty, though still
sharp, spearpoints. Its once-intricate craftmanship is now
marred by the thick brown rust coating its surface and its
bent bars. Creeping weeds entwined between its bars
completely block your view past the fence.

name: rusty iron key
descriptions: This large, heavy key is covered in a layer of thick brown
rust. Engraved in its handle appears to be two words in the
old script, reading "Western Door".

name: rusty scythe
descriptions: This long curved blade is wicked in appearance for such a
benign tool. Stretched out from a curved handle like a
ragged, bloody claw, this farming instrument has seen better
days and those days were many ages ago. While immensely slow
it could cut many a limb off with dreadful precision.

name: sabre
descriptions: This finely-balanced weapon has an extremely sharp blade,
measuring two and a half feet long, and slightly curved. It
is fairly heavy for its length, but is balanced so well that
this makes no difference speedwise.

name: sabre of inquisition
descriptions: This fine blade appears to have been manufactured from
some type of glass or crystal and then hardened using some
chemical mixture. It looks to be very sharp and has a
mithril hilt with a crimson flame etched on its pommel.
Something catches your eye and you see in very tiny letters
the words "Purify or Die" written in flowing script.

name: sacrificed body
descriptions: This is the body of a creature of unknown race, its skin
melted away, a milky fluid covering it. Its flesh is
embedded with pale, oval-shaped eggs the colour of maggots,
though they have all been broken and ooze liquid. It is
impossible to determine who, or what, the body once was.

name: sacrificial dagger
descriptions: This light weight blade appears to be crafted of some black
metal. The blade is very serrated, with skulls engraved all
along its length. A single bloodstone is set in the pommel
and it seems to have a faint glow to it.

name: sacrificial robes
descriptions: These jet black robes are made of a heavy, tightly-woven
cloth. The cuffs, collar and hem are adorned with blood-red
sigils and glyphs. They radiate a definite aura of evil.

name: sadamune-
descriptions: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a
half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a
greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and
the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its
black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: sai
descriptions: A pair of thin blades about a foot long. Each blade has a
curving hilt, giving them the appearance of small hand held
pitchforks. The sai are ideal tools for an opportunistic
ninja to surprise his prey with.

name: salca dart
descriptions: The poison that coats this dart is made from a rare fungas
only upon the upper branches of the trees in the jungle.
Known to cause weakness in muscles, monkey that accidentally
eat it commonly plunge to their deaths unable to hold their
weight going from branch to branch.

name: sandals
descriptions: This is a simple pair of leather thong sandals.

name: sandstone chest
descriptions: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has
been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's
carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its
lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: sandstone tablet
descriptions: This large sandstone slab is crudely engraved with intricate
runes of power, which you recognize as druidic magic.

name: sapling longbow
descriptions: This slender bow is made out of the sapling of some
outlandish forest. The string used is a single glowing
vine, that is tightly wound to the ends of the bow. It
comes with a quiver full of similar sapling-like
arrows, feathered together with a tree-leaf.

name: sapphire
descriptions: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering
medium blue in colour, and is highly prized for use in
jewelry.

name: sapphire bracers
descriptions: Fashioned from a beautiful sapphire gem, and enforced with
powerful magic, these bracers crackle with energy and might.
A glowing warmth radiates from this magical armour, and the
symbol of the Kai Lords can be seen within each bracer.

name: sapphire chakram
descriptions: A razor-sharp circle that shines with immense power. It has
been crafted to appear as if a large white serpent and large
black serpent were fighting over two sapphires, crafted
opposite of each other. Suddenly a wave of electricity runs
through the circle from one sapphire to the next. Etched
on each gem is a scale of balance.

name: sapphire emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCSAPPH.EMB

name: sapphire key
descriptions: This is a large shiny key carved from a large sapphire.
Its handle is carved in the shape of a snowflake.

name: sapphire ring
descriptions: This small silver ring is set with a pale, glittering
sapphire. The gem is as translucent as a piece of ice, and
just as cold.

name: sapphire shard
descriptions: This long shard of sapphire is freezing to touch for it
seems to possess an awesome amount of cold. Inside
the crystal you see a light blue icicle, most likely
fueling the enormous chill it emits.

name: saracen head
descriptions: This severed head is quite revolting. And it stinks. The
desert raiders are apparently not big on personal hygiene.

name: sarcophagus
descriptions: This white stone coffin is seemingly carved out of one huge
piece of rock, and is made in the likeliness of the long-
dead noble for whom it was commissioned. You can see no seam
or binding which would enable it to open.

name: scale gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of soft leather gloves with coin-sized
iron discs sewn onto them. They are heavy, as far as gloves
go, and have leather palms for better weapon grip.

name: scaled lantern
descriptions: A small wiry stock holds this strong smelling lantern at
arms length. Scales and bone house a small, but bright,
glowing ball, which radiates a greenish light.

name: scalemail leggings
descriptions: This is a pair of leather pants with iron discs sewn onto
them as protection. They are a little heavy, but give better
protection than chainmail does.

name: scalemail tunic
descriptions: This is a suit of boiled leather with coin-sized iron discs
sewn onto it. It is a little heavier than chainmail, but
also protects better.

name: scarab necklace
descriptions: A necklace of elaborate design, it is made up of twelve
golden scarabs. Each one looks as if it had been alive, and
dipped into the liquid metal. A single sygil is marked on
each insect. Ancient myth tells of a necklace such as this
protecting the wearer from most things terrifying.

name: scarlet doublet
descriptions: No finer doublet have you ever seen then this piece of
superb sewmanship. Normally worn by noblemen, you pinch the
fabric and realize it is several thousand miniscule chains
interlinked together. An excellent a deception as any, this
could be worn to look like normal clothes but in truth
protect as well as any hauberk.

name: sceptre
descriptions: This heavy glass sceptre feels as cold as ice. Its broad,
flat head is engraved with a single, brightly glowing rune.
The handle is wrapped in white leather, and a thong hangs
from the pommel.

name: scholarly statue
descriptions: An ancient stone statue, fashioned many centuries ago stands
here. You presume the statue is meant to honor a specific
scholar that belonged to the library long ago, but time has
not been merciful and the statue is almost beyond
recognition of any sort. A large stone book is grasped by
the statue, a title was once chiseled onto the cover.

name: scimitar
descriptions: This is a curved sword, about three feet in length, and
bladed upon one edge. It is thin, and fairly light, but can
deliver considerable slashing wounds.

name: scorpion tail
descriptions: This tail yields from one of the white scorpions that live
near the city of Khazarad. Medicine men have long favored
these for various healing concoctions. Charlatans peddle
them at a high price to the lonely as an effective love
potion if ground and served in a drink.

name: scrawling wall
descriptions: Brushing away the dust you can see that someone or something
used a sharp, crude instrument to make the markings on the
wall. It takes some time to read the handwriting but it says
the following: Tis the sword, the hand and the eye, but not
the m.... the rest is unreadable.

name: scrawling wall
descriptions: Brushing away the dust you can see that someone or something
used a sharp, crude instrument to make the markings on the
wall. It takes some time to read the handwriting but it says
the following: Sword, hand, sword, eye, then you die!

name: scrawling wall
descriptions: Brushing away the dust you can see that someone or something
used a sharp, crude instrument to make the markings on the
wall. It takes some time to read the handwriting but it says
the following: "Gem...storage......mouth....back...pray....
opens....way"

detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.
