name: sculpture
descriptions: This odd stone construct is quite smooth, and appears to
have been polished-- it has an almost mirrorlike sheen.
Multicoloured crystals embedded in its surface flash and
pulse with a haunting rhythm. There is a gap in the side,
which may allow entrance inside.

name: sealed letter
descriptions: Once pristine parchment is now stained with a mixture of
dirt, sweat and blood. Yet the seal of the letter, that of a
cat eye inside a rising sun, seems fresh and new.

name: serpent armbands
descriptions: This is a pair of armbands crafted to look like snakes
entwining each arm. Their sinuous spirals are made from some
dull green metal. Each tiny scale is picked out with
marvellous skill, and the serpents' eyes are small rubies.

name: serpent scourge
descriptions: This vicious-looking weapon consists of a cluster of long
lashes attached to an iron handle. Each four-foot leather
lash is painted green and is fitted with a wicked iron tip
crafted in the likeness of a snake's head. A small green
emerald set in the pommel glows malevolently.

name: serpent staff
descriptions: This long, twisted mahogany staff is carved in the form of a
slender snake. Small glittering emeralds in its eyes glow
with an inner fire, and it is warm to the touch.

name: serpentine dagger
descriptions: This long, wavy-bladed dagger is nearly as big as a
shortsword. Its edge is honed to be razor-sharp, and its
black hilt is adorned with a single tiny emerald.

name: serpentine sword
descriptions: This disturbing-looking weapon has a three-foot razor-sharp
blade, wavy like the name suggests. Its black hilt is
adorned with a single tiny emerald in the pommel.

name: serrated battle axe
descriptions: This is a large double-bladed axe, used in one hand. Its
huge, serrated blades are razor-sharp, and jagged runes have
been cut into its haft.

name: serrated bone war-spear
descriptions: A large bone, three-feet in length has been used to craft
this weapon of cruelty. Jagged ridges surround the head of
the spear, formed to cause great agony and bleeding to any
foe unwise enough to challenge the wielder. The butt of
the spear has been hollowed out to appear like that of a
skull.

name: serrated dwarven axe
descriptions: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single
blade shaped like a half moon. The blade has wicked
serrations along its edge, and a thick, green substance has
coated it as well. The workmanship of this axe is shoddy at
best, and looks as though an amateur smith crafted it.

name: serrated scimitar
descriptions: This heavy, sawtoothed scimitar is engraved with harsh
orcish runes. Its hilt and pommel are made of bone, worn
dark with age.

name: serrated spiked shield
descriptions: This medium shield was crafted with pain in mind. A large
spike protrudes from the center, and several serrated barbs
stick out from the front and sides of the shield, giving
the holder a fearsome look in combat.

name: seven-pointed star symbol
descriptions: This star is crafted out of a bluish silver, and its seven
points are evenly spaced about its perimeter. It is set in
the top right corner of the ebony triangle, and although it
is affixed there you get the impression that it is meant to
be moved.

name: severed arm
descriptions: This long arm once belonged to some well muscled humanoid.
It is black and purplish from the severed shoulder down to
the stiff, jagged nails. It smells faintly of rotting but
your sure it would do as a weapon in a pinch.

name: severed earth dragon claw
descriptions: This dismembered claw is the shriveled, dead remains of some
massive dragon. Its skin was once the color of soil, but in
withered form it has blackened some. Five decayed fingers
jut out to end in five very sharp nails. It looks like an
awkward, but usable weapon.

name: severed head of Enigma Lord
descriptions: The bloody head of the undead mystic known as the Enigma
Lord. Even in death his eyes are cold and unforgiving. His
demeanor showing a will of iron, and unbendable force.

name: severed head of Goru-Nezar
descriptions: This large, heavy head once belonged to the ogre-mage lord,
Goru-Nezar. Now its lifeless eyes stare out ominously, and
its tongue lolls out grotesquely.

name: severed head of Irikani
descriptions: Even in death, her visage is one of pure evil, and her
devlish eyes follow you, giving you an ill feeling in the
pit of your stomach. Her hair is coarse and almost burning
to touch, and droplets of crimson occasionaly drop from the
head, splashing on the ground with a smell of sulphur.

name: severed head of Markus
descriptions: This is the gruesome, bloody head of Commander Markus of the
Western Garrison. His once-proud eyes are now glazed and
lifeless, and his once-dark skin is now pale and clammy. His
swollen tongue lolls grotesquely out of his mouth.

name: severed leg
descriptions: This blackened severed leg has belonged to some humanoid of
great strength. Even disattached the muscles are still bulky
and toned. Despite the fact you can hardly stand the rancid
smell you know this would make a crude though morbid weapon.

name: severed purple tentacle
descriptions: This is the deep purple tentacle of a mind flayer, brutally
severed from it's previous owner. It is cold and damp to
touch, and black ichor still oozes occasionally from the
wound.

name: shadow bracelet
descriptions: This dark black bracelet is made of an odd leather than
seems to eat at the surrounding light. Running your finger
along it gives you a strange cool feeling.

name: shadow cloak
descriptions: This nightblack cloak is made from some strange, non-
reflective cloth, and is smooth to the touch. It is not
stirred by the wind or weather, but just hangs motionless.

name: shadow material
descriptions: This strange wispy fragment weighs nothing, and seems to
fade in and out of view. It has an unpleasant feel to it.

name: shadowy ankh
descriptions: This slim cross seems to defy description. One moment it
glows softly, yet is insubstantial, then next becomes
shadowy, occasionally waves of color ripple throughout.
Only a dim red light is always visible at the center. One
leg of the cross is a bit longer, the center of the shorter
is ribbed, and fits your hand comfortably.

name: shadowy corselet
descriptions: This is a heavy platemail corselet eats the light around you
with its blackness. Engraved on the breast is a white
skeletal hand crushing a red skull. The armour is so bulky
it would be hard to avoid not getting hit, but it looks so
massive that it would take any blow with ease.

name: shadowy portal
descriptions: This rift appears as though it were a vertical pool of
shadowy black ink. A chill seems to flow from its edges,
consuming all light, and making your entire body ache with
its warmth-sucking embrace. There is no telling where this
may take you, but it appears to be your only exit.

name: shamanic headdress
descriptions: This strange rustic headdress shows no method to its madness
with the many pieces of leather, twigs, and animal bones
that adorn it. It carries a strange mixed aroma that is
impossible to identify, and it seems to tingle at your touch
as if it carried some form of magical power.

name: sharktooth trident
descriptions: This heavy, two-handed weapon, is made of a most unusual
material. Three jagged prongs covered in razor sharp teeth
jut from a barnacle covered shaft of stone. The construction
of the weapon and the barnacles make it somewhat unwieldy,
but the sharp teeth that litter the prongs would seem to
do enough damage to suffice.

name: shattered skeleton
descriptions: This broken, chewed carcass has evidently been here a long
time, judging by the dirt encrusting its bones. At second
glance, one of the bones seems to be free of blood and dirt,
and sticks out of the ground rather than out of the
skeleton.

name: shattered skeleton
descriptions: This poor adventurer appears to have missed a handhold and
fallen to his death. Chunks of rock and dirt cover its body
and as you look closer, you notice a large silver disk
behind the rubble.

name: shawl of fortune
descriptions: A light wrap that borders between blue and gray these cloaks
had been within the gypsy families for years, lost during
the tragedy of the wars. Many great gypsy princes and wise
fortune tellers have warn these robes and more than a little
of their spirit remains bound to them.

name: shelf
descriptions: This small shelf is quite bare, apart from two large,
ancient-looking books. One of the books has a bright-red
cover, and has small pages, but hundreds of them. The other
is bound with blue cloth, and is slim, but the pages and
cover are at least twice the size of the other.

name: shelf and jars
descriptions: This large shelf is covered in dirt and dust, and many tiny
disgusting creatures crawl about it in squalor. Partially
concealed behind the row of jars is a crude stone button
recessed into the wall!

name: shillelagh
descriptions: This gnarled wooden club is inlaid with brightly glittering
gold. It emanates a strange magical aura.

name: shimmering greatsword
descriptions: This exquisite silvery greatsword is polished to a
mirrorlike sheen. Its hilt is wrapped in cords of gold, and
is heavily worked with holy symbols.

name: shimmering papyrus
descriptions: This coarse-grained paper seems to disappear and reappear at
random intervals. Runes of magic are inscribed in a thick,
black ink. The runes seem to spell out powers that can only
be harnessed by powerful magi.

name: shimmering pool
descriptions: This wide, deep pool is filled with a cool, crystal clear
water. It darkens somewhat towards the centre.

name: shimmering portal
descriptions: A large oblong portal that shimmers with white light. If you
listen quietly, you can hear the energies surging and fading
in rhythm with your heart beating. It looks large enough for
a man to walk through on horseback.

name: shimmering sash
descriptions: This is a six-foot long shimmering silken sash, worn around
the waist. It seems to glow and pulsate with its own light.
You can just make out runes sewn in some tupe of gold thread
but you are forced to look away by the light.

name: shimmering vial
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled to the brim with an oily,
opalescent liquid that glows and shimmers with a pale light.

name: shimmering white robes
descriptions: These extremely plain and unadorned robes seem to made out
of plain cotton, but there is definitely something special
about them that you just can't put your finger on. They are
soft and comfortable, and their mere touch soothes you. Holy
symbols are worked into the hem with a simple stitch.

name: shining metallic robes
descriptions: These heavy garments are made from some seamless, glittering
silvery fabric, which is smooth as silk. A strange energy
courses though the robes, which crackle with sparkling
motes whenever their shining folds are shifted.

name: shining white talisman
descriptions: This small white disk is hung upon a fine platinum chain.
Strange runes are inscribed upon its surface, which read:
"Use me above the pledging room."

name: shintai sword-
descriptions: This simple sword is just under five feet long. Its three
and a half foot blade is sharpened from both sides to the
center. Its steel blade is a dull white colour and near its
tip a single rune is engraved with unpolished gold. Its long
cloth wrapped handle is stained with sweat and shows the
swords extensive use.

name: ship's wheel
descriptions: Aged beyond recognition this wheel that steers the ship has
degenerated into a skeletal circle of large splinters.
The ghostly magic that charges the ship keeps it together
however and it seems to be steering itself by some unknown
command or by the will of the ship itself.

name: short-spear
descriptions: This is a short thrusting spear, used in one hand and
usually with a shield. It can do decent impaling damage, and
is a favourite of woods dwellers who have to worry about
hitting trees with a swing.

name: shortbow
descriptions: This small curved bow is made out of a light, polished
wood. It is tightly strung, and has a light pull. It is
fairly effective at close range, but has not the power for
extreme range or damage. It comes with a small quiver
filled with arrows.

name: shortsword
descriptions: This is a two-foot-long blade, useful for close-quarters
fighting. It is the standard arm of alley-fighters, and the
dwarven tunnel-fighters, who do not have the space available
to swing a long sword.

name: shovel
descriptions: This is a simple shovel that has hardly been used. It is
made with an oaken handle, that seems somewhat rotten, and
a rusty iron blade. It could be used to dig up a few graves
but anything more stressful and it could easily break.

name: shreaded tapestry
descriptions: You can tell this was once a piece of fine tapestry, but
that would have been ages ago. Now it is a pile of shreaded
and tattered thread. Despite its poor condition you can
still make out a picture in the tapestry. It is that of
a person climbing into a pile of shreaded tapestry, as if
it were some kind of portal.

name: shuriken
descriptions: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding
from its edge. It shines brightly from its polish and look
ready to deal out damage.

name: sickle
descriptions: This is a sharp, curved crescent of iron. The Druids use
this to cut mistletoe and such plants for their woodland
worship. In a pinch, it can do decent damage, but it is
unwieldly.

name: sickly green potion
descriptions: This odd potion looks like some form of moldy vegtables
liquified long ago. It has a disgusting slosh to it and your
nostrils tingle from the smell that corrodes your nose.

name: sign
descriptions: This is a strange sign showing runes written in a dark ink.
Though you can not decipher what is said you can tell that
it seems to be a sign of warding, specifically banishing
something or someone from entrance into this encampment.

name: sign
descriptions: ** Choose your path wisely **

name: sign
descriptions: Gone hunting components, try back later.

name: silk cape
descriptions: This is a long silken cape, embroidered with intertwining
designs about the hem. A small silver clasp holds it closed.

name: silk gloves
descriptions: This is a beautifully-crafted pair of silk gloves. They are
light and protective, though somewhat costly.

name: silk robe
descriptions: This is a beautiful silken robe, glossy midnight blue in
colour. It is durable and extremely smooth to the touch. On
its back a slender, sinuous dragon-like creature is curled
about a magnificent silver orb. It is bound about the waist
with a shimmering silver sash.

name: silk skirt
descriptions: This long wrap of brilliant silk is of excellent
workmanship. It are light and loose, ties in a knot at the
waist, and hangs down to the ankles.

name: silk trousers
descriptions: This is a pair of brilliant silk pants, of excellent
workmanship. They are light and loose, and tight around the
ankles and waist.

name: silver banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCSILV.BAN

name: silver belt
descriptions: This brightly shining belt is made of a single massive band
of silvery metal. Green runes adorn the buckle, and they
seem to give off their own light.

name: silver box
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: silver box
descriptions: This smallish silver box is ornately carved with rampant
animals. When moved, objects rattle about inside.

name: silver box
descriptions: This smallish silver box is ornately carved with rampant
animals. When moved, objects rattle about inside.

name: silver bracelet
descriptions: This is a simple silver link bracelet, commonly worn as
adornment.

name: silver bracers
descriptions: These engraved silver bracers are etched with ancient runes
and symbols, and are beautifully crafted.

name: silver casket
descriptions: This squat, heavy silver casket is inlaid with many small
etchings of capering warriors. It rests upon a small marble
dias.

name: silver disk
descriptions: This small flat silver plate is around 5 inches in diameter.
It is quite tarnished and worn with age, but you can make
out the following inscription:
Speak the answer, and you may pass.
"Starter of wars, Purifies thoughts.
Creates a deity, Without you are lost."

name: silver emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCSILV.EMB

name: silver flute
descriptions: This beautiful silver flute sings with a clear, beautiful
tone when played.

name: silver gloves
descriptions: These gloves are made of some type of metallic silver cloth.
Tingling the tips of your fingers, you notice the stitching
along the fingers and wrists show an odd pattern, woven
with black and crimson thread.

name: silver holy amulet
descriptions: This simple but beautifully-crafted amulet is worked in
the shape of a holy symbol, and is made out of blue-white
silver. It is hung upon a chain of silver links.

name: silver hood
descriptions: This is a hood of metallic silver cloth. Woven along the
border is a strange pattern of black and crimson.

name: silver key
descriptions: This simple silver key still gleams brightly despite it's
obvious age. Made with the curves, and teeth of ages long
past, you assume it belongs to someone with a long heritage
to have such an old item.

name: silver key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright
silver, you can assume to match whatever house it belongs
to.

name: silver keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate silver keys.

name: silver ore
descriptions: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of silver.
Fairly valuable, it is mainly used in jewlery and high-
quality dishware. The ore must be smelted so that the silver
can be extracted-- until then, it is nearly worthless.

name: silver parchment deed
descriptions: A sheet of silver-tinted vellum sealed with cool grey wax stamped
with a horse's head. Penned in elegant flowing script on premium
material, this deed grants ownership of a grand gang hall with
capacity for up to 1,500 members.

name: silver pedestal
descriptions: This intricately-designed pedestal was most likely magically
crafted out of pure silver. It breaks out into a three-
pronged clasp at the top where it holds the crystal ball. On
closer inspection, you discover that you might be able to
to turn the crystal ball in some manner.

name: silver plaque
descriptions: Carved with a skilled hand, this plaque stands upon a
marble pedestal for all to see. Various patterns have been
shaped around the edges, and in big block letters you see:
X B I E K O C D
a few inches below the plaque reads:
Speak the missing letter.

name: silver rapier
descriptions: This light sword has a long, thin blade designed for
thrusting, which shines with a soft white light. It handles
beautifully, and it seems to move with a will of its own.

name: silver ring
descriptions: This is a thick silver ring, heavily carved with angular
lines and designs.

name: silver river
descriptions: The Silver river is reknowned for its beauty, majesty, and
mystery, as well as for its danger. Lurking beneath the
glittering silvery surface, capricious and sometimes evil
creatures wait for unsuspecting travelers. A perpetual cover
of fine white mist muffles the sounds here and prevents
seeing very far.

name: silver signet ring
descriptions: This small silver ring has been fashioned to appear like two
wings encircling each other. On the head is the symbol of
a sunrise, with the letters D and B engraved upon it.

name: silver spined tome
descriptions: This plain grey tome is fixated with a silver spine, which
is fashioned to resemble several wild roses. Glancing at the
cover, you read the topic "Magical Incantations".

name: silverbark canoe
descriptions: This small, beautiful canoe is made of carefully-cured and
waterproofed silverwood bark. Of elven make, it is virtually
unsinkable in shallow waters and is very light.

name: silvermere wall
descriptions: The massive town wall of Silvermere once was used to keep
out waves of invaders, and now serves a somewhat similar
purpose -- warding off maligned creatures in the wild. There
appears no place to land a boat along the base of the wall,
as its sheer face descends right into the river.

name: silversilk gloves
descriptions: Woven from elven silversilk, these gloves weigh almost
nothing. Stitched with runes of gold they would give any
wearer simple protection to their hands.

name: silversilk slippers
descriptions: This pair of simple slippers have been woven from silversilk
that only elves possess. Embroidered with runes of gold
they offer great comfort to the feet while traversing the
harshest surface.

name: silversilk trousers
descriptions: This is a marvelously-sewn pair of silversilk pants, inlaid
with precious runes of gold. They are light and supple, and
are a treasure indeed.

name: silversilk tunic
descriptions: This beautiful shirt is made of the finest material known to
man -- silversilk. Only the elves know how to weave this
marvelous magical cloth, which is as light as silk while
being strong as steel, and just as impenetrable.

name: silverwood chest
descriptions: This large, gorgeous silverwood chest is heavily inlaid with
golden ornamentation and small precious stones. Objects
inside rattle about when it is moved.
from within.

name: silverwood forest
descriptions: The trees of this forest are tall, with golden leaves and
smooth silvery bark. They are slender but very strong, with
long, high limbs.

name: silverwood helm
descriptions: This leather helm has been fastened with a covering of deep
silverwood bark. While heavier then regular helms it also
vastly increases protection against blows to the head.
A single blue sigil has been carved into the bark, above
the crown of the helm.

name: silverwood lute
descriptions: This lute is definitely a rare find, for it is made of the
sacred silverwood tree. It glows brightly from the symbols
engraved on it, and the strings seems to play a musical tune
themselves.

name: silverwood plate corselet
descriptions: This is a corselet of enchanted silverwood, inlaid with
precious gems and gold. It is strong as steel, but is
nonetheless quite light. A gift surely fit for a king.

name: silverwood rod
descriptions: This heavy silverwood rod is about two feet long, and is
covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: silverwood staff
descriptions: This elegant staff is a living branch of the silverwood
trees, long and slender and warm with life. Starting halfway
up the shaft and continuing to its end, stars of all shape
and size have been carved into the wood and have been
coloured gold, with no apparent damage to the living wood.
The silverwood staff radiates a palpable magical aura.

name: silverwood staff
descriptions: This elegant staff is a living branch of the silverwood
trees, long and slender and warm with life. Starting halfway
up the shaft and continuing to its end, stars of all shape
and size have been carved into the wood and have been
coloured gold, with no apparent damage to the living wood.
The silverwood staff radiates a palpable magical aura.

name: silvery chain leggings
descriptions: These brilliant leggings are crafted from some silvery metal
chain mesh. A band of disks about the waist is etched with
a series of strange letters in some foreign tongue.

name: silvery crested shield
descriptions: This large, curved shield is crafted from a fine, silvery
metal, and glitters brightly. Emblazoned on its smooth face
is the proud symbol of the town of Silvermere.

name: silvery longbow
descriptions: This beautifully-made longbow appears to be made of
glimmering Silverwood, a sure sign of Elven origin. It has
elegant, sinuous runes carved into its length, and although
it is tightly strung, it is remarkably easy to draw. A
silver-laced quiver of white leather is full of black-
feathered arrows, their points sharp as razors.

name: silvery mace
descriptions: This brilliant silvery mace shines with an inner light. Its
broad head is studded, and its hilt is wrapped in white
leather. A thong hangs from the base of its handle.

name: silvery moon symbol
descriptions: This waxing crescent moon appears to be made of a white
metal, possibly platinum. It is fixed to the triangle, but
you think it may be able to be moved in some way.

name: silvery plate corselet
descriptions: This light corselet is fashioned from an extremely stong,
glittering metal. It is elaborately engraved with swirling
designs, highlighted in gold. The crest of the town of
Silvermere is emblazoned on its chest, proudly displayed in
gold and jewels.

name: silvery pool
descriptions: This large pool is fed from a small tributary of the Silver
River. It must drain down into the earth somewhere, as the
water does not rise despite the constant influx of water.

name: silvery potion
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a glittering silver
liquid. Engraved upon the steel stopper is a small cross.

name: silvery scroll
descriptions: This thin scroll is made of hammered silver, and is
imprinted with ancient characters. It radiates an aura of
power that is unmistakeable.

name: silvery shield
descriptions: This large, curved knight's shield gleams with a silvery
light. A thin border of golden runes frames the rearing
shape of a lion.

name: silvery skullcap
descriptions: This thin skullcap is made of a shining silver-like metal.
It is heavily inscribed with angular runes, glowing a faint
blue. An emanation of power surrounds it.

name: silvery spiked corselet
descriptions: This finely crafted platemail is fashioned from a silver
that has a white and pure innocence to it. You can find
no dents or scratches on the metal, as if it had
never been fashioned by mortal hand. The only markings
found is a simple holy symbol inscribed on each individual
plate and many large spikes that protrude from the shoulder.

name: silvery spiked shield
descriptions: This is a silver shield of medium size. A massive spike has
been masterfully grafted in the center, offering a warning
to any opponents of the shield.

name: silvery stream
descriptions: This rapidly-flowing stream is an offshoot of the Silver
River. It threads its way along the bottom of a wide crack
in the Dragon's Teeth hills. The stony walls loom high above
you, and occasionally a stone falls with a loud splash into
the waters near you.

name: skeletal remains
descriptions: A humanoid skeletan lies here, or what parts remain. From
what you are able to discern, a large amount of force was
applied to its structure, leaving most of it in chips or
shattered bits. One entire hand though still cluthes a piece
of paper.
The paper reads...

name: skeleton key
descriptions: This small, fragile key appears to be made out of yellow
bone. The handle is a rat's skull, with small glass marbles
for eyes.

name: skin-covered book
descriptions: In this unholy manual, you uncover the evil, secret
techniques of the blood ritual! This Blood Ritual allows the
recipient to be filled with a minute power of the Blood God,
giving an increase in combat power along with a small amount
of healing over time. This spell is powered by the pain and
suffering of others, and is needless to say quite evil.

name: skirts of flame
descriptions: Red and orange silk make up the underlayers of these
eyecatching skirts, with the topmost pieces shaped like
petals of the sun. The pieces rise and sway as small flames
run course along their surface. The deep red inner layer
feels cool to the touch.

name: skull-capped staff
descriptions: This six-foot long staff is made of some type of yellowed
wood. It almost appears to be rotting until you feel how
sturdy it is. On the top of the staff is a grinning human
skull, with two red points of light seeming to come from its
eyeless sockets.

name: skull flail
descriptions: Fashioned by evil hands this weapon would strike fear in the
weak. A long, black rod carries spikes of its own, even as
its spiked chains are attached to three humanoid skulls,
each one polished to a sickly shine. A single crimson rune
has been carved into each skull, glowing with a vile light.

name: skull key
descriptions: This large, light key is made of polished ivory. Its many
teeth are sharp, and its handle is carved in the form of a
grinning skull.

name: skull key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of a skull.

name: skull mask
descriptions: This large face-mask appears to be crafted from a human
skull. Painted black and laquered, it is placed over the
face and attached by a pair of thin leather straps so that
it fits snugly. The eye socks glow faintly red, giving the
wearer a demonic appearance.

name: skull shield
descriptions: This massive shield has elaborately-carved skulls set in
its black iron front. Embedded in the centre of the shield's
face is a gleaming skull, its visage forever frozen in a
hideous grin.

name: skull sword
descriptions: This huge, one-handed sword is crafted out of some dark
metal. Its blade is serrated and razor-sharp, and is
engraved with skulls along its length. Its long bone handle
is as strong as iron, and appears to be the legbone of some
creature. A small skull is set in the pommel.

name: skull wand
descriptions: This thick-hafted wand is more like a rod, in that it is
short, about two feet long, and thick as a pole. It is
crafted from some dark, polished wood, and is tipped with
a gleaming silver skull. Runes carved into the length of the
wand glow with a dull, fiery red.

name: skullcap
descriptions: This is an extremely thin skullcap of steel, designed to be
worn over the crown of the head. It provides a little
defense.

name: slimey spiked key
descriptions: Covered in slime that reeks of death, this key appears to
be tiny bits of metal somehow melded into one. Disjointed
points rise up from the key, stabbing and poking any who
grasp it.

name: sling
descriptions: This is a simple leather thong, with a pouch affixed to its
middle. To use, a stone is placed within the pouch, then the
sling is whirled about at great speeds. When one end of the
sling is released, the stone flies at the target. It comes
with a pouch full of smooth, round stones.

name: small black holes
descriptions: Looking into some of the small black holes, you discover a
smooth metal stud lurking within one of them!

name: small black mushrooms
descriptions: These small mushrooms are jet black in colour, and have a
distinctly distasteful odour. Their stalks are long and
spindly, their caps wide and thin.

name: small book
descriptions: This ancient book's pages have all crumbled to dust, but
its lacquered covers have not. There is writing on the
inside cover, as well as a small illustration, and though
they are faded and hard to make out, they read as follows:

name: small cloth pouch
descriptions: This is a dirty canvas bag, large enough to hold a few
personal belongings.

name: small diamond
descriptions: This tiny, glittering diamond has been well cut, and the
light reflects from within beautifully.

name: small glass flask
descriptions: This rounded flask is filled with an oily fluid, which
bubbles and froths unnaturally.

name: small green fruit
descriptions: These bite-sized fruits are a pale green in colour, and
are banded with black stripes. They have a faintly sweet
smell.

name: small hole
descriptions: This dark hole is about four feet across, and appears to
lead down into the depths of the hill.

name: small sign
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
SILVRMRE.TXT

name: small sign
descriptions: Say you want to 'buy healing' to have your damage healed.

name: small vial
descriptions: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering green
elixir. It is closed by a simple cork stopper.

name: smoke bomb
descriptions: This small, paper-wrapped package smells slightly of powder
and chemicals.

name: smoking blackwood chest
descriptions: This massive blackwood chest smells faintly of brimstone and
tinder. Smoke comes from every crack and crevice and you
are left to wonder if opening it will release some hell bent
force or unholy treasure of utter damnation.

name: smoky black talisman
descriptions: This small dark disk is hung upon a fine silver chain.
Strange runes are inscribed upon its surface, which read:
"Walk UP from the park fountain with me."

name: smooth metal stud
descriptions: This is a small metallic button, and it appears to be well-
used. It moves slightly at your touch.

name: smudged paper
descriptions: This small piece of paper has a few lines scribbled on it:
"Still no way to get up waterfall. Shadow Fist brotherhood
will not be pleased. Remember to send spy to gnome
alchemist to see if any levitation potions available."

name: snakeskin boots
descriptions: This is a pair of glittering black snakeskin boots. The
scales are sharp and opalescent, and gleam like oil in the
light.

name: soft leather cap
descriptions: This is a leather helm with ear and nose-guards. It is light
and flexible, and provides decent protection.

name: Solarblade
descriptions: This swift golden blade shines as if it holds the power of
the sun. Three feet in length, it moves with blinding speed,
a golden wave of death. The hilt is made from pure white
pearl with silver lettering of divine power inscribed on the
crosspiece. Weaving it through the air it makes a loud hum,
seething with righteous power.

name: songsheet of agility
descriptions: This parchement is inscribed with the musical knowledge to
sing the magical Song of Agility.

name: songsheet of battle
descriptions: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to
sing the magical song of battle.
