name: soulblighter
descriptions: A long, slightly curved blade of red meets a hilt fashioned
from the yellowed bone of some dead animal. The blade gives
off a glow giving everything a macabre shine of blood. An
inscription on the blade reads "Soulblighter". As you read
it a foul raspy voice seems to whisper in your ear words
of great power and damnation.

name: soulsword
descriptions: This ghostly weapon flickers with charged energy from the
astral plane. Its nature is such that it magically bonds
with the bearer, and cannot be removed except by spells. It
is rumoured that Soulswords will remain with the wielder
even after death, accompanying him into the afterlife.

name: Soulwaste
descriptions: Dark runes dance along this weapon of black iron. Slightly
curved, the blade is very well balanced with a razor sharp
edge. A small skull is set in the pommel, a crimson rune
clearly marked upon it. The smell of ash invades your nose
and grasping it seems to cause the hilt to graft to your
skin with unnautral glee.

name: sparkling pendant
descriptions: A silver star shaped necklace with gems set into each of the
points. The metal is buffed to a high sheen, and the gems
sparkle with a life of their own. Looking closely you notice
the gems seem to slowly shift colors.

name: spectral shroud
descriptions: This weightless death shroud barely appears to exist in this
world, fading in and out of view and giving off strange
energy.

name: spectral sword
descriptions: This long, glowing blade is slender and sharp, and appears
like it doesn't actually exist fully in this plane. It is
a pale yellowish-white, with the hilt being white-gold.

name: spider leg
descriptions: This long and thin spider leg is still twitching its death
throes. The leg is suprisingly light and folds neatly in
half from the natural segments. A trail of short black hairs
runs up one side of the leg.

name: spider silk
descriptions: This is a coil of shimmering, silky thread, smooth and cool
to the touch.

name: spider silk robes
descriptions: These robes have been beautifully crafted from the silk of
giant spiders. They drape comfortably about your body, and
give off a sort of warm feeling. You see a soft rainbow
effect when it catches the light.

name: spider silk trousers
descriptions: These trousers appear made of some incredibly fine silk.
When you touch the cloth it seems as if a million tiny
strands of a fine fabric form each thread, and the stitching
appears made of some golden fabric, each one appearing to
form a sparkling rune.

name: spiked black tentacle
descriptions: This is is the severed black greenish arm of a tentacled
abomination. Several spikes protrude from the end making it
a very clumsy but cruelly effective weapon.

name: spiked club
descriptions: This is a rod with jagged nails stuck through it. It is not
very quick or effective against armour, but can do good
damage against unarmored foes as the nails rip through them.
It is mainly used my impoverished thugs who cannot afford
any better weapons.

name: spiked collar
descriptions: This heavy iron collar is studded with cruel-looking spikes.
It is large enough that it must have been worn by an animal
of great size, and could comfortably fit around the neck of
a human. It has some strange runes inscribed about its edge.

name: spiked gauntlets
descriptions: These heavy steel gauntlets have spikes protruding from the
knuckles and the back of the hand. Their palms are of thick
leather so that they will provide better grip.

name: spiked obsidian collar
descriptions: This heavy, glittering collar is crafted from unnaturally
hard obsidian. Short, sharp spikes jut out of its surface
at refgular intervals, and gleam wickedly in the light.

name: spiked plate corselet
descriptions: This is a massive steel plate corselet, studded with wicked
spikes all over its surface. Although it is extremely heavy,
it is also exceedingly strong.

name: spiked shield
descriptions: This is a medium-sized shield with a large iron spike in the
centre. It is very heavy, but gives good protection, as well
as a little offense.

name: Spirit Dagger of Goijar
descriptions: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly
bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and
is both indestructible and razor-sharp. Glowing with a
ghostly halo of spectral fire, this weapon is designed for a
special purpose.

name: spiritual warhammer
descriptions: Myths have told of great and powerful priests creating the
embodiment of a weapon to fight all that is wretched. This
is such a weapon. Created from some holy power, it seems
metallic, yet weighs nothing. The heavens seem instilled in
its handle and head, and you can faintly hear the chant of
holy prayer, tickling your senses with a divine presence.

name: splotched scroll
descriptions: This long, ripped scroll bears several splotches upon its
pages. The contents of the scroll contains the runes of
magic, which can only be read by those who practice the
magi talent.

name: staff-sling
descriptions: This weapon looks like a shortish wooden staff, with a
leather sling affixed to the end. It is able to throw stones
faster and further than a normal sling, but it is slower to
use and it requires two hands. It comes with a pouch full of
stones.

name: staff of power
descriptions: This long, exquisite ebony staff has been crafted by the
finest smiths, and emblazoned with powerful magic runes by
only the strongest enchanters. A smooth multifaceted crystal
tops the staff, sending out a glittering spray of rainbow
sparkles.

name: staff of scales
descriptions: A long staff fashioned from an alien material, it has been
carved to appear as if two long snakes were intwined with
each other, pointing opposite of the other.

name: staff of the elements
descriptions: This strange staff is made of four intertwined metallic
rods, one blue, one green, one red and one silver. It
crackles with arcane energy, as the powers from all four
elements meet, fuse and conflict.

name: stained papyrus scroll
descriptions: This ancient, crumbling scroll of coarse-grained paper has
been greatly dirtied and stained over the years. Despite
this you are still able to read the words of an ancient,
guttural tongue writen upon its surface. They appear to be
words to an unholy prayer.

name: star helm
descriptions: Made of pure starsteel, or adamant as it was called by the
ancients, this huge helm is a very strange sight indeed. A
small oval covers the entire face of the bearer, shielding
the front of the skull, as well as protecting the eyes, it
is said the bearer sees only by the holy light of his faith.
Twelve golden tendrils jut out of the top and rear.

name: star key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form
of a multi-pointed star.

name: starcharts
descriptions: Several star charts lay tossed around this room. Among them
you see several depicting mythological beasts, and a few
with an unreadable script written underneath. You come to
the conclusion that they are for summoning purposes.

name: starhammer
descriptions: This beautiful weapon seems to be made out of pure light
from the stars, glowing radiantly and shimmering. It hums
with arcane power and feels warm to the touch.

name: starsteel bracers
descriptions: These shining steel bracers have a bluish-silver glint in
the light. As you look more closely, you notice runes
etched into their surface, and upon further examination
you determine the runes to be of the dwarven language.

name: starsteel corselet
descriptions: Large, thick plates of starsteel give this corselet a look
of indestructibility. The combination of so many shining
starsteel plates gives the entire suit a vibrant glow.
It's massive weight is balanced by the fact it provides
incredible protection in combat.

name: starsteel greathelm
descriptions: This large helm is made of shining starsteel, as you hold it
up to the light it gleams a brilliant azure. It is obviously
work of the finest craftsmanship, but simple and efficient
as well.

name: starsteel greatsword
descriptions: This huge two-handed sword is crafted from some glittering,
silvery metal. The light refracts off of it in rainbows, its
perfect surface reflecting like a mirror. Its elegant hilt
is bound in black leather. The pommel is adorned with a
softly glowing diamond the size of a bull's eye, and
sinuous patterns are etched into the double crossguards.

name: starsteel mace
descriptions: This long-shafted mace has been crafted from a strange and
extremely rare metal called starsteel. It shines bluish-
silver, and its head is round and studded. A single
glittering diamond has been set in its pommel, and spiral
symbols inlaid in its haft glow warmly.

name: starsteel plate boots
descriptions: You see before you, a pair of very fine boots. Thin,
overlapping starsteel plates reinforce the already sturdy
leather backdrop, providing amazing protection to your feet
and lower legs. Inside the boot is layered with the finest
doe-skin, to provide a soft padding as well as excellent

name: starsteel plate gauntlets
descriptions: This pair of plate gauntlets is fashioned from the silver
blue metal known as starsteel. Dwarven worksmen have pounded
and fashioned the plates to maximize their durability and
protection.

name: starsteel plate leggings
descriptions: This is a pair of greaves made from shimmering starsteel.
They look to provide remarkable protection for the legs,
if the weight of the thick metal can be easily supported.

name: starsteel scimitar
descriptions: This curved sword appears to have been crafted from an
extremely rare metal called starsteel. The blade shines
bluish-silver and the edge glitters brightly. A single
glittering diamond has been set in its pommel, and spiral
symbols inlaid in its hilt glow warmly.

name: starsteel shortsword
descriptions: This impressive shortsword gleams with a silver-bluish tint,
indicating it to be made from the rare metal, starsteel.
It's razor-sharp edge looks extremely deadly, and it
seems to glide silently through the air as you swing it.
A well-cut diamond is set within the pommel.

name: statue
descriptions: This towering stone figure stands at least twenty feet tall.
Crafted in the image of cloaked man, its features are
shrouded in the depths of its hood, and its sleeves are
rolled up to its elbows. Inscribed upon its base is an
intricate text which can be deciphered upon closer
inspection.

name: statue
descriptions: This is a white marble statue of a ten-foot-tall knight in
full plate armour. He stands resting both hands on the
pommel of his sword, and his shield rests up against the
wall. Although his face cannot be seen through his visored
helmet, he conveys a feeling of sorrow.

name: statue's eyes
descriptions: The minotaur's eyes are much more skillfully crafted than
the rest of the statue, and appear to have been set in after
the main statue body was created. They reflect what looks
like an attitude of utter fearlessness and ferocity, and you
shudder when you think that the real beast must truly exist.
At any rate, since they are separate, they might be moved.

name: statue's horned head
descriptions: Long and terrible horns jut out from either side of the
minotaur statue's head. Looking closer, you notice they are
both jointed at their bases. Your curiosity aroused, you
inspect the head thoroughly and find some other mysterious
discoveries -- both the statue's eyes and nose ring appear
to have been set in after the creation of the statue.

name: statue's nose ring
descriptions: This is a simple stone hoop set through the nostrils of the
statue's nose. It appears to be able to move freely, and
the construction of the whole face indicates to you that
this statue is not all that it seems.

name: statue's stone greataxe
descriptions: This massive axe is huge even for a two-handed weapon. It
has a single massive blade, and looks like the axes
executioners use to remove their victims' heads from their
necks. It appears that there is a joint at the base of the
greataxe's handle, where it is gripped by the statue,
allowing it to be moved somewhat.

name: steel brassiere
descriptions: This is a light steel breastplate for women, padded with
leather. It is slightly cumbersome, but provides great
protection.

name: steel chest
descriptions: This solid steel chest appears to have been crafted by a
blacksmith, as the work is crude but solid. Objects inside
rattle about when it is moved.

name: steel key
descriptions: This large, shining key is well-crafted and seems to be used
often. Stamped in its head is the shape of a roaring lion.

name: steel nunchaku
descriptions: This small flail is made up of two steel rods joined
together by a short iron chain.

name: stiletto
descriptions: This is an extremely thin, edgeless thrusting blade. It is
very small and easy to conceal. Its extremely poor combat
value makes it useless against all but the most lightly
armoured opponents.

name: stone
descriptions: This large stone looks very out of place from the rest of
the rubble. Something seems to be holding it in place, but
it looks moveable.

name: stone chest
descriptions: This chest is actually a large piece of granite that has
been meticulously hollowed out. A large stone slab forms the
door. It looks immensely heavy and you already feel your
muscles ache from the strain they are about to take.

name: stone door
descriptions: This huge stone portal is completely plain except for a
black keyhole set in the exact centre of its grey face.
Spidery runes are carved all about this hole, in a script
which you have never seen before.

name: stone face
descriptions: As you look closer, the stone face comes to life. Its eyes
flicker open, and as it opens its lips, a chilling, hollow
voice whispers the words:
Never seen, always felt
Without you are dead as stone.

name: stone hand
descriptions: This outstretched hand, palm up, appears not to have been
cracked by age, but by design. Closer inspection shows that
by turning the hand you can move it in a circular motion,
perhaps even turning it upside down.

name: stone hand
descriptions: This is a stone carving of a gnarled, inhuman hand. Its
fingers are splayed as if ready to claw at someone.

name: stone head
descriptions: This is a giant life-like head made of solid stone, it is
very heavy to lift. The former owner of the head seems to
have belonged to that of someone of great power. The dead
eyes gaze outward in cold, lifeless silence.

name: stone javelin
descriptions: This long stone pole runs seven feet in length. You can
not tell if it is chiseled stone, or petrified wood,
but regardless it feels very sturdy. The pole has a
sharp point at each end.

name: stone jaw
descriptions: Though closed shut, this jaw appears as if it could be
easily moved or lowered down to open the mouth, and possibly
reveal the contents inside.

name: stone key
descriptions: This is a large key fashioned from a large piece of granite.
Its handle is unremarkable, fashioned to form a solid
circle.

name: stone key
descriptions: This is a large stone key, made out of a black-flecked
granite.

name: stone mouth
descriptions: As you gaze at the mouth, the lips begin to move, whispering
a ghostly rhyme which goes like this:

name: stone pedestal
descriptions: Jagged and rough, this pedestal of stone looks as though it
had been ripped from under a mountain. It is a deep grey
color and still smells heavily of earth. A large shard of
quartz floats out of reach above it, hanging in midair above
the chaos.

name: stone rook key
descriptions: Made of smooth, polished stone, this key has been fashioned
to appear like that of the Rook chess piece.

name: stone shelves
descriptions: These crude stone shelves have been carved out of the wall
by the use of some sharp, heavy instrument. Placed on these
shelves is a variety of disgusting objects, ranging from
a pile of rancid scalps to a jar full of fingerbones. Dead
bats and reptiles also occupy space here.

name: stone statue
descriptions: A large stone statue stands before you. Sculpted in the
image of a warrior, he wields a sword in one hand, and his
other is outstretched in a grasping manner. Age has caused
cracks to form on his sword hand, his jaw, and a large hole
can be seen where his eye once was.

name: stone statue
descriptions: A large stone statue stands before you. Sculpted in the
image of a warrior, he wields a sword in one hand, and his
other is outstretched in a grasping manner. Age has caused
cracks to form on his sword hand, his other hand and his
jaw.

name: stone sword
descriptions: Upon closer inspection of the sword you see that it is not
age that has formed the cracks but the original maker. It
looks as though you could perhaps twist the sword while it
is still wielded by the statue.

name: stone table
descriptions: This is a huge stone table, its edge right at your eye
level. Deep cracks riddle its surface, and it is worn with
age and heavy use. A stone chair of appropriate size stands
nearby.

name: stone wall letters
descriptions: It is hard to make out much of the scrawling here, as age
has devoured most of its form. Trying to decipher the
writing only reveals gibberish, with the letters
"ukubakahs si rewop fo drow eht" etched repeatedly, ending
finally with "egnellahc eht tiefrof dna drow eht esu"

name: stone warhammer
descriptions: Black and white runes are inscripted on this massive sledge
of stone. Made from some type of granite, its color is so
dull it seems to flow out and shade everything around it.
A pair of scales have been written on the head of this
weapon of stone, making it the only markings that you see.

name: storm crown
descriptions: This is a large circlet finely-crafted in some strange
metal. The air crackles with the lightning that circulates
all around the crown. A massive sapphire is set in the front
of the crown. Upon closer inspection there appears to be a
thundercloud hidden deep in the gem.

name: Storm Spirit
descriptions: This small crystal sphere contains the essence of lightning.
Swirling about inside as crackling arcs, which make the orb
flash and spark wildly.

name: stormhammer
descriptions: This heavy stone weapon seems almost crudely made, but is
imbued with incredible destructive magics. Lightning
crackles all about it, occasionally discharging when the
hammer strikes its mark.

name: stormmetal belt
descriptions: This is a very large belt, fashioned from hide and linked
plates. From the blusish tinge that radiates from the belt
it can be identified as stormmetal. It was obviously
intended to be worn by someone much larger, but it is still
possible to cinch it enough to wear it. An engraving of a
lightning bolt has been stamped upon the middle plate.

name: stormmetal bracers
descriptions: A pair of armbands made from a bizzare metal, with a
lightning charge running along the length of the bracers
giving it a blueish tinge. The metal is incredibly sturdy,
etched in runes of some strange language of power. The
bracers are oversized but will still fit.

name: stormmetal corselet
descriptions: Thick plates of a bluish metal have been crafted to form a
massive corselet. Sparkles of white and blue dance around
the edges and the plates seem to hum as they rub together.
It is obvious by its size that a giant was the intended
wearer, but with some adjustments it could fit the frame
of a normal humanoid.

name: stormmetal greataxe
descriptions: This is a massive, long-handled axe. The double blades are
made of a bizzare metal that gives off a blueish tinge as
white lightning runs up and down the razor-like edge. As you
grasp the handle it gives you a slight shock, and it seems
to give off an odd hum as it weaves through the air.

name: stormmetal scalemail tunic
descriptions: This entire suit is enchanting to behold, the metal lights
up all over with lightning, giving the entire suit a
blueish tinge. The circles of metal are all tightly woven
together to make a hard-to-pierce suit. You note the suit
was worn by a very large man as you put it on and have to
adjust the straps to fit your smaller frame.

name: stove
descriptions: This fat black wood-burning stove is covered in grease and
soot, and appears to be heavily used. It stinks of burnt
flesh and fat.

name: strange mushrooms
descriptions: These odd-looking mushrooms seem to have been coated with a
glittering dust of some sort.

name: street
descriptions: This wide, flagstoned street is in a moderate state of
disrepair. Trash is scattered haphazardly about the streets,
and it is obvious that attention to cleanliness is not one
of the priorities here. The tall, rickety buildings flanking
the street have a decidedly seedy and unkempt look about
them.

name: studded leather tunic
descriptions: This is a vest of thick leather studded with iron rivets. It
is a little heavy, but will provide good protection in
combat.

name: suede gloves
descriptions: This is a pair of simple suede gloves. They are soft and
warm, but are not very protective.

name: summoning bone
descriptions: This long, smooth bone radiates pure evil. Used by powerful
necromancers to trap the souls of the living and force them
into an undead state, it is a tool of the netherworld and
should be destroyed.

name: sunburst necklace
descriptions: Inlaid with bright gold that almost shines with its own
light this necklace one of the finest works youve ever seen.
In the image of a glorious sunburst that has risen with the
new day to destroy the night with the light of purification.
On each chain link of the necklace is a symbol from some
sacred archaic tongue.

name: sunstone flame carving
descriptions: This priceless sunstone sculpture is crafted to ressemble
a single burning flame, each tiny lick picked out in
exquisite detail. Although affixed to the stone altar, it
appears able to be moved somewhat.

name: sunstone wristband
descriptions: This thin gold wristband is etched with intricate spiral
patterns. Set into its surface are many small, circular
sunstones, which shine orange-red in the light.

name: sunsword
descriptions: This heavy golden sword burns with a brilliant fiery light.
Its hilt is wrapped in black leather, its pommel and guards
elaborately engraved with stylized suns. The arcane power
emanating from this weapon is enormous, and it would be
impressive in battle.

name: swamp
descriptions: This spooky swamp stinks of rotting vegetation and gaseous
fumes. The ground alternates from soft spongy masses, to
soupy poisonous marsh seemingly at random, making navigation
hazardous in the extreme. Strange sounds echo throughout the
concealing mists, and shadows continually flicker in your
peripheral vision. You get the feeling of being watched.

name: swamp boots
descriptions: These long boots come up nearly to your crotch, and are
covered in a coarse, dense black pelt. They seem to be
completely waterproof.

name: switch
descriptions: This is a simple iron switch, set under the edge of the
stone table.

name: sword
descriptions: The knight's massive bastard-sword is intricately engraved
with ancient runic symbols. It is nearly six feet long, and
even though this must be a stone duplicate of the real
weapon, it appears to be razor-sharp.

name: table
descriptions: This simple table has seen better days years ago. Marks and
scratches decorate it like a polish, and it has been stained
crimson in splotches, as if a great battle had been waged
upon its simple surface.

name: tails of battle
descriptions: Not so much a cloak but a collection of cloth strips, black
on the outer side and bright yellow on the underside.
Commissioned by the king these cloaks struck terror into the
foes while the warlocks spun and cleaved their way into
enemy ranks.

name: tainted ruby
descriptions: A massive ruby inset on the floor before the altar, it
has a tainted, dirty, red colour to it. With horror you
realize the blood from the altar is draining to tarnish the
ruby. An inner flame seems to burn inside it, swaying with
an odd seduction, yearning for your touch.

name: tankard of mead
descriptions: This is a large, heavy wooden mug filled with a sweet honey
mead. It is very tasty.

name: tapestry
descriptions: This is an elaborately-woven tapestry, made of red and gold
thread. It depicts a battle between a griffon and a dragon,
their bodies entwined one around the other. Moving it aside,
you see a small crack in the wall.

name: target shield
descriptions: This is a small wooden shield, used by warriors to practice
maneuvers. It is fairly light and protective.

name: tarnished chainmail hauberk
descriptions: This is a tunic of iron chain armour. It appears to be well-
used, as it is covered with a thin layer of rust and many
nicks and scratches.

name: tattered manual
descriptions: A training manual from long ago, it is written in old tongue
you open it and decipher the following...

name: tattered scroll
descriptions: This long, ripped scroll is covered by row upon row of
thin, evenly-spaced handwriting, describing the methods of
learning and casting a spell named Mass Frenzy! This spell
duplicates the effects of the Frenzy spell, but is cast upon
oneself and one's allies.

name: tattered white bible
descriptions: With curled edges, and visible tear marks, this book has
seen many days go by, and yet it somehow its pages seem to
have a bright, enduring whiteness to its paper. Within the
manual, written in silver, are the runes of a special, holy
prayer.

name: teak wand
descriptions: This long, slender teak wand is smoothly carved, and is
engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: templar greatsword
descriptions: This is a long, heavy blade, made from some pristine metal.
Sharp and deadly, it is bladed on both sides. A golden
cross is imprinted on the hilt, and you see holy symbols
written around the cross. On the blade itself it also has
written "For Honour".

name: tent
descriptions: The blue fabric of the tent sparkles lightly in the darkness
As you feel the wonderous cloth, a cool breeze flows over
your body and caresses your mind.

name: text inscription
descriptions: "When the light be quenched and shadow falls upon the earth,
the seas will boil, the sky will turn as red as blood, and
the earth itself will crack and spew forth all-consuming
flame. Then darkness will reign over the people of the
land, and all shall bow before the Dark One and his dread
lords."

name: thick brown vines
descriptions: These heavy, almost-leathery vines vary in thickness from
one inch to almost four. They appear quite strong, and could
possibly bear the weight of someone climbing upon them.

name: thief's kit
descriptions: This small box contains a full set of lockpicks, as well as
other assorted tools that aid in not only picking locks, but
also disarming traps.

name: thief's pouch
descriptions: This tiny, leather pouch attachs to the wrist, providing
easy access to the tools of a thief which jingle inside.

name: thin grey tome
descriptions: This simple grey tome seems to sparkle with an interesting
light, causing your eyes to be drawn to it immediately.
On the cover, the book is titled "Tresspassers".

name: three-headed flail
descriptions: This massive flail is quite impressive -- it has three
spherical, studded heads attached to long chains, which
would cause great damage in combat. Its thick wooden haft
is banded with iron for reinforcement. A difficult weapon
to use, it is rarely seen in the possession of unseasoned
fighters.

name: three-toothed key
descriptions: This long, heavy key has a strange construction-- three
oddly-formed teeth jut out from its barrel instead of the
usual one.

name: throne
descriptions: This large gilded throne appears to have been crafted for
someone of large stature, as it is a little big even for a
fully-grown man. The throne's arms are carved to ressemble
lion's paws, and at the top of the throne is a glaring
eagle's head, its beak open in a soundless shriek.

name: throne
descriptions: Piercing spikes protrude from every angle of this throne.
Crafted from some sort of black iron that has long since
rusted and stained by blood, it looks as though it were a
device for torture then used for sitting.
power emanating from it.

name: throne
descriptions: This exquisitely-carved throne is truly fit for a king -- or
queen, in this case. An intricate button in the shape of a
skull can easily be seen carved into one arm of the throne.

name: throne
descriptions: Crafted masterfully from solid gold, this throne would do
for any person of royalty. Fashioned for comfort, a plush
cushion of purple covers the seat. The faint smell of
perfume is in the air, and you feel warm just by being near
this symbol of power.

name: throne
descriptions: This large, heavy throne is carved out of adamantite. Its
two arms are made to look like serpents, with their tails
stretching back and entwining intricately to form the back
and seat. The serpent on the left is black, while the one on
the right is white. Somehow you get an impression of great
power emanating from it.

name: throwing hammers
descriptions: This well-balanced, sturdy pair of light hammers make a
poweful weapon at close range. Crafted by dwarven smiths,
it has been told that hammers like these were used in combat
to support skirmishing troops.

name: thundering scroll
descriptions: This scroll seems charged with rippling energy, you find it
shocking to touch!

name: thunderstaff
descriptions: This slender, silvery staff crackles with power. Lightning
flickers up and down its length, and magical runes are
engraved in jagged patterns all over it.

name: tiger-claw necklace
descriptions: Long, perfect tiger claws, covered with golden runes, hang
from the platinum chain of this necklace. It seems to hum
slightly, and feels oddly light.

name: tissue
descriptions: This piece of carefully woven cotten looks as though it can
hold up to many gallons of liquid.

name: titanic stone maul
descriptions: This huge maul is made up by a great eight foot rod, topped
by a large stone ball. Incredibly difficult to lift, it is
very slow to wield, but anything it hits will be crushed by
its massive weight. A great weapon for only the strongest
combatant, you see by the stains on the stone that it's
already found many victims.

name: titanium fork
descriptions: This shining, titanium device greatly resembles an oversized
tuning fork, attached to a strange crystal-studded
handle. Of gnomish manufacture, it is a queer device that
only the brilliant gnome inventors could create.
<Type AIM FORK WEST to use on a western wall, and so on.>

name: tomb door
descriptions: This large stone door is carved with holy images and
symbols. A large plaque in the centre is engraved with an
elaborate script, but the age of the writing is such that it
is indecipherable to you.

name: tonfa
descriptions: The tonfa consists of a long, thick rod made from hardwood
and a handle that juts out about a third of the way down the
shaft. Used in the hands of a trained ninja, it can be used
to effectively break an opponent's weapon, leaving him
vulnerable to your attack.

name: topaz emblem
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCTOPAZ.EMB

name: topaz stone
descriptions: This small, precious stone is a golden yellow in colour.

name: torch
descriptions: This long wooden stick is bound by stips of oil-soaked
cloth. When lit, it provides fairly good illumination.

name: tournament badge
descriptions: This small, bloodstained iron badge is a symbol proving
once's participation in a Tournament battle. It has
obviously seen much use.

name: tower shield
descriptions: This huge iron shield is bolted together with rivets, and
is held onto the forearm by thick leather straps. It
provides a virtual wall of defense against attack, but gets
in the way of your attacks as well as the opponents. The
incredible weight of this shield prohibits its use by weaker
adventurers.

name: training key
descriptions: This is a heavy iron key. Its handles has been crafted into
three images, a visored helmet, a skull, and a five pointed
star.

name: travelers cloak
descriptions: This is a light leather cloak, suitable for the road. It
gives a little defense, and is good for protection against
the elements.

name: tree
descriptions: This ancient darkwood tree must be hundreds of years old, if
not millenia. Large enough in girth to house a village of
people, this grandfather of trees is unparraleled in all of
the land.

name: tree branch
descriptions: Made from a tree you do not recognize, this branch seems
to glow with power and youth. While it is not attached to
any sort of tree itself, the branch does not bleed.

name: tree trunk
descriptions: A large tree that has been ripped from the ground, only
someone with extreme strength could imagine wielding it.
Large handprints have shrunk one side of it, forming a
handle of sorts. It could easily cause great damage to any
unlucky enough to meet its bark.

name: trident
descriptions: This is a heavy, two-handed weapon much like a spear. Its
shaft is crafted from a durable hardwood, and its triple-
pronged head of high steel. The tip-heavy construction of
the trident makes it a somewhat clumsy weapon if one is not
used to it, but it is effective nonetheless.

name: trollskin boots
descriptions: This pair of boots is well-crafted from the skin of a large
troll. They come up to the knee and feel comfortable enough,
but it's still hard to grapple with the idea of wearing the
skin of a troll.

name: tukata root
descriptions: This rare root is from the tukata plant, which only grows
upon the corpses of those killed by poison. Tukata root
seems to have the ability to nullify the effects of poison
and in the living plant actually create nutrients to live
off of.

name: turkey leg
descriptions: This giant turkey leg is easily the size of your fist!
It smells delicious, and has been roasted in a thick, gooey
red sauce. You can't help but get it all over yourself,
and consider having a second helping.

name: turquoise potion
descriptions: This is a crystal bottle, filled with a pale turquoise
elixir. It is stoppered with a steel plug, which has a
symbol of a drop imprinted on it.

name: turquoise ring
descriptions: This elaborately-carved platinum ring is set with a small
turquoise stone. The band is made to ressemble intertwined
vines, with small leaves forming the clasps which hold the
stone.

name: turquoise stone
descriptions: This small, ornamental stone is a mottled light and dark
aqua.

name: twin shortswords
descriptions: A pair of shortswords, specially crafted for the
ambidextrous. There are matching symbols carved down the
sides of the blades.

name: twisted bone staff
descriptions: This long, yellowed bone staff is twisted along its length
and curls at the top like a goat's horn. Engraved upon its
surface are runes of power.

name: twisted tree
descriptions: This tall tree stands here, parched and broken, waiting for
nature to end its existence. You can tell by the size it is
easily a century in age, but scratches and cuts all over its
trunk tell of a life not well lived.

name: two-headed morningstar
descriptions: This heavy weapon consists of a leather-bound oak rod about
two feet in length, attached to a pair of ball-tipped
chains. The metal balls are covered in blunt protrusions to
cause more damage. A golden tassle hanging off the pommel is
its only ornamentation.

name: two-headed pike
descriptions: This long, unwieldly polearm has razor-sharp pike blades at
both ends. Difficult to use for the novice warrior, it can
be a deadly weapon in the hands of a strong, large
opponent.

name: unfertilized eggs
descriptions: These half-dozen eggs are each about six inches long, and
are pasty white in colour. They have a faint sweet smell and
are a little sticky to the touch.

name: unicorn horn
descriptions: This three-foot-long horn is one of the most beautiful
objects you have ever seen. Its spiraling length is a
shining pearly white, and its tip is razor-sharp. Since the
only way to obtain a unicorn horn is to kill one and take
it, these horns are shunned with disgust by the good-
hearted.

name: vibrant scroll
descriptions: This parchment is a radiant sight to see. In strange
patterns, every colour of the rainbow reflects from it,
while the blackened magi letters seem to stay bold and
unwavering.

name: violet banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCVIOL.BAN

name: violet key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright
violet, you can assume to match whatever house it belongs
to.

name: violet keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate violet keys.

name: violet orchid
descriptions: A narrow, dangly brown stem bears five, perfectly-shaped,
violet flowers. Each flower has five petals, round and broad
encircling feathery, red anthers. Each orchid plant will
only bear this one stem of flowers, making them extremely
exotic and beautiful.

name: violet organic walls
descriptions: These strange-looking walls are made of a hard, sticky,
violet substance that smells faintly sweet. They are formed
in organic patterns, with swirling rounded designs. Although
they are interesting to look at, they are also extremely
alien, and somewhat disturbing.

name: violet parchment deed
descriptions: A heavy roll of quality parchment sealed with violet wax bearing
an amethyst imprint of crossed swords. Written in formal legal
hand, this deed grants ownership of a well-appointed gang hall
capable of housing up to 1,000 members.

name: violet robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: viper totem
descriptions: Coiled as if to strike, the obsidian figurine of a viper
makes you think twice about putting your hand near it.

name: visored greathelm
descriptions: This is a massive steel helm, offering full protection from
attacks. Vision is limited to sight through the narrow
eyeslits.

name: void
descriptions: A large void of space stands before you, supported by
nothing, containing nothing, you almost think it goes on for
eternity, but that would still come up short. Suddenly a
small tiny pin prick of light appears, and seems to move
closer to the hole of nothingness.

name: vorpal cutlass
descriptions: A three foot blade crafted from an unknown metal, glittering
as if silver, yet black as nightfall. The blade is slightly
curved to allow for quick, precise strikes that would leave
a foe in pieces. A crimson flame has been stamped on the
blade.

name: vorpal hatchet
descriptions: This is a strange axe made of a metal which glitters as if
it were silver, but is blacker then the heart of a fiend.
Designed for quick and deadly cuts, it appears that with the
slightest swing it could dismember an opponent very easily.

name: vorpal katana
descriptions: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a
half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a
greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and
the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its
black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: vorpal sword
descriptions: This long, strangely-crafted sword is made out of some
unknown type of metal, which glitters like silver, but is
as dark as jet. Its blade is so sharp that even the
slightest touch with the edge could sever a finger. This
otherwordly weapon would prove deadly in battle.

name: vortex staff
descriptions: This long staff is made of a strange metallic silver, which
has a myraid shine to it. Strange sparkles shimmer along
its shaft, as if it held stars inside its metal confines.
The image of a circular wave sits at the head of the staff,
and a crackle seems to emenate from it at odd times.

name: wall
descriptions: This wall of cavern rock seems to have been smoothed down
through magical means. Upon closer inspection you can see a
small letter "R" that has been chiseled in reverse on its
dark surface.

name: wall
descriptions: This smooth wall is made of carefully-fitted bricks. As you
examine it, one of the bricks seems to stick out of the wall
as if it were a gross boil.

name: walls
descriptions: The walls of these tunnels are made of a light grey stone,
run through with metallic veins the colour of blood. They
are deeply gouged in places, though what could tear stone
with such ease remains to be seen.

name: war mattock
descriptions: This is a large, heavy, square-headed mace with a flat end.
It does good damage and is a fairly good weapon.

name: warhammer
descriptions: This is a martial version of the tool by the same name. It
has a heavy, flattened head on one side, and a blunt spike
on the other. The damage it can do is considerable, but due
to its weight it is fairly slow.

name: warpblade
descriptions: The blade of this strange weapon seems to fade in and out
of existence -- one minute a solid grey length, the next as
insubstantial as smoke. Odd sigils are etched up and down
the length of the blade, and golden threads are worked into
the normal-seeming steel hilt.

name: warrior statue
descriptions: A large statue, carved from marble stands here. It shows no
sign of age or degradation, as if it was carved new. The
statue itself is sculpted after some noble, powerful
warrior, a hard cold gaze staring into nothing. One hand is
placed over his heart, while the other grasps a magnificent
sword. A single word is on the statue's plaque: Ozrinom.

name: water lily
descriptions: Designed for floating freely, a large, trumpet-like flower
rests candidly atop a broad, circular leaf. A languid, thin
strand of roots dangles from beneath the flower, to provide
necessary sustenance.

name: waterfall
descriptions: The Silver river thunders down through a gaping hole in the
ceiling of the cave here, pouring down into a turbulent
pool.

name: waterskin
descriptions: This is a small waterskin made of waterproofed leather. It
holds a few litres of water.

name: wavy-bladed dagger
descriptions: This long dagger is practically a shortsword in length. Its
wavy blade is a jet black, and its hilt is of polished black
iron.

name: webbed gauntlets
descriptions: This pair of once leather only gauntlets has been fused with
think, but very light webbing. The added protection from the
webbing in no way restricts the movement of the wearer, as
the leather and webbing mix is completely flexible.

name: wedding band
descriptions: This elegantly-crafted band is made of the finest gold. It
is about a quarter inch in diameter, and polished to a high
sheen. A small diamond set in the center glitters softly,
and engraved in small letters inside the band are the words,
"For My Beloved."

name: wedding gown
descriptions: This elaborate wedding gown is made from the finest silk.
The bodice is decorated with small pearls, arranged in
intricate patterns. The ten foot train that trails behind
the gown is made from layers of soft lace.

name: weeping statue
descriptions: Cracked and faded, this marble statue depicts a middle-aged
woman, weeping for the loss of life in the graveyard. Bright
marble has now faded to grey. As you look at the statue
more, an eerie feeling overwhelms you and every now and then
you would swear the statue was looking up at you, grinning
with malice, and baring fangs.

name: well
descriptions: This well is filled with a brackish, muddy water that would
probably not be healthy to drink.

name: western wall
descriptions: This wall is extremely clean compared to the rest of the
sewer -- in other words, it is not outright filthy. A thin
layer of slime and mould covers its surface, as well as an
abnormal number of small black holes.

name: whip
descriptions: This is a four-foot-long braided leather whip. Overall, it
is not a very good weapon, as it is used mainly to entangle
and to cause pain.

name: whirling vortex
descriptions: Brilliant colours swirl about in midair here, as some sort
of extra-planar rift breaks the air. Energy crackles all
about this arcane portal... Who knows where it might lead?

name: white banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCWHIT.BAN

name: white bishop
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a miter, the
headdress of high clergy.

name: white dragon boots
descriptions: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the
white hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and
are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also
form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: white dragon carving
descriptions: This three-foot-diameter white marble carving features a
roaring dragon's head, encircled by icicles. Five odd curved
slots ring the carving, one of which is filled by a white
fang.

name: white dragon gauntlets
descriptions: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the
hide of a white dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm
to the touch, yet they give excellent protection against
almost any attack.

name: white dragon helm
descriptions: This is a sturdy helm of white dragonhide, fashioned with
superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect
the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: white dragon hide
descriptions: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon.
White as snow it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes
jutting out in some spots. It seems to carry a chill of its
own, and you wonder if it could be used for some kind of
armour.

name: white dragon leggings
descriptions: White icy dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings.
Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer
powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very
flexible.

name: white dragon tunic
descriptions: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of white dragonhide was
obviously by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges run along
the back and shoulders, and give off a shimmering glow.

name: white fang
descriptions: This is a four-inch-long fang, bone-white, and somewhat cold
to the touch.

name: white gold flail
descriptions: This great flail is made of the purest white metal. Silver
and gold symbols of holy power are etched into the four
spiked heads, each one bearing righteous wrath and fury upon
the unfaithful. Many a good soul must test their virtue each
day to use such a weapon.

name: white gold ring
descriptions: This elegantly-crafted band is made of three intertwined
loops of the finest pale gold. Small diamonds set around its
perimeter glitter brightly, and a prayer is engraved in
small letters inside the band.

name: white key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright white,
you can assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: white keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate white keys.

name: white marble fog carving
descriptions: This beautifully-crafted sculpture depicts the intricate
swirling details of a foggy cloud. Upon closer inspection,
the fog carving appears able to be moved somewhat.

name: white oak forest
descriptions: You gaze at one of the many trees standing before you. As
you look closer you see the leaves are a mix of gold and
silver, giving the ancient oak a strange glow. Its branches
reaching to the sky it looks like a great victorious king,
returned from a battle of vanquished evil.

name: white oak forest
descriptions: You gaze at one of the many trees standing before you. As
you look closer you see the leaves are a mix of gold and
silver, giving the ancient oak a strange glow. Its branches
reaching to the sky it looks like a great victorious king,
returned from a battle of vanquished evil.

name: white oaken staff
descriptions: This is a six-foot-long staff fashioned from some white oak
tree. It is carved to appear like a ring of angels dances up
around the staff until at the top sits a sunburst of gold.

name: white parchment deed
descriptions: A pristine sheet of bleached vellum sealed with crystalline wax
pressed with a faceted diamond star. The words are penned in
midnight-black ink and seem to shift faintly in the light. This
deed grants ownership of the grandest gang hall in the realm,
with room for up to 2,000 members.

name: white pawn
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which slowly narrows to a rounded top.

name: white potion
descriptions: This thick crystal bottle is filled with a thin white
liquid with the consistency of milk. A strange rune is
carved into the stopper.

name: white queen
descriptions: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is
fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide
flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a tiara, the
crown of queens.

name: white robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: white satin gloves
descriptions: These simple white gloves are made of a soft white satin,
stitched with golden thread. A holy symbol is embroidered
into the back of each glove.

name: white scroll
descriptions: Written upon bleached white paper, in gold letters you can
tell this scroll is a prayer of good priestly virtue.

name: wicked bone scythe
descriptions: This massive weapon looks like it was conjured up in
someone's nightmare. Its long, curved blade is almost talon-
like in appearance, and glitters with razor-edged sharpness.
The haft is made out of yellowed bone, carved with faces
screaming in torment and with images of leering demons.

name: Windblade
descriptions: Lightning erupts from this weapon as if it had struck down
from the clouds and stuck itself to the steel hilt. Furious
power streaks around the sword, as if in a constant struggle
over the blade, weaving around like a coiled serpent.
Untouched by this struggle is a large sapphire on its pommel
a grey stamp of scales the only markings upon it.

name: winged boots
descriptions: This pair of boots have been masterfully fashioned from
white leather. Soft to the touch, they look incredibly
durable, and a pair of golden wings have been imprinted
on the side of each boot, next to the heel.

name: winged sandals
descriptions: These silvery sandals are adorned with a small pair of
feathery white wings on each heel.

name: wire key
descriptions: This small key is made of a complex intertwining of steel
wires.

name: wishbone
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCWHIT.BAN

name: witchwood bracelet
descriptions: This bracelet is crafted from the magically-grown
witchwood tree. Exotic runes are precisely placed in
intervals along the band. It feels strangely warm to the
touch and you feel a harmony with nature.

name: witchwood breastplate
descriptions: This odd breastplate is crafted out of a magical, living
wood. It is engraved with sorcerous runes which shift and
change as you watch. The breastplate is slightly warm to the
touch, as the wood's life force is magically kept alive to
strengthen the armour.

name: witchwood spear
descriptions: This spear is crafted from a magically-grown hardwood, which
when cut from the living tree, can be crafted into high
quality magical weapons. This long spear is inlaid with
silvery runes, and its foot-long bladed head narrows to a
razor-sharp point.

name: withered tree
descriptions: This once great tree, now twists and bends like a tired old
man. Diseased and near death something seems to keep it
clinging to life. Its dried branches stick out like ancient
fingers reaching to the sky. Two large holes stick out of
the bark where branches once were.

name: withered tree
descriptions: This once great tree, now twists and bends like a tired old
man. Diseased and near death something seems to keep it
clinging to life. Its dried branches stick out like ancient
fingers reaching to the sky. One large hole sticks out of
the bark where branches once were.

name: withered walking stick
descriptions: A small stick, once the branch of some tree, is now almost
petrified from the many ages it has seen. Dirt covers it
from tip to handle and you can tell from the scratches and
cuts that the many miles it has seen have not been kind.
Something about this stick gives you a tingle.

name: wolf helm
descriptions: This exquisite helm is crafted from the finest steel, and is
light as well as strong. It is crafted in the form of a
snarling wolf's head with the jaws wide open, giving the
appearance that the wearer is being swallowed alive.

name: wooden box
descriptions: This simple pine box is about one foot long and half as
wide and deep. Objects inside rattle about freely.

name: wooden box
descriptions: This simple pine box is about one foot long and half as
wide and deep. Objects inside rattle about freely.

name: wooden chair
descriptions: This elegant wooden chair is ornamented with simple curving
designs. Built to last, it is commonly seen in most town
houses.

name: wooden desk
descriptions: This old wooden desk looks like it has been severly abused,
its surface being cut and worn. All its drawers are missing,
but this is fortunate, as it allows you to see a hidden
iron switch lurking deep within!

name: wooden hammer
descriptions: A simple wooden hammer, it smells of fresh oak. It is a
simple weapon of labor, a square wooden head sitting atop a
wooden handle. Used primarly for pounding with great force,
it could hardly be used much as a weapon against normal
adversaries.

name: wooden ladder
descriptions: Two long, parellel planks of wood are attached together by
evenly spaced, perpendicular steps. The wood looks chipped
and gnawed, and it is easy to tell this ladder has been used
many times.

name: wooden ladder
descriptions: Two long, parellel planks of wood are attached together by
evenly spaced, perpendicular steps. The wood has been sanded
smooth, and feels fairly trustworthy not to break from under
you.

name: wooden skiff
descriptions: This somewhat shabbily-made boat is barely large enough for
one person. Its pair of small oars are barely long enough
to use and would give you splinters, but nonetheless it is
waterworthy.

name: wooden stake
descriptions: A stake of wood carved with master precision, the tip looks
sharp enough to pierce any sort of unprotected surface.
Made from a white oak, it smells freshly cut, but looks to
have had some sort of hardening chemical used to make it
almost unbreakable. It can be used by all priestly types but
only for holy acts such as purifying a coffin.

name: wooden table
descriptions: This is a rather ordinary-looking wooden table, made to
last. Its thick face and legs are heavily nicked and cut
with use.

name: wooden table
descriptions: This is a fairly ordinary oaken table, about six feet by
four feet in size. It has four stumps as legs, and stands
three feet off of the ground.

name: woodland robes
descriptions: These forest-green robes are adorned with black and grey
stitching, depicting several different woodland creatures.
The robes are of a fine, almost silky fabric, and feel warm
to the touch. A palpable aura of power emanates from them.

name: words scratched into floor
descriptions: There are but a few straggling characters scratched into the
floor here, and due to their shaky hand you presume that
they were written in haste. Apparently parts have been
worn out with the passage of time. They read: "Do n#t push
th# le## ey#! #or#, ##e, h###, #### is th# #ay thr##gh."
There appears to be more, but much is scratched out.

name: worn stone tablet
descriptions: This ancient stone tablet is engraved with arcane runes,
detailing the methods and practice of druidic magic!

name: wyvernhide boots
descriptions: This pair of boots have been fashioned from wyvern's hide.
They are extremely tough, providing protection from the toe
to the middle of the shin. The insides are lined with a soft
material, to provide comfort as well.

name: wyvernhide gauntlets
descriptions: These leather gauntlets are made from the hide of a wyvern.
The dull brown scales are extremely tough, and provide
excellent protection for the hands. Wyvernhide is highly
prized as wyverns are known for their ferocity in combat.

name: wyvernhide helm
descriptions: This is a helm of thick, boiled, wyvern's hide. The brownish
scales look dull, but immensely sturdy, and you can tell
this helm was fashioned to offer decent protection for the
head.

name: wyvernhide pants
descriptions: These thick leather trousers are made from the hide of
some reptilian beast. The brown scales are incredibly
durable, and you can tell they provide protection that
would rival the thickest animal hide.

name: wyvernhide tunic
descriptions: This thick leather tunic is made from boiled wyvern's hide.
The dull brown scales are extremely tough, and provide
excellent protection from attack. Wyvernhide is highly
prized as wyverns are known for their ferocity in combat.

name: yellow banner
descriptions: FILE DESCRIPTION
WCCYEL.BAN

name: yellow bone portal
descriptions: A grotesque piece of sorcery, this portal appears to be made
of the bones of many humanoids. The vile gate pulsates
making the bones chatter to some foul tempo. A swirlling
crimson liquid pulsates within the portal, and the stink of
death reeks from it.

name: yellow bone portal
descriptions: A grotesque piece of sorcery, this portal appears to be made
of the bones of many humanoids. The vile gate pulsates
making the bones chatter to some foul tempo. A swirlling
crimson liquid pulsates within the portal, and the stink of
death reeks from it.

name: yellow key
descriptions: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to
manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling
you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright
yellow, you can assume to match whatever house it belongs
to.

name: yellow keyring
descriptions: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with
ease. It contains ten duplicate yellow keys.

name: yellow parchment deed
descriptions: A clean sheet of parchment rolled tight and sealed with bright
yellow wax bearing a leaf imprint. Written in steady black ink,
the deed grants the bearer full ownership of a gang hall with
capacity for up to 550 members.

name: yellow potion
descriptions: This is a glass vial filled with a thin, bright yellow
liquid. Stamped into the cork is a small symbol of a sun.

name: yellow potion
descriptions: This glass bottle holds a rich yellow liquid that almost
looks like melted cheese. A simple cork stopper plugs the
opening.

name: yellow robes
descriptions: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It
is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: yellowed note
descriptions: This worn, tattered parchment is inscribed with a few
straggling sentences, reading:

name: yellowed parchment
descriptions: A bright yellow parchment, written with black ink, it
unrolls easily and you read the following...

name: young tree
descriptions: This young tree has been planted decades ago and is in full
bloom of its leaves. It sways lightly through the wind, the
branches creaking like old bones and the whisper of leaves
is quiet and relaxing.
